translations.kjv: The book of the generation of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham.
translations.ylt: A roll of the birth of Jesus Christ, son of David, son of Abraham.
translations.web: The book of the genealogy of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham.

translations.kjv: Abraham begat Isaac; and Isaac begat Jacob; and Jacob begat Judas and his brethren;
translations.ylt: Abraham begat Isaac, and Isaac begat Jacob, and Jacob begat Judah and his brethren,
translations.web: Abraham became the father of Isaac. Isaac became the father of Jacob. Jacob became the father of Judah and his brothers.

translations.kjv: And Judas begat Phares and Zara of Thamar; and Phares begat Esrom; and Esrom begat Aram;
translations.ylt: and Judah begat Pharez and Zarah of Tamar, and Pharez begat Hezron, and Hezron begat Ram,
translations.web: Judah became the father of Perez and Zerah by Tamar. Perez became the father of Hezron. Hezron became the father of Ram.

translations.kjv: And Aram begat Aminadab; and Aminadab begat Naasson; and Naasson begat Salmon;
translations.ylt: and Ram begat Amminadab, and Amminadab begat Nahshon, and Nahshon begat Salmon,
translations.web: Ram became the father of Amminadab. Amminadab became the father of Nahshon. Nahshon became the father of Salmon.

translations.kjv: And Salmon begat Booz of Rachab; and Booz begat Obed of Ruth; and Obed begat Jesse;
translations.ylt: and Salmon begat Boaz of Rahab, and Boaz begat Obed of Ruth, and Obed begat Jesse,
translations.web: Salmon became the father of Boaz by Rahab. Boaz became the father of Obed by Ruth. Obed became the father of Jesse.

translations.kjv: And Jesse begat David the king; and David the king begat Solomon of her that had been the wife of Urias;
translations.ylt: and Jesse begat David the king. And David the king begat Solomon, of her who had been Uriah's,
translations.web: Jesse became the father of King David. David the king became the father of Solomon by her who had been Uriah’s wife.

translations.kjv: And Solomon begat Roboam; and Roboam begat Abia; and Abia begat Asa;
translations.ylt: and Solomon begat Rehoboam, and Rehoboam begat Abijah, and Abijah begat Asa,
translations.web: Solomon became the father of Rehoboam. Rehoboam became the father of Abijah. Abijah became the father of Asa.

translations.kjv: And Asa begat Josaphat; and Josaphat begat Joram; and Joram begat Ozias;
translations.ylt: and Asa begat Jehoshaphat, and Jehoshaphat begat Joram, and Joram begat Uzziah,
translations.web: Asa became the father of Jehoshaphat. Jehoshaphat became the father of Joram. Joram became the father of Uzziah.

translations.kjv: And Ozias begat Joatham; and Joatham begat Achaz; and Achaz begat Ezekias;
translations.ylt: and Uzziah begat Jotham, and Jotham begat Ahaz, and Ahaz begat Hezekiah,
translations.web: Uzziah became the father of Jotham. Jotham became the father of Ahaz. Ahaz became the father of Hezekiah.

translations.kjv: And Ezekias begat Manasses; and Manasses begat Amon; and Amon begat Josias;
translations.ylt: and Hezekiah begat Manasseh, and Manasseh begat Amon, and Amon begat Josiah,
translations.web: Hezekiah became the father of Manasseh. Manasseh became the father of Amon. Amon became the father of Josiah.

translations.kjv: And Josias begat Jechonias and his brethren, about the time they were carried away to Babylon:
translations.ylt: and Josiah begat Jeconiah and his brethren, at the Babylonian removal.
translations.web: Josiah became the father of Jechoniah and his brothers at the time of the exile to Babylon.

translations.kjv: And after they were brought to Babylon, Jechonias begat Salathiel; and Salathiel begat Zorobabel;
translations.ylt: And after the Babylonian removal, Jeconiah begat Shealtiel, and Shealtiel begat Zerubbabel,
translations.web: After the exile to Babylon, Jechoniah became the father of Shealtiel. Shealtiel became the father of Zerubbabel.

translations.kjv: And Zorobabel begat Abiud; and Abiud begat Eliakim; and Eliakim begat Azor;
translations.ylt: and Zerubbabel begat Abiud, and Abiud begat Eliakim, and Eliakim begat Azor,
translations.web: Zerubbabel became the father of Abiud. Abiud became the father of Eliakim. Eliakim became the father of Azor.

translations.kjv: And Azor begat Sadoc; and Sadoc begat Achim; and Achim begat Eliud;
translations.ylt: and Azor begat Sadok, and Sadok begat Achim, and Achim begat Eliud,
translations.web: Azor became the father of Zadok. Zadok became the father of Achim. Achim became the father of Eliud.

translations.kjv: And Eliud begat Eleazar; and Eleazar begat Matthan; and Matthan begat Jacob;
translations.ylt: and Eliud begat Eleazar, and Eleazar begat Matthan, and Matthan begat Jacob,
translations.web: Eliud became the father of Eleazar. Eleazar became the father of Matthan. Matthan became the father of Jacob.

translations.kjv: And Jacob begat Joseph the husband of Mary, of whom was born Jesus, who is called Christ.
translations.ylt: and Jacob begat Joseph, the husband of Mary, of whom was begotten Jesus, who is named Christ.
translations.web: Jacob became the father of Joseph, the husband of Mary, from whom was born Jesus, who is called Christ.

translations.kjv: So all the generations from Abraham to David are fourteen generations; and from David until the carrying away into Babylon are fourteen generations; and from the carrying away into Babylon unto Christ are fourteen generations.
translations.ylt: All the generations, therefore, from Abraham unto David are fourteen generations, and from David unto the Babylonian removal fourteen generations, and from the Babylonian removal unto the Christ, fourteen generations.
translations.web: So all the generations from Abraham to David are fourteen generations; from David to the exile to Babylon fourteen generations; and from the carrying away to Babylon to the Christ, fourteen generations.

translations.kjv: Now the birth of Jesus Christ was on this wise: When as his mother Mary was espoused to Joseph, before they came together, she was found with child of the Holy Ghost.
translations.ylt: And of Jesus Christ, the birth was thus: For his mother Mary having been betrothed to Joseph, before their coming together she was found to have conceived from the Holy Spirit,
translations.web: Now the birth of Jesus Christ was like this: After his mother, Mary, was engaged to Joseph, before they came together, she was found pregnant by the Holy Spirit.

translations.kjv: Then Joseph her husband, being a just man, and not willing to make her a publick example, was minded to put her away privily.
translations.ylt: and Joseph her husband being righteous, and not willing to make her an example, did wish privately to send her away.
translations.web: Joseph, her husband, being a righteous man, and not willing to make her a public example, intended to put her away secretly.

translations.kjv: But while he thought on these things, behold, the angel of the Lord appeared unto him in a dream, saying, Joseph, thou son of David, fear not to take unto thee Mary thy wife: for that which is conceived in her is of the Holy Ghost.
translations.ylt: And on his thinking of these things, lo, a messenger of the Lord in a dream appeared to him, saying, `Joseph, son of David, thou mayest not fear to receive Mary thy wife, for that which in her was begotten is of the Holy Spirit,
translations.web: But when he thought about these things, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in a dream, saying, “Joseph, son of David, don’t be afraid to take to yourself Mary as your wife, for that which is conceived in her is of the Holy Spirit.

translations.kjv: And she shall bring forth a son, and thou shalt call his name JESUS: for he shall save his people from their sins.
translations.ylt: and she shall bring forth a son, and thou shalt call his name Jesus, for he shall save his people from their sins.'
translations.web: She shall give birth to a son. You shall name him Jesus, for it is he who shall save his people from their sins.”

translations.kjv: Now all this was done, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken of the Lord by the prophet, saying,
translations.ylt: And all this hath come to pass, that it may be fulfilled that was spoken by the Lord through the prophet, saying,
translations.web: Now all this has happened that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the Lord through the prophet, saying,

translations.kjv: Behold, a virgin shall be with child, and shall bring forth a son, and they shall call his name Emmanuel, which being interpreted is, God with us.
translations.ylt: `Lo, the virgin shall conceive, and she shall bring forth a son, and they shall call his name Emmanuel,' which is, being interpreted `With us he is God.'
translations.web: “Behold, the virgin shall be with child, and shall give birth to a son. They shall call his name Immanuel,” which is, being interpreted, “God with us.”

translations.kjv: Then Joseph being raised from sleep did as the angel of the Lord had bidden him, and took unto him his wife:
translations.ylt: And Joseph, having risen from the sleep, did as the messenger of the Lord directed him, and received his wife,
translations.web: Joseph arose from his sleep, and did as the angel of the Lord commanded him, and took his wife to himself;

translations.kjv: And knew her not till she had brought forth her firstborn son: and he called his name JESUS.
translations.ylt: and did not know her till she brought forth her son--the first-born, and he called his name Jesus.
translations.web: and didn’t know her sexually until she had given birth to her firstborn son. He named him Jesus.

translations.kjv: Now when Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judea in the days of Herod the king, behold, there came wise men from the east to Jerusalem,
translations.ylt: And Jesus having been born in Beth-Lehem of Judea, in the days of Herod the king, lo, mages from the east came to Jerusalem,
translations.web: Now when Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judea in the days of King Herod, behold, wise men from the east came to Jerusalem, saying,

translations.kjv: Saying, Where is he that is born King of the Jews? for we have seen his star in the east, and are come to worship him.
translations.ylt: saying, `Where is he who was born king of the Jews? for we saw his star in the east, and we came to bow to him.'
translations.web: “Where is he who is born King of the Jews? For we saw his star in the east, and have come to worship him.”

translations.kjv: When Herod the king had heard these things, he was troubled, and all Jerusalem with him.
translations.ylt: And Herod the king having heard, was stirred, and all Jerusalem with him,
translations.web: When King Herod heard it, he was troubled, and all Jerusalem with him.

translations.kjv: And when he had gathered all the chief priests and scribes of the people together, he demanded of them where Christ should be born.
translations.ylt: and having gathered all the chief priests and scribes of the people, he was inquiring from them where the Christ is born.
translations.web: Gathering together all the chief priests and scribes of the people, he asked them where the Christ would be born.

translations.kjv: And they said unto him, In Bethlehem of Judea: for thus it is written by the prophet,
translations.ylt: And they said to him, `In Beth-Lehem of Judea, for thus it hath been written through the prophet,
translations.web: They said to him, “In Bethlehem of Judea, for this is written through the prophet,

translations.kjv: And thou Bethlehem, in the land of Juda, art not the least among the princes of Juda: for out of thee shall come a Governor, that shall rule my people Israel.
translations.ylt: And thou, Beth-Lehem, the land of Judah, thou art by no means the least among the leaders of Judah, for out of thee shall come one leading, who shall feed My people Israel.'
translations.web: ‘You Bethlehem, land of Judah, are in no way least among the princes of Judah; for out of you shall come a governor who shall shepherd my people, Israel.’”

translations.kjv: Then Herod, when he had privily called the wise men, enquired of them diligently what time the star appeared.
translations.ylt: Then Herod, privately having called the mages, did inquire exactly from them the time of the appearing star,
translations.web: Then Herod secretly called the wise men, and learned from them exactly what time the star appeared.

translations.kjv: And he sent them to Bethlehem, and said, Go and search diligently for the young child; and when ye have found him, bring me word again, that I may come and worship him also.
translations.ylt: and having sent them to Beth-Lehem, he said, `Having gone--inquire ye exactly for the child, and whenever ye may have found, bring me back word, that I also having come may bow to him.'
translations.web: He sent them to Bethlehem, and said, “Go and search diligently for the young child. When you have found him, bring me word, so that I also may come and worship him.”

translations.kjv: When they had heard the king, they departed; and, lo, the star, which they saw in the east, went before them, till it came and stood over where the young child was.
translations.ylt: And they, having heard the king, departed, and lo, the star, that they did see in the east, did go before them, till, having come, it stood over where the child was.
translations.web: They, having heard the king, went their way; and behold, the star, which they saw in the east, went before them until it came and stood over where the young child was.

translations.kjv: When they saw the star, they rejoiced with exceeding great joy.
translations.ylt: And having seen the star, they rejoiced with exceeding great joy,
translations.web: When they saw the star, they rejoiced with exceedingly great joy.

translations.kjv: And when they were come into the house, they saw the young child with Mary his mother, and fell down, and worshipped him: and when they had opened their treasures, they presented unto him gifts; gold, and frankincense, and myrrh.
translations.ylt: and having come to the house, they found the child with Mary his mother, and having fallen down they bowed to him, and having opened their treasures, they presented to him gifts, gold, and frankincense, and myrrh,
translations.web: They came into the house and saw the young child with Mary, his mother, and they fell down and worshiped him. Opening their treasures, they offered to him gifts: gold, frankincense, and myrrh.

translations.kjv: And being warned of God in a dream that they should not return to Herod, they departed into their own country another way.
translations.ylt: and having been divinely warned in a dream not to turn back unto Herod, through another way they withdrew to their own region.
translations.web: Being warned in a dream not to return to Herod, they went back to their own country another way.

translations.kjv: And when they were departed, behold, the angel of the Lord appeareth to Joseph in a dream, saying, Arise, and take the young child and his mother, and flee into Egypt, and be thou there until I bring thee word: for Herod will seek the young child to destroy him.
translations.ylt: And on their having withdrawn, lo, a messenger of the Lord doth appear in a dream to Joseph, saying, `Having risen, take the child and his mother, and flee to Egypt, and be thou there till I may speak to thee, for Herod is about to seek the child to destroy him.'
translations.web: Now when they had departed, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared to Joseph in a dream, saying, “Arise and take the young child and his mother, and flee into Egypt, and stay there until I tell you, for Herod will seek the young child to destroy him.”

translations.kjv: When he arose, he took the young child and his mother by night, and departed into Egypt:
translations.ylt: And he, having risen, took the child and his mother by night, and withdrew to Egypt,
translations.web: He arose and took the young child and his mother by night and departed into Egypt,

translations.kjv: And was there until the death of Herod: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken of the Lord by the prophet, saying, Out of Egypt have I called my son.
translations.ylt: and he was there till the death of Herod, that it might be fulfilled that was spoken by the Lord through the prophet, saying, `Out of Egypt I did call My Son.'
translations.web: and was there until the death of Herod, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the Lord through the prophet, saying, “Out of Egypt I called my son.”

translations.kjv: Then Herod, when he saw that he was mocked of the wise men, was exceeding wroth, and sent forth, and slew all the children that were in Bethlehem, and in all the coasts thereof, from two years old and under, according to the time which he had diligently enquired of the wise men.
translations.ylt: Then Herod, having seen that he was deceived by the mages, was very wroth, and having sent forth, he slew all the male children in Beth-Lehem, and in all its borders, from two years and under, according to the time that he inquired exactly from the mages.
translations.web: Then Herod, when he saw that he was mocked by the wise men, was exceedingly angry, and sent out and killed all the male children who were in Bethlehem and in all the surrounding countryside, from two years old and under, according to the exact time which he had learned from the wise men.

translations.kjv: Then was fulfilled that which was spoken by Jeremy the prophet, saying,
translations.ylt: Then was fulfilled that which was spoken by Jeremiah the prophet, saying,
translations.web: Then that which was spoken by Jeremiah the prophet was fulfilled, saying,

translations.kjv: In Rama was there a voice heard, lamentation, and weeping, and great mourning, Rachel weeping for her children, and would not be comforted, because they are not.
translations.ylt: `A voice in Ramah was heard--lamentation and weeping and much mourning--Rachel weeping for her children, and she would not be comforted because they are not.'
translations.web: “A voice was heard in Ramah, lamentation, weeping and great mourning, Rachel weeping for her children; she wouldn’t be comforted, because they are no more.”

translations.kjv: But when Herod was dead, behold, an angel of the Lord appeareth in a dream to Joseph in Egypt,
translations.ylt: And Herod having died, lo, a messenger of the Lord in a dream doth appear to Joseph in Egypt,
translations.web: But when Herod was dead, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared in a dream to Joseph in Egypt, saying,

translations.kjv: Saying, Arise, and take the young child and his mother, and go into the land of Israel: for they are dead which sought the young child’s life.
translations.ylt: saying, `Having risen, take the child and his mother, and be going to the land of Israel, for they have died--those seeking the life of the child.'
translations.web: “Arise and take the young child and his mother, and go into the land of Israel, for those who sought the young child’s life are dead.”

translations.kjv: And he arose, and took the young child and his mother, and came into the land of Israel.
translations.ylt: And he, having risen, took the child and his mother, and came to the land of Israel,
translations.web: He arose and took the young child and his mother, and came into the land of Israel.

translations.kjv: But when he heard that Archelaus did reign in Judea in the room of his father Herod, he was afraid to go thither: notwithstanding, being warned of God in a dream, he turned aside into the parts of Galilee:
translations.ylt: and having heard that Archelaus doth reign over Judea instead of Herod his father, he was afraid to go thither, and having been divinely warned in a dream, he withdrew to the parts of Galilee,
translations.web: But when he heard that Archelaus was reigning over Judea in the place of his father, Herod, he was afraid to go there. Being warned in a dream, he withdrew into the region of Galilee,

translations.kjv: And he came and dwelt in a city called Nazareth: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophets, He shall be called a Nazarene.
translations.ylt: and coming, he dwelt in a city named Nazareth, that it might be fulfilled that was spoken through the prophets, that `A Nazarene he shall be called.'
translations.web: and came and lived in a city called Nazareth; that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through the prophets that he will be called a Nazarene.

translations.kjv: In those days came John the Baptist, preaching in the wilderness of Judea,
translations.ylt: And in those days cometh John the Baptist, proclaiming in the wilderness of Judea,
translations.web: In those days, John the Baptizer came, preaching in the wilderness of Judea, saying,

translations.kjv: And saying, Repent ye: for the kingdom of heaven is at hand.
translations.ylt: and saying, `Reform, for come nigh hath the reign of the heavens,'
translations.web: “Repent, for the Kingdom of Heaven is at hand!”

translations.kjv: For this is he that was spoken of by the prophet Esaias, saying, The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.
translations.ylt: for this is he who was spoken of by Isaiah the prophet, saying, `A voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, straight make ye His paths.'
translations.web: For this is he who was spoken of by Isaiah the prophet, saying, “The voice of one crying in the wilderness, make the way of the Lord ready! Make his paths straight!”

translations.kjv: And the same John had his raiment of camel’s hair, and a leathern girdle about his loins; and his meat was locusts and wild honey.
translations.ylt: And this John had his clothing of camel's hair, and a girdle of skin round his loins, and his nourishment was locusts and honey of the field.
translations.web: Now John himself wore clothing made of camel’s hair with a leather belt around his waist. His food was locusts and wild honey.

translations.kjv: Then went out to him Jerusalem, and all Judea, and all the region round about Jordan,
translations.ylt: Then were going forth unto him Jerusalem, and all Judea, and all the region round about the Jordan,
translations.web: Then people from Jerusalem, all of Judea, and all the region around the Jordan went out to him.

translations.kjv: And were baptized of him in Jordan, confessing their sins.
translations.ylt: and they were baptized in the Jordan by him, confessing their sins.
translations.web: They were baptized by him in the Jordan, confessing their sins.

translations.kjv: But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees come to his baptism, he said unto them, O generation of vipers, who hath warned you to flee from the wrath to come?
translations.ylt: And having seen many of the Pharisees and Sadducees coming about his baptism, he said to them, `Brood of vipers! who did shew you to flee from the coming wrath?
translations.web: But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees coming for his baptism, he said to them, “You offspring of vipers, who warned you to flee from the wrath to come?

translations.kjv: Bring forth therefore fruits meet for repentance:
translations.ylt: bear, therefore, fruits worthy of the reformation,
translations.web: Therefore produce fruit worthy of repentance!

translations.kjv: And think not to say within yourselves, We have Abraham to our father: for I say unto you, that God is able of these stones to raise up children unto Abraham.
translations.ylt: and do not think to say in yourselves, A father we have--Abraham, for I say to you, that God is able out of these stones to raise children to Abraham,
translations.web: Don’t think to yourselves, ‘We have Abraham for our father,’ for I tell you that God is able to raise up children to Abraham from these stones.

translations.kjv: And now also the axe is laid unto the root of the trees: therefore every tree which bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.
translations.ylt: and now also, the axe unto the root of the trees is laid, every tree therefore not bearing good fruit is hewn down, and to fire is cast.
translations.web: Even now the ax lies at the root of the trees. Therefore every tree that doesn’t produce good fruit is cut down, and cast into the fire.

translations.kjv: I indeed baptize you with water unto repentance: but he that cometh after me is mightier than I, whose shoes I am not worthy to bear: he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost, and with fire:
translations.ylt: `I indeed do baptize you with water to reformation, but he who after me is coming is mightier than I, of whom I am not worthy to bear the sandals, he shall baptize you with the Holy Spirit and with fire,
translations.web: “I indeed baptize you in water for repentance, but he who comes after me is mightier than I, whose sandals I am not worthy to carry. He will baptize you in the Holy Spirit.

translations.kjv: Whose fan is in his hand, and he will throughly purge his floor, and gather his wheat into the garner; but he will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire.
translations.ylt: whose fan is in his hand, and he will thoroughly cleanse his floor, and will gather his wheat to the storehouse, but the chaff he will burn with fire unquenchable.'
translations.web: His winnowing fork is in his hand, and he will thoroughly cleanse his threshing floor. He will gather his wheat into the barn, but the chaff he will burn up with unquenchable fire.”

translations.kjv: Then cometh Jesus from Galilee to Jordan unto John, to be baptized of him.
translations.ylt: Then cometh Jesus from Galilee upon the Jordan, unto John to be baptized by him,
translations.web: Then Jesus came from Galilee to the Jordan to John, to be baptized by him.

translations.kjv: But John forbad him, saying, I have need to be baptized of thee, and comest thou to me?
translations.ylt: but John was forbidding him, saying, `I have need by thee to be baptized--and thou dost come unto me!'
translations.web: But John would have hindered him, saying, “I need to be baptized by you, and you come to me?”

translations.kjv: And Jesus answering said unto him, Suffer it to be so now: for thus it becometh us to fulfil all righteousness. Then he suffered him.
translations.ylt: But Jesus answering said to him, `Suffer now, for thus it is becoming to us to fulfil all righteousness,' then he doth suffer him.
translations.web: But Jesus, answering, said to him, “Allow it now, for this is the fitting way for us to fulfill all righteousness.” Then he allowed him.

translations.kjv: And Jesus, when he was baptized, went up straightway out of the water: and, lo, the heavens were opened unto him, and he saw the Spirit of God descending like a dove, and lighting upon him:
translations.ylt: And having been baptized, Jesus went up immediately from the water, and lo, opened to him were the heavens, and he saw the Spirit of God descending as a dove, and coming upon him,
translations.web: Jesus, when he was baptized, went up directly from the water: and behold, the heavens were opened to him. He saw the Spirit of God descending as a dove, and coming on him.

translations.kjv: And lo a voice from heaven, saying, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.
translations.ylt: and lo, a voice out of the heavens, saying, `This is My Son--the Beloved, in whom I did delight.'
translations.web: Behold, a voice out of the heavens said, “This is my beloved Son, with whom I am well pleased.”

translations.kjv: Then was Jesus led up of the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted of the devil.
translations.ylt: Then Jesus was led up to the wilderness by the Spirit, to be tempted by the Devil,
translations.web: Then Jesus was led up by the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted by the devil.

translations.kjv: And when he had fasted forty days and forty nights, he was afterward an hungred.
translations.ylt: and having fasted forty days and forty nights, afterwards he did hunger.
translations.web: When he had fasted forty days and forty nights, he was hungry afterward.

translations.kjv: And when the tempter came to him, he said, If thou be the Son of God, command that these stones be made bread.
translations.ylt: And the Tempter having come to him said, `If Son thou art of God--speak that these stones may become loaves.'
translations.web: The tempter came and said to him, “If you are the Son of God, command that these stones become bread.”

translations.kjv: But he answered and said, It is written, Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of God.
translations.ylt: But he answering said, `It hath been written, Not upon bread alone doth man live, but upon every word coming forth from the mouth of God.'
translations.web: But he answered, “It is written, ‘Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceeds out of God’s mouth.’”

translations.kjv: Then the devil taketh him up into the holy city, and setteth him on a pinnacle of the temple,
translations.ylt: Then doth the Devil take him to the holy city, and doth set him on the pinnacle of the temple,
translations.web: Then the devil took him into the holy city. He set him on the pinnacle of the temple,

translations.kjv: And saith unto him, If thou be the Son of God, cast thyself down: for it is written, He shall give his angels charge concerning thee: and in their hands they shall bear thee up, lest at any time thou dash thy foot against a stone.
translations.ylt: and saith to him, `If Son thou art of God--cast thyself down, for it hath been written, that, His messengers He shall charge concerning thee, and on hands they shall bear thee up, that thou mayest not dash on a stone thy foot.'
translations.web: and said to him, “If you are the Son of God, throw yourself down, for it is written, ‘He will command his angels concerning you,’ and, ‘On their hands they will bear you up, so that you don’t dash your foot against a stone.’”

translations.kjv: Jesus said unto him, It is written again, Thou shalt not tempt the Lord thy God.
translations.ylt: Jesus said to him again, `It hath been written, Thou shalt not tempt the Lord thy God.'
translations.web: Jesus said to him, “Again, it is written, ‘You shall not test the Lord, your God.’”

translations.kjv: Again, the devil taketh him up into an exceeding high mountain, and sheweth him all the kingdoms of the world, and the glory of them;
translations.ylt: Again doth the Devil take him to a very high mount, and doth shew to him all the kingdoms of the world and the glory of them,
translations.web: Again, the devil took him to an exceedingly high mountain, and showed him all the kingdoms of the world and their glory.

translations.kjv: And saith unto him, All these things will I give thee, if thou wilt fall down and worship me.
translations.ylt: and saith to him, `All these to thee I will give, if falling down thou mayest bow to me.'
translations.web: He said to him, “I will give you all of these things, if you will fall down and worship me.”

translations.kjv: Then saith Jesus unto him, Get thee hence, Satan: for it is written, Thou shalt worship the Lord thy God, and him only shalt thou serve.
translations.ylt: Then saith Jesus to him, `Go--Adversary, for it hath been written, The Lord thy God thou shalt bow to, and Him only thou shalt serve.'
translations.web: Then Jesus said to him, “Get behind me, Satan! For it is written, ‘You shall worship the Lord your God, and you shall serve him only.’”

translations.kjv: Then the devil leaveth him, and, behold, angels came and ministered unto him.
translations.ylt: Then doth the Devil leave him, and lo, messengers came and were ministering to him.
translations.web: Then the devil left him, and behold, angels came and served him.

translations.kjv: Now when Jesus had heard that John was cast into prison, he departed into Galilee;
translations.ylt: And Jesus having heard that John was delivered up, did withdraw to Galilee,
translations.web: Now when Jesus heard that John was delivered up, he withdrew into Galilee.

translations.kjv: And leaving Nazareth, he came and dwelt in Capernaum, which is upon the sea coast, in the borders of Zabulon and Nephthalim:
translations.ylt: and having left Nazareth, having come, he dwelt at Capernaum that is by the sea, in the borders of Zebulun and Naphtalim,
translations.web: Leaving Nazareth, he came and lived in Capernaum, which is by the sea, in the region of Zebulun and Naphtali,

translations.kjv: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet, saying,
translations.ylt: that it might be fulfilled that was spoken through Isaiah the prophet, saying,
translations.web: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through Isaiah the prophet, saying,

translations.kjv: The land of Zabulon, and the land of Nephthalim, by the way of the sea, beyond Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles;
translations.ylt: `Land of Zebulun and land of Naphtali, way of the sea, beyond the Jordan, Galilee of the nations! --
translations.web: “The land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali, toward the sea, beyond the Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles,

translations.kjv: The people which sat in darkness saw great light; and to them which sat in the region and shadow of death light is sprung up.
translations.ylt: the people that is sitting in darkness saw a great light, and to those sitting in a region and shadow of death--light arose to them.'
translations.web: the people who sat in darkness saw a great light; to those who sat in the region and shadow of death, to them light has dawned.”

translations.kjv: From that time Jesus began to preach, and to say, Repent: for the kingdom of heaven is at hand.
translations.ylt: From that time began Jesus to proclaim and to say, `Reform ye, for come nigh hath the reign of the heavens.'
translations.web: From that time, Jesus began to preach, and to say, “Repent! For the Kingdom of Heaven is at hand.”

translations.kjv: And Jesus, walking by the sea of Galilee, saw two brethren, Simon called Peter, and Andrew his brother, casting a net into the sea: for they were fishers.
translations.ylt: And Jesus, walking by the sea of Galilee, saw two brothers, Simon named Peter and Andrew his brother, casting a drag into the sea--for they were fishers--
translations.web: Walking by the sea of Galilee, he saw two brothers: Simon, who is called Peter, and Andrew, his brother, casting a net into the sea; for they were fishermen.

translations.kjv: And he saith unto them, Follow me, and I will make you fishers of men.
translations.ylt: and he saith to them, `Come ye after me, and I will make you fishers of men,'
translations.web: He said to them, “Come after me, and I will make you fishers for men.”

translations.kjv: And they straightway left their nets, and followed him.
translations.ylt: and they, immediately, having left the nets, did follow him.
translations.web: They immediately left their nets and followed him.

translations.kjv: And going on from thence, he saw other two brethren, James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, in a ship with Zebedee their father, mending their nets; and he called them.
translations.ylt: And having advanced thence, he saw other two brothers, James of Zebedee, and John his brother, in the boat with Zebedee their father, refitting their nets, and he called them,
translations.web: Going on from there, he saw two other brothers, James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, in the boat with Zebedee their father, mending their nets. He called them.

translations.kjv: And they immediately left the ship and their father, and followed him.
translations.ylt: and they, immediately, having left the boat and their father, did follow him.
translations.web: They immediately left the boat and their father, and followed him.

translations.kjv: And Jesus went about all Galilee, teaching in their synagogues, and preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing all manner of sickness and all manner of disease among the people.
translations.ylt: And Jesus was going about all Galilee teaching in their synagogues, and proclaiming the good news of the reign, and healing every disease, and every malady among the people,
translations.web: Jesus went about in all Galilee, teaching in their synagogues, preaching the Good News of the Kingdom, and healing every disease and every sickness among the people.

translations.kjv: And his fame went throughout all Syria: and they brought unto him all sick people that were taken with divers diseases and torments, and those which were possessed with devils, and those which were lunatick, and those that had the palsy; and he healed them.
translations.ylt: and his fame went forth to all Syria, and they brought to him all having ailments, pressed with manifold sicknesses and pains, and demoniacs, and lunatics, and paralytics, and he healed them.
translations.web: The report about him went out into all Syria. They brought to him all who were sick, afflicted with various diseases and torments, possessed with demons, epileptics, and paralytics; and he healed them.

translations.kjv: And there followed him great multitudes of people from Galilee, and from Decapolis, and from Jerusalem, and from Judea, and from beyond Jordan.
translations.ylt: And there followed him many multitudes from Galilee, and Decapolis, and Jerusalem, and Judea, and beyond the Jordan.
translations.web: Great multitudes from Galilee, Decapolis, Jerusalem, Judea, and from beyond the Jordan followed him.

translations.kjv: And seeing the multitudes, he went up into a mountain: and when he was set, his disciples came unto him:
translations.ylt: And having seen the multitudes, he went up to the mount, and he having sat down, his disciples came to him,
translations.web: Seeing the multitudes, he went up onto the mountain. When he had sat down, his disciples came to him.

translations.kjv: And he opened his mouth, and taught them, saying,
translations.ylt: and having opened his mouth, he was teaching them, saying:
translations.web: He opened his mouth and taught them, saying,

translations.kjv: Blessed are the poor in spirit: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
translations.ylt: `Happy the poor in spirit--because theirs is the reign of the heavens.
translations.web: “Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the Kingdom of Heaven.

translations.kjv: Blessed are they that mourn: for they shall be comforted.
translations.ylt: `Happy the mourning--because they shall be comforted.
translations.web: Blessed are those who mourn, for they shall be comforted.

translations.kjv: Blessed are the meek: for they shall inherit the earth.
translations.ylt: `Happy the meek--because they shall inherit the land.
translations.web: Blessed are the gentle, for they shall inherit the earth.

translations.kjv: Blessed are they which do hunger and thirst after righteousness: for they shall be filled.
translations.ylt: `Happy those hungering and thirsting for righteousness--because they shall be filled.
translations.web: Blessed are those who hunger and thirst for righteousness, for they shall be filled.

translations.kjv: Blessed are the merciful: for they shall obtain mercy.
translations.ylt: `Happy the kind--because they shall find kindness.
translations.web: Blessed are the merciful, for they shall obtain mercy.

translations.kjv: Blessed are the pure in heart: for they shall see God.
translations.ylt: `Happy the clean in heart--because they shall see God.
translations.web: Blessed are the pure in heart, for they shall see God.

translations.kjv: Blessed are the peacemakers: for they shall be called the children of God.
translations.ylt: `Happy the peacemakers--because they shall be called Sons of God.
translations.web: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they shall be called children of God.

translations.kjv: Blessed are they which are persecuted for righteousness’ sake: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
translations.ylt: `Happy those persecuted for righteousness' sake--because theirs is the reign of the heavens.
translations.web: Blessed are those who have been persecuted for righteousness’ sake, for theirs is the Kingdom of Heaven.

translations.kjv: Blessed are ye, when men shall revile you, and persecute you, and shall say all manner of evil against you falsely, for my sake.
translations.ylt: `Happy are ye whenever they may reproach you, and may persecute, and may say any evil thing against you falsely for my sake--
translations.web: “Blessed are you when people reproach you, persecute you, and say all kinds of evil against you falsely, for my sake.

translations.kjv: Rejoice, and be exceeding glad: for great is your reward in heaven: for so persecuted they the prophets which were before you.
translations.ylt: rejoice ye and be glad, because your reward is great in the heavens, for thus did they persecute the prophets who were before you.
translations.web: Rejoice, and be exceedingly glad, for great is your reward in heaven. For that is how they persecuted the prophets who were before you.

translations.kjv: Ye are the salt of the earth: but if the salt have lost his savour, wherewith shall it be salted? it is thenceforth good for nothing, but to be cast out, and to be trodden under foot of men.
translations.ylt: `Ye are the salt of the land, but if the salt may lose savour, in what shall it be salted? for nothing is it good henceforth, except to be cast without, and to be trodden down by men.
translations.web: “You are the salt of the earth, but if the salt has lost its flavor, with what will it be salted? It is then good for nothing, but to be cast out and trodden under the feet of men.

translations.kjv: Ye are the light of the world. A city that is set on an hill cannot be hid.
translations.ylt: `Ye are the light of the world, a city set upon a mount is not able to be hid;
translations.web: “You are the light of the world. A city located on a hill can’t be hidden.

translations.kjv: Neither do men light a candle, and put it under a bushel, but on a candlestick; and it giveth light unto all that are in the house.
translations.ylt: nor do they light a lamp, and put it under the measure, but on the lamp-stand, and it shineth to all those in the house;
translations.web: Neither do you light a lamp and put it under a measuring basket, but on a stand; and it shines to all who are in the house.

translations.kjv: Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father which is in heaven.
translations.ylt: so let your light shine before men, that they may see your good works, and may glorify your Father who is in the heavens.
translations.web: Even so, let your light shine before men, that they may see your good works and glorify your Father who is in heaven.

translations.kjv: Think not that I am come to destroy the law, or the prophets: I am not come to destroy, but to fulfil.
translations.ylt: `Do not suppose that I came to throw down the law or the prophets--I did not come to throw down, but to fulfil;
translations.web: “Don’t think that I came to destroy the law or the prophets. I didn’t come to destroy, but to fulfill.

translations.kjv: For verily I say unto you, Till heaven and earth pass, one jot or one tittle shall in no wise pass from the law, till all be fulfilled.
translations.ylt: for, verily I say to you, till that the heaven and the earth may pass away, one iota or one tittle may not pass away from the law, till that all may come to pass.
translations.web: For most certainly, I tell you, until heaven and earth pass away, not even one smallest letter or one tiny pen stroke shall in any way pass away from the law, until all things are accomplished.

translations.kjv: Whosoever therefore shall break one of these least commandments, and shall teach men so, he shall be called the least in the kingdom of heaven: but whosoever shall do and teach them, the same shall be called great in the kingdom of heaven.
translations.ylt: `Whoever therefore may loose one of these commands--the least--and may teach men so, least he shall be called in the reign of the heavens, but whoever may do and may teach them, he shall be called great in the reign of the heavens.
translations.web: Therefore, whoever shall break one of these least commandments and teach others to do so, shall be called least in the Kingdom of Heaven; but whoever shall do and teach them shall be called great in the Kingdom of Heaven.

translations.kjv: For I say unto you, That except your righteousness shall exceed the righteousness of the scribes and Pharisees, ye shall in no case enter into the kingdom of heaven.
translations.ylt: `For I say to you, that if your righteousness may not abound above that of the scribes and Pharisees, ye may not enter to the reign of the heavens.
translations.web: For I tell you that unless your righteousness exceeds that of the scribes and Pharisees, there is no way you will enter into the Kingdom of Heaven.

translations.kjv: Ye have heard that it was said by them of old time, Thou shalt not kill; and whosoever shall kill shall be in danger of the judgment:
translations.ylt: `Ye heard that it was said to the ancients: Thou shalt not kill, and whoever may kill shall be in danger of the judgment;
translations.web: “You have heard that it was said to the ancient ones, ‘You shall not murder;’ and ‘Whoever murders will be in danger of the judgment.’

translations.kjv: But I say unto you, That whosoever is angry with his brother without a cause shall be in danger of the judgment: and whosoever shall say to his brother, Raca, shall be in danger of the council: but whosoever shall say, Thou fool, shall be in danger of hell fire.
translations.ylt: but I--I say to you, that every one who is angry at his brother without cause, shall be in danger of the judgment, and whoever may say to his brother, Empty fellow! shall be in danger of the sanhedrim, and whoever may say, Rebel! shall be in danger of the gehenna of the fire.
translations.web: But I tell you that everyone who is angry with his brother without a cause will be in danger of the judgment. Whoever says to his brother, ‘Raca!’ will be in danger of the council. Whoever says, ‘You fool!’ will be in danger of the fire of Gehenna.

translations.kjv: Therefore if thou bring thy gift to the altar, and there rememberest that thy brother hath ought against thee;
translations.ylt: `If, therefore, thou mayest bring thy gift to the altar, and there mayest remember that thy brother hath anything against thee,
translations.web: “If therefore you are offering your gift at the altar, and there remember that your brother has anything against you,

translations.kjv: Leave there thy gift before the altar, and go thy way; first be reconciled to thy brother, and then come and offer thy gift.
translations.ylt: leave there thy gift before the altar, and go--first be reconciled to thy brother, and then having come bring thy gift.
translations.web: leave your gift there before the altar, and go your way. First be reconciled to your brother, and then come and offer your gift.

translations.kjv: Agree with thine adversary quickly, whiles thou art in the way with him; lest at any time the adversary deliver thee to the judge, and the judge deliver thee to the officer, and thou be cast into prison.
translations.ylt: `Be agreeing with thy opponent quickly, while thou art in the way with him, that the opponent may not deliver thee to the judge, and the judge may deliver thee to the officer, and to prison thou mayest be cast,
translations.web: Agree with your adversary quickly while you are with him on the way; lest perhaps the prosecutor deliver you to the judge, and the judge deliver you to the officer, and you be cast into prison.

translations.kjv: Verily I say unto thee, Thou shalt by no means come out thence, till thou hast paid the uttermost farthing.
translations.ylt: verily I say to thee, thou mayest not come forth thence till that thou mayest pay the last farthing.
translations.web: Most certainly I tell you, you shall by no means get out of there until you have paid the last penny.

translations.kjv: Ye have heard that it was said by them of old time, Thou shalt not commit adultery:
translations.ylt: `Ye heard that it was said to the ancients: Thou shalt not commit adultery;
translations.web: “You have heard that it was said, ‘You shall not commit adultery;’

translations.kjv: But I say unto you, That whosoever looketh on a woman to lust after her hath committed adultery with her already in his heart.
translations.ylt: but I--I say to you, that every one who is looking on a woman to desire her, did already commit adultery with her in his heart.
translations.web: but I tell you that everyone who gazes at a woman to lust after her has committed adultery with her already in his heart.

translations.kjv: And if thy right eye offend thee, pluck it out, and cast it from thee: for it is profitable for thee that one of thy members should perish, and not that thy whole body should be cast into hell.
translations.ylt: `But, if thy right eye doth cause thee to stumble, pluck it out and cast from thee, for it is good to thee that one of thy members may perish, and not thy whole body be cast to gehenna.
translations.web: If your right eye causes you to stumble, pluck it out and throw it away from you. For it is more profitable for you that one of your members should perish than for your whole body to be cast into Gehenna.

translations.kjv: And if thy right hand offend thee, cut it off, and cast it from thee: for it is profitable for thee that one of thy members should perish, and not that thy whole body should be cast into hell.
translations.ylt: `And, if thy right hand doth cause thee to stumble, cut it off, and cast from thee, for it is good to thee that one of thy members may perish, and not thy whole body be cast to gehenna.
translations.web: If your right hand causes you to stumble, cut it off, and throw it away from you. For it is more profitable for you that one of your members should perish, than for your whole body to be cast into Gehenna.

translations.kjv: It hath been said, Whosoever shall put away his wife, let him give her a writing of divorcement:
translations.ylt: `And it was said, That whoever may put away his wife, let him give to her a writing of divorce;
translations.web: “It was also said, ‘Whoever shall put away his wife, let him give her a writing of divorce,’

translations.kjv: But I say unto you, That whosoever shall put away his wife, saving for the cause of fornication, causeth her to commit adultery: and whosoever shall marry her that is divorced committeth adultery.
translations.ylt: but I--I say to you, that whoever may put away his wife, save for the matter of whoredom, doth make her to commit adultery; and whoever may marry her who hath been put away doth commit adultery.
translations.web: but I tell you that whoever puts away his wife, except for the cause of sexual immorality, makes her an adulteress; and whoever marries her when she is put away commits adultery.

translations.kjv: Again, ye have heard that it hath been said by them of old time, Thou shalt not forswear thyself, but shalt perform unto the Lord thine oaths:
translations.ylt: `Again, ye heard that it was said to the ancients: Thou shalt not swear falsely, but thou shalt pay to the Lord thine oaths;
translations.web: “Again you have heard that it was said to the ancient ones, ‘You shall not make false vows, but shall perform to the Lord your vows,’

translations.kjv: But I say unto you, Swear not at all; neither by heaven; for it is God’s throne:
translations.ylt: but I--I say to you, not to swear at all; neither by the heaven, because it is the throne of God,
translations.web: but I tell you, don’t swear at all: neither by heaven, for it is the throne of God;

translations.kjv: Nor by the earth; for it is his footstool: neither by Jerusalem; for it is the city of the great King.
translations.ylt: nor by the earth, because it is His footstool, nor by Jerusalem, because it is a city of a great king,
translations.web: nor by the earth, for it is the footstool of his feet; nor by Jerusalem, for it is the city of the great King.

translations.kjv: Neither shalt thou swear by thy head, because thou canst not make one hair white or black.
translations.ylt: nor by thy head mayest thou swear, because thou art not able one hair to make white or black;
translations.web: Neither shall you swear by your head, for you can’t make one hair white or black.

translations.kjv: But let your communication be, Yea, yea; Nay, nay: for whatsoever is more than these cometh of evil.
translations.ylt: but let your word be, Yes, Yes, No, No, and that which is more than these is of the evil.
translations.web: But let your ‘Yes’ be ‘Yes’ and your ‘No’ be ‘No.’ Whatever is more than these is of the evil one.

translations.kjv: Ye have heard that it hath been said, An eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth:
translations.ylt: `Ye heard that it was said: Eye for eye, and tooth for tooth;
translations.web: “You have heard that it was said, ‘An eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth.’

translations.kjv: But I say unto you, That ye resist not evil: but whosoever shall smite thee on thy right cheek, turn to him the other also.
translations.ylt: but I--I say to you, not to resist the evil, but whoever shall slap thee on thy right cheek, turn to him also the other;
translations.web: But I tell you, don’t resist him who is evil; but whoever strikes you on your right cheek, turn to him the other also.

translations.kjv: And if any man will sue thee at the law, and take away thy coat, let him have thy cloke also.
translations.ylt: and whoever is willing to take thee to law, and thy coat to take--suffer to him also the cloak.
translations.web: If anyone sues you to take away your coat, let him have your cloak also.

translations.kjv: And whosoever shall compel thee to go a mile, go with him twain.
translations.ylt: `And whoever shall impress thee one mile, go with him two,
translations.web: Whoever compels you to go one mile, go with him two.

translations.kjv: Give to him that asketh thee, and from him that would borrow of thee turn not thou away.
translations.ylt: to him who is asking of thee be giving, and him who is willing to borrow from thee thou mayest not turn away.
translations.web: Give to him who asks you, and don’t turn away him who desires to borrow from you.

translations.kjv: Ye have heard that it hath been said, Thou shalt love thy neighbour, and hate thine enemy.
translations.ylt: `Ye heard that it was said: Thou shalt love thy neighbour, and shalt hate thine enemy;
translations.web: “You have heard that it was said, ‘You shall love your neighbor and hate your enemy.’

translations.kjv: But I say unto you, Love your enemies, bless them that curse you, do good to them that hate you, and pray for them which despitefully use you, and persecute you;
translations.ylt: but I--I say to you, Love your enemies, bless those cursing you, do good to those hating you, and pray for those accusing you falsely, and persecuting you,
translations.web: But I tell you, love your enemies, bless those who curse you, do good to those who hate you, and pray for those who mistreat you and persecute you,

translations.kjv: That ye may be the children of your Father which is in heaven: for he maketh his sun to rise on the evil and on the good, and sendeth rain on the just and on the unjust.
translations.ylt: that ye may be sons of your Father in the heavens, because His sun He doth cause to rise on evil and good, and He doth send rain on righteous and unrighteous.
translations.web: that you may be children of your Father who is in heaven. For he makes his sun to rise on the evil and the good, and sends rain on the just and the unjust.

translations.kjv: For if ye love them which love you, what reward have ye? do not even the publicans the same?
translations.ylt: `For, if ye may love those loving you, what reward have ye? do not also the tax-gatherers the same?
translations.web: For if you love those who love you, what reward do you have? Don’t even the tax collectors do the same?

translations.kjv: And if ye salute your brethren only, what do ye more than others? do not even the publicans so?
translations.ylt: and if ye may salute your brethren only, what do ye abundant? do not also the tax-gatherers so?
translations.web: If you only greet your friends, what more do you do than others? Don’t even the tax collectors do the same?

translations.kjv: Be ye therefore perfect, even as your Father which is in heaven is perfect.
translations.ylt: ye shall therefore be perfect, as your Father who is in the heavens is perfect.
translations.web: Therefore you shall be perfect, just as your Father in heaven is perfect.

translations.kjv: Take heed that ye do not your alms before men, to be seen of them: otherwise ye have no reward of your Father which is in heaven.
translations.ylt: `Take heed your kindness not to do before men, to be seen by them, and if not--reward ye have not from your Father who is in the heavens;
translations.web: “Be careful that you don’t do your charitable giving before men, to be seen by them, or else you have no reward from your Father who is in heaven.

translations.kjv: Therefore when thou doest thine alms, do not sound a trumpet before thee, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets, that they may have glory of men. Verily I say unto you, They have their reward.
translations.ylt: whenever, therefore, thou mayest do kindness, thou mayest not sound a trumpet before thee as the hypocrites do, in the synagogues, and in the streets, that they may have glory from men; verily I say to you--they have their reward!
translations.web: Therefore, when you do merciful deeds, don’t sound a trumpet before yourself, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets, that they may get glory from men. Most certainly I tell you, they have received their reward.

translations.kjv: But when thou doest alms, let not thy left hand know what thy right hand doeth:
translations.ylt: `But thou, doing kindness, let not thy left hand know what thy right hand doth,
translations.web: But when you do merciful deeds, don’t let your left hand know what your right hand does,

translations.kjv: That thine alms may be in secret: and thy Father which seeth in secret himself shall reward thee openly.
translations.ylt: that thy kindness may be in secret, and thy Father who is seeing in secret Himself shall reward thee manifestly.
translations.web: so that your merciful deeds may be in secret, then your Father who sees in secret will reward you openly.

translations.kjv: And when thou prayest, thou shalt not be as the hypocrites are: for they love to pray standing in the synagogues and in the corners of the streets, that they may be seen of men. Verily I say unto you, They have their reward.
translations.ylt: `And when thou mayest pray, thou shalt not be as the hypocrites, because they love in the synagogues, and in the corners of the broad places--standing--to pray, that they may be seen of men; verily I say to you, that they have their reward.
translations.web: “When you pray, you shall not be as the hypocrites, for they love to stand and pray in the synagogues and in the corners of the streets, that they may be seen by men. Most certainly, I tell you, they have received their reward.

translations.kjv: But thou, when thou prayest, enter into thy closet, and when thou hast shut thy door, pray to thy Father which is in secret; and thy Father which seeth in secret shall reward thee openly.
translations.ylt: `But thou, when thou mayest pray, go into thy chamber, and having shut thy door, pray to thy Father who is in secret, and thy Father who is seeing in secret, shall reward thee manifestly.
translations.web: But you, when you pray, enter into your inner room, and having shut your door, pray to your Father who is in secret; and your Father who sees in secret will reward you openly.

translations.kjv: But when ye pray, use not vain repetitions, as the heathen do: for they think that they shall be heard for their much speaking.
translations.ylt: `And--praying--ye may not use vain repetitions like the nations, for they think that in their much speaking they shall be heard,
translations.web: In praying, don’t use vain repetitions as the Gentiles do; for they think that they will be heard for their much speaking.

translations.kjv: Be not ye therefore like unto them: for your Father knoweth what things ye have need of, before ye ask him.
translations.ylt: be ye not therefore like to them, for your Father doth know those things that ye have need of before your asking him;
translations.web: Therefore don’t be like them, for your Father knows what things you need before you ask him.

translations.kjv: After this manner therefore pray ye: Our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name.
translations.ylt: thus therefore pray ye: `Our Father who art in the heavens! hallowed be Thy name.
translations.web: Pray like this: “‘Our Father in heaven, may your name be kept holy.

translations.kjv: Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done in earth, as it is in heaven.
translations.ylt: `Thy reign come: Thy will come to pass, as in heaven also on the earth.
translations.web: Let your Kingdom come. Let your will be done on earth as it is in heaven.

translations.kjv: Give us this day our daily bread.
translations.ylt: `Our appointed bread give us to-day.
translations.web: Give us today our daily bread.

translations.kjv: And forgive us our debts, as we forgive our debtors.
translations.ylt: `And forgive us our debts, as also we forgive our debtors.
translations.web: Forgive us our debts, as we also forgive our debtors.

translations.kjv: And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil: For thine is the kingdom, and the power, and the glory, for ever. Amen.
translations.ylt: `And mayest Thou not lead us to temptation, but deliver us from the evil, because Thine is the reign, and the power, and the glory--to the ages. Amen.
translations.web: Bring us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one. For yours is the Kingdom, the power, and the glory forever. Amen.’

translations.kjv: For if ye forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you:
translations.ylt: `For, if ye may forgive men their trespasses He also will forgive you--your Father who is in the heavens;
translations.web: “For if you forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you.

translations.kjv: But if ye forgive not men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive your trespasses.
translations.ylt: but if ye may not forgive men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive your trespasses.
translations.web: But if you don’t forgive men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive your trespasses.

translations.kjv: Moreover when ye fast, be not, as the hypocrites, of a sad countenance: for they disfigure their faces, that they may appear unto men to fast. Verily I say unto you, They have their reward.
translations.ylt: `And when ye may fast, be ye not as the hypocrites, of sour countenances, for they disfigure their faces, that they may appear to men fasting; verily I say to you, that they have their reward.
translations.web: “Moreover when you fast, don’t be like the hypocrites, with sad faces. For they disfigure their faces that they may be seen by men to be fasting. Most certainly I tell you, they have received their reward.

translations.kjv: But thou, when thou fastest, anoint thine head, and wash thy face;
translations.ylt: `But thou, fasting, anoint thy head, and wash thy face,
translations.web: But you, when you fast, anoint your head and wash your face,

translations.kjv: That thou appear not unto men to fast, but unto thy Father which is in secret: and thy Father, which seeth in secret, shall reward thee openly.
translations.ylt: that thou mayest not appear to men fasting, but to thy Father who is in secret, and thy Father, who is seeing in secret, shall reward thee manifestly.
translations.web: so that you are not seen by men to be fasting, but by your Father who is in secret; and your Father, who sees in secret, will reward you.

translations.kjv: Lay not up for yourselves treasures upon earth, where moth and rust doth corrupt, and where thieves break through and steal:
translations.ylt: `Treasure not up to yourselves treasures on the earth, where moth and rust disfigure, and where thieves break through and steal,
translations.web: “Don’t lay up treasures for yourselves on the earth, where moth and rust consume, and where thieves break through and steal;

translations.kjv: But lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust doth corrupt, and where thieves do not break through nor steal:
translations.ylt: but treasure up to yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust doth disfigure, and where thieves do not break through nor steal,
translations.web: but lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust consume, and where thieves don’t break through and steal;

translations.kjv: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.
translations.ylt: for where your treasure is, there will be also your heart.
translations.web: for where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.

translations.kjv: The light of the body is the eye: if therefore thine eye be single, thy whole body shall be full of light.
translations.ylt: `The lamp of the body is the eye, if, therefore, thine eye may be perfect, all thy body shall be enlightened,
translations.web: “The lamp of the body is the eye. If therefore your eye is sound, your whole body will be full of light.

translations.kjv: But if thine eye be evil, thy whole body shall be full of darkness. If therefore the light that is in thee be darkness, how great is that darkness!
translations.ylt: but if thine eye may be evil, all thy body shall be dark; if, therefore, the light that is in thee is darkness--the darkness, how great!
translations.web: But if your eye is evil, your whole body will be full of darkness. If therefore the light that is in you is darkness, how great is the darkness!

translations.kjv: No man can serve two masters: for either he will hate the one, and love the other; or else he will hold to the one, and despise the other. Ye cannot serve God and mammon.
translations.ylt: `None is able to serve two lords, for either he will hate the one and love the other, or he will hold to the one, and despise the other; ye are not able to serve God and Mammon.
translations.web: “No one can serve two masters, for either he will hate the one and love the other, or else he will be devoted to one and despise the other. You can’t serve both God and Mammon.

translations.kjv: Therefore I say unto you, Take no thought for your life, what ye shall eat, or what ye shall drink; nor yet for your body, what ye shall put on. Is not the life more than meat, and the body than raiment?
translations.ylt: `Because of this I say to you, be not anxious for your life, what ye may eat, and what ye may drink, nor for your body, what ye may put on. Is not the life more than the nourishment, and the body than the clothing?
translations.web: Therefore I tell you, don’t be anxious for your life: what you will eat, or what you will drink; nor yet for your body, what you will wear. Isn’t life more than food, and the body more than clothing?

translations.kjv: Behold the fowls of the air: for they sow not, neither do they reap, nor gather into barns; yet your heavenly Father feedeth them. Are ye not much better than they?
translations.ylt: look to the fowls of the heaven, for they do not sow, nor reap, nor gather into storehouses, and your heavenly Father doth nourish them; are not ye much better than they?
translations.web: See the birds of the sky, that they don’t sow, neither do they reap, nor gather into barns. Your heavenly Father feeds them. Aren’t you of much more value than they?

translations.kjv: Which of you by taking thought can add one cubit unto his stature?
translations.ylt: `And who of you, being anxious, is able to add to his age one cubit?
translations.web: “Which of you by being anxious, can add one moment to his lifespan?

translations.kjv: And why take ye thought for raiment? Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow; they toil not, neither do they spin:
translations.ylt: and about clothing why are ye anxious? consider well the lilies of the field; how do they grow? they do not labour, nor do they spin;
translations.web: Why are you anxious about clothing? Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow. They don’t toil, neither do they spin,

translations.kjv: And yet I say unto you, That even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.
translations.ylt: and I say to you, that not even Solomon in all his glory was arrayed as one of these.
translations.web: yet I tell you that even Solomon in all his glory was not dressed like one of these.

translations.kjv: Wherefore, if God so clothe the grass of the field, which to day is, and to morrow is cast into the oven, shall he not much more clothe you, O ye of little faith?
translations.ylt: `And if the herb of the field, that to-day is, and to-morrow is cast to the furnace, God doth so clothe--not much more you, O ye of little faith?
translations.web: But if God so clothes the grass of the field, which today exists and tomorrow is thrown into the oven, won’t he much more clothe you, you of little faith?

translations.kjv: Therefore take no thought, saying, What shall we eat? or, What shall we drink? or, Wherewithal shall we be clothed?
translations.ylt: therefore ye may not be anxious, saying, What may we eat? or, What may we drink? or, What may we put round?
translations.web: “Therefore don’t be anxious, saying, ‘What will we eat?’, ‘What will we drink?’ or, ‘With what will we be clothed?’

translations.kjv: (For after all these things do the Gentiles seek:) for your heavenly Father knoweth that ye have need of all these things.
translations.ylt: for all these do the nations seek for, for your heavenly Father doth know that ye have need of all these;
translations.web: For the Gentiles seek after all these things; for your heavenly Father knows that you need all these things.

translations.kjv: But seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you.
translations.ylt: but seek ye first the reign of God and His righteousness, and all these shall be added to you.
translations.web: But seek first God’s Kingdom and his righteousness; and all these things will be given to you as well.

translations.kjv: Take therefore no thought for the morrow: for the morrow shall take thought for the things of itself. Sufficient unto the day is the evil thereof.
translations.ylt: Be not therefore anxious for the morrow, for the morrow shall be anxious for its own things; sufficient for the day is the evil of it.
translations.web: Therefore don’t be anxious for tomorrow, for tomorrow will be anxious for itself. Each day’s own evil is sufficient.

translations.kjv: Judge not, that ye be not judged.
translations.ylt: `Judge not, that ye may not be judged,
translations.web: “Don’t judge, so that you won’t be judged.

translations.kjv: For with what judgment ye judge, ye shall be judged: and with what measure ye mete, it shall be measured to you again.
translations.ylt: for in what judgment ye judge, ye shall be judged, and in what measure ye measure, it shall be measured to you.
translations.web: For with whatever judgment you judge, you will be judged; and with whatever measure you measure, it will be measured to you.

translations.kjv: And why beholdest thou the mote that is in thy brother’s eye, but considerest not the beam that is in thine own eye?
translations.ylt: `And why dost thou behold the mote that is in thy brother's eye, and the beam that is in thine own eye dost not consider?
translations.web: Why do you see the speck that is in your brother’s eye, but don’t consider the beam that is in your own eye?

translations.kjv: Or how wilt thou say to thy brother, Let me pull out the mote out of thine eye; and, behold, a beam is in thine own eye?
translations.ylt: or, how wilt thou say to thy brother, Suffer I may cast out the mote from thine eye, and lo, the beam is in thine own eye?
translations.web: Or how will you tell your brother, ‘Let me remove the speck from your eye,’ and behold, the beam is in your own eye?

translations.kjv: Thou hypocrite, first cast out the beam out of thine own eye; and then shalt thou see clearly to cast out the mote out of thy brother’s eye.
translations.ylt: Hypocrite, cast out first the beam out of thine own eye, and then thou shalt see clearly to cast out the mote out of thy brother's eye.
translations.web: You hypocrite! First remove the beam out of your own eye, and then you can see clearly to remove the speck out of your brother’s eye.

translations.kjv: Give not that which is holy unto the dogs, neither cast ye your pearls before swine, lest they trample them under their feet, and turn again and rend you.
translations.ylt: `Ye may not give that which is holy to the dogs, nor cast your pearls before the swine, that they may not trample them among their feet, and having turned--may rend you.
translations.web: “Don’t give that which is holy to the dogs, neither throw your pearls before the pigs, lest perhaps they trample them under their feet, and turn and tear you to pieces.

translations.kjv: Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you:
translations.ylt: `Ask, and it shall be given to you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened to you;
translations.web: “Ask, and it will be given you. Seek, and you will find. Knock, and it will be opened for you.

translations.kjv: For every one that asketh receiveth; and he that seeketh findeth; and to him that knocketh it shall be opened.
translations.ylt: for every one who is asking doth receive, and he who is seeking doth find, and to him who is knocking it shall be opened.
translations.web: For everyone who asks receives. He who seeks finds. To him who knocks it will be opened.

translations.kjv: Or what man is there of you, whom if his son ask bread, will he give him a stone?
translations.ylt: `Or what man is of you, of whom, if his son may ask a loaf--a stone will he present to him?
translations.web: Or who is there among you who, if his son asks him for bread, will give him a stone?

translations.kjv: Or if he ask a fish, will he give him a serpent?
translations.ylt: and if a fish he may ask--a serpent will he present to him?
translations.web: Or if he asks for a fish, who will give him a serpent?

translations.kjv: If ye then, being evil, know how to give good gifts unto your children, how much more shall your Father which is in heaven give good things to them that ask him?
translations.ylt: if, therefore, ye being evil, have known good gifts to give to your children, how much more shall your Father who is in the heavens give good things to those asking him?
translations.web: If you then, being evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father who is in heaven give good things to those who ask him!

translations.kjv: Therefore all things whatsoever ye would that men should do to you, do ye even so to them: for this is the law and the prophets.
translations.ylt: `All things, therefore, whatever ye may will that men may be doing to you, so also do to them, for this is the law and the prophets.
translations.web: Therefore, whatever you desire for men to do to you, you shall also do to them; for this is the law and the prophets.

translations.kjv: Enter ye in at the strait gate: for wide is the gate, and broad is the way, that leadeth to destruction, and many there be which go in thereat:
translations.ylt: `Go ye in through the strait gate, because wide is the gate, and broad the way that is leading to the destruction, and many are those going in through it;
translations.web: “Enter in by the narrow gate; for the gate is wide and the way is broad that leads to destruction, and there are many who enter in by it.

translations.kjv: Because strait is the gate, and narrow is the way, which leadeth unto life, and few there be that find it.
translations.ylt: how strait is the gate, and compressed the way that is leading to the life, and few are those finding it!
translations.web: How narrow is the gate and the way is restricted that leads to life! There are few who find it.

translations.kjv: Beware of false prophets, which come to you in sheep’s clothing, but inwardly they are ravening wolves.
translations.ylt: `But, take heed of the false prophets, who come unto you in sheep's clothing, and inwardly are ravening wolves.
translations.web: “Beware of false prophets, who come to you in sheep’s clothing, but inwardly are ravening wolves.

translations.kjv: Ye shall know them by their fruits. Do men gather grapes of thorns, or figs of thistles?
translations.ylt: From their fruits ye shall know them; do men gather from thorns grapes? or from thistles figs?
translations.web: By their fruits you will know them. Do you gather grapes from thorns or figs from thistles?

translations.kjv: Even so every good tree bringeth forth good fruit; but a corrupt tree bringeth forth evil fruit.
translations.ylt: so every good tree doth yield good fruits, but the bad tree doth yield evil fruits.
translations.web: Even so, every good tree produces good fruit, but the corrupt tree produces evil fruit.

translations.kjv: A good tree cannot bring forth evil fruit, neither can a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit.
translations.ylt: A good tree is not able to yield evil fruits, nor a bad tree to yield good fruits.
translations.web: A good tree can’t produce evil fruit, neither can a corrupt tree produce good fruit.

translations.kjv: Every tree that bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.
translations.ylt: Every tree not yielding good fruit is cut down and is cast to fire:
translations.web: Every tree that doesn’t grow good fruit is cut down and thrown into the fire.

translations.kjv: Wherefore by their fruits ye shall know them.
translations.ylt: therefore from their fruits ye shall know them.
translations.web: Therefore by their fruits you will know them.

translations.kjv: Not every one that saith unto me, Lord, Lord, shall enter into the kingdom of heaven; but he that doeth the will of my Father which is in heaven.
translations.ylt: `Not every one who is saying to me Lord, lord, shall come into the reign of the heavens; but he who is doing the will of my Father who is in the heavens.
translations.web: “Not everyone who says to me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ will enter into the Kingdom of Heaven, but he who does the will of my Father who is in heaven.

translations.kjv: Many will say to me in that day, Lord, Lord, have we not prophesied in thy name? and in thy name have cast out devils? and in thy name done many wonderful works?
translations.ylt: Many will say to me in that day, Lord, lord, have we not in thy name prophesied? and in thy name cast out demons? and in thy name done many mighty things?
translations.web: Many will tell me in that day, ‘Lord, Lord, didn’t we prophesy in your name, in your name cast out demons, and in your name do many mighty works?’

translations.kjv: And then will I profess unto them, I never knew you: depart from me, ye that work iniquity.
