translations.ylt: and then I will acknowledge to them, that--I never knew you, depart from me ye who are working lawlessness.
translations.web: Then I will tell them, ‘I never knew you. Depart from me, you who work iniquity.’

translations.kjv: Therefore whosoever heareth these sayings of mine, and doeth them, I will liken him unto a wise man, which built his house upon a rock:
translations.ylt: `Therefore, every one who doth hear of me these words, and doth do them, I will liken him to a wise man who built his house upon the rock;
translations.web: “Everyone therefore who hears these words of mine and does them, I will liken him to a wise man who built his house on the rock.

translations.kjv: And the rain descended, and the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat upon that house; and it fell not: for it was founded upon a rock.
translations.ylt: and the rain did descend, and the streams came, and the winds blew, and they beat on that house, and it fell not, for it had been founded on the rock.
translations.web: The rain came down, the floods came, and the winds blew and beat on that house; and it didn’t fall, for it was founded on the rock.

translations.kjv: And every one that heareth these sayings of mine, and doeth them not, shall be likened unto a foolish man, which built his house upon the sand:
translations.ylt: `And every one who is hearing of me these words, and is not doing them, shall be likened to a foolish man who built his house upon the sand;
translations.web: Everyone who hears these words of mine and doesn’t do them will be like a foolish man who built his house on the sand.

translations.kjv: And the rain descended, and the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat upon that house; and it fell: and great was the fall of it.
translations.ylt: and the rain did descend, and the streams came, and the winds blew, and they beat on that house, and it fell, and its fall was great.'
translations.web: The rain came down, the floods came, and the winds blew and beat on that house; and it fell—and its fall was great.”

translations.kjv: And it came to pass, when Jesus had ended these sayings, the people were astonished at his doctrine:
translations.ylt: And it came to pass, when Jesus ended these words, the multitudes were astonished at his teaching,
translations.web: When Jesus had finished saying these things, the multitudes were astonished at his teaching,

translations.kjv: For he taught them as one having authority, and not as the scribes.
translations.ylt: for he was teaching them as having authority, and not as the scribes.
translations.web: for he taught them with authority, and not like the scribes.

translations.kjv: When he was come down from the mountain, great multitudes followed him.
translations.ylt: And when he came down from the mount, great multitudes did follow him,
translations.web: When he came down from the mountain, great multitudes followed him.

translations.kjv: And, behold, there came a leper and worshipped him, saying, Lord, if thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.
translations.ylt: and lo, a leper having come, was bowing to him, saying, `Sir, if thou art willing, thou art able to cleanse me;'
translations.web: Behold, a leper came to him and worshiped him, saying, “Lord, if you want to, you can make me clean.”

translations.kjv: And Jesus put forth his hand, and touched him, saying, I will; be thou clean. And immediately his leprosy was cleansed.
translations.ylt: and having stretched forth the hand, Jesus touched him, saying, `I will, be thou cleansed,' and immediately his leprosy was cleansed.
translations.web: Jesus stretched out his hand and touched him, saying, “I want to. Be made clean.” Immediately his leprosy was cleansed.

translations.kjv: And Jesus saith unto him, See thou tell no man; but go thy way, shew thyself to the priest, and offer the gift that Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them.
translations.ylt: And Jesus saith to him, `See, thou mayest tell no one, but go, thyself shew to the priest, and bring the gift that Moses commanded for a testimony to them.'
translations.web: Jesus said to him, “See that you tell nobody; but go, show yourself to the priest, and offer the gift that Moses commanded, as a testimony to them.”

translations.kjv: And when Jesus was entered into Capernaum, there came unto him a centurion, beseeching him,
translations.ylt: And Jesus having entered into Capernaum, there came to him a centurion calling upon him,
translations.web: When he came into Capernaum, a centurion came to him, asking him for help,

translations.kjv: And saying, Lord, my servant lieth at home sick of the palsy, grievously tormented.
translations.ylt: and saying, `Sir, my young man hath been laid in the house a paralytic, fearfully afflicted,'
translations.web: saying, “Lord, my servant lies in the house paralyzed, grievously tormented.”

translations.kjv: And Jesus saith unto him, I will come and heal him.
translations.ylt: and Jesus saith to him, `I, having come, will heal him.'
translations.web: Jesus said to him, “I will come and heal him.”

translations.kjv: The centurion answered and said, Lord, I am not worthy that thou shouldest come under my roof: but speak the word only, and my servant shall be healed.
translations.ylt: And the centurion answering said, `Sir, I am not worthy that thou mayest enter under my roof, but only say a word, and my servant shall be healed;
translations.web: The centurion answered, “Lord, I’m not worthy for you to come under my roof. Just say the word, and my servant will be healed.

translations.kjv: For I am a man under authority, having soldiers under me: and I say to this man, Go, and he goeth; and to another, Come, and he cometh; and to my servant, Do this, and he doeth it.
translations.ylt: for I also am a man under authority, having under myself soldiers, and I say to this one, Go, and he goeth, and to another, Be coming, and he cometh, and to my servant, Do this, and he doth it.'
translations.web: For I am also a man under authority, having under myself soldiers. I tell this one, ‘Go,’ and he goes; and tell another, ‘Come,’ and he comes; and tell my servant, ‘Do this,’ and he does it.”

translations.kjv: When Jesus heard it, he marvelled, and said to them that followed, Verily I say unto you, I have not found so great faith, no, not in Israel.
translations.ylt: And Jesus having heard, did wonder, and said to those following, `Verily I say to you, not even in Israel so great faith have I found;
translations.web: When Jesus heard it, he marveled and said to those who followed, “Most certainly I tell you, I haven’t found so great a faith, not even in Israel.

translations.kjv: And I say unto you, That many shall come from the east and west, and shall sit down with Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, in the kingdom of heaven.
translations.ylt: and I say to you, that many from east and west shall come and recline (at meat) with Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, in the reign of the heavens,
translations.web: I tell you that many will come from the east and the west, and will sit down with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob in the Kingdom of Heaven,

translations.kjv: But the children of the kingdom shall be cast out into outer darkness: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
translations.ylt: but the sons of the reign shall be cast forth to the outer darkness--there shall be the weeping and the gnashing of the teeth.'
translations.web: but the children of the Kingdom will be thrown out into the outer darkness. There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.”

translations.kjv: And Jesus said unto the centurion, Go thy way; and as thou hast believed, so be it done unto thee. And his servant was healed in the selfsame hour.
translations.ylt: And Jesus said to the centurion, `Go, and as thou didst believe let it be to thee;' and his young man was healed in that hour.
translations.web: Jesus said to the centurion, “Go your way. Let it be done for you as you have believed.” His servant was healed in that hour.

translations.kjv: And when Jesus was come into Peter’s house, he saw his wife’s mother laid, and sick of a fever.
translations.ylt: And Jesus having come into the house of Peter, saw his mother-in-law laid, and fevered,
translations.web: When Jesus came into Peter’s house, he saw his wife’s mother lying sick with a fever.

translations.kjv: And he touched her hand, and the fever left her: and she arose, and ministered unto them.
translations.ylt: and he touched her hand, and the fever left her, and she arose, and was ministering to them.
translations.web: He touched her hand, and the fever left her. So she got up and served him.

translations.kjv: When the even was come, they brought unto him many that were possessed with devils: and he cast out the spirits with his word, and healed all that were sick:
translations.ylt: And evening having come, they brought to him many demoniacs, and he did cast out the spirits with a word, and did heal all who were ill,
translations.web: When evening came, they brought to him many possessed with demons. He cast out the spirits with a word, and healed all who were sick,

translations.kjv: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet, saying, Himself took our infirmities, and bare our sicknesses.
translations.ylt: that it might be fulfilled that was spoken through Isaiah the prophet, saying, `Himself took our infirmities, and the sicknesses he did bear.'
translations.web: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through Isaiah the prophet, saying, “He took our infirmities and bore our diseases.”

translations.kjv: Now when Jesus saw great multitudes about him, he gave commandment to depart unto the other side.
translations.ylt: And Jesus having seen great multitudes about him, did command to depart to the other side;
translations.web: Now when Jesus saw great multitudes around him, he gave the order to depart to the other side.

translations.kjv: And a certain scribe came, and said unto him, Master, I will follow thee whithersoever thou goest.
translations.ylt: and a certain scribe having come, said to him, `Teacher, I will follow thee wherever thou mayest go;'
translations.web: A scribe came and said to him, “Teacher, I will follow you wherever you go.”

translations.kjv: And Jesus saith unto him, The foxes have holes, and the birds of the air have nests; but the Son of man hath not where to lay his head.
translations.ylt: and Jesus saith to him, `The foxes have holes, and the birds of the heaven places of rest, but the Son of Man hath not where he may lay the head.'
translations.web: Jesus said to him, “The foxes have holes and the birds of the sky have nests, but the Son of Man has nowhere to lay his head.”

translations.kjv: And another of his disciples said unto him, Lord, suffer me first to go and bury my father.
translations.ylt: And another of his disciples said to him, `Sir, permit me first to depart and to bury my father;'
translations.web: Another of his disciples said to him, “Lord, allow me first to go and bury my father.”

translations.kjv: But Jesus said unto him, Follow me; and let the dead bury their dead.
translations.ylt: and Jesus said to him, `Follow me, and suffer the dead to bury their own dead.'
translations.web: But Jesus said to him, “Follow me, and leave the dead to bury their own dead.”

translations.kjv: And when he was entered into a ship, his disciples followed him.
translations.ylt: And when he entered into the boat his disciples did follow him,
translations.web: When he got into a boat, his disciples followed him.

translations.kjv: And, behold, there arose a great tempest in the sea, insomuch that the ship was covered with the waves: but he was asleep.
translations.ylt: and lo, a great tempest arose in the sea, so that the boat was being covered by the waves, but he was sleeping,
translations.web: Behold, a violent storm came up on the sea, so much that the boat was covered with the waves; but he was asleep.

translations.kjv: And his disciples came to him, and awoke him, saying, Lord, save us: we perish.
translations.ylt: and his disciples having come to him, awoke him, saying, `Sir, save us; we are perishing.'
translations.web: The disciples came to him and woke him up, saying, “Save us, Lord! We are dying!”

translations.kjv: And he saith unto them, Why are ye fearful, O ye of little faith? Then he arose, and rebuked the winds and the sea; and there was a great calm.
translations.ylt: And he saith to them, `Why are ye fearful, O ye of little faith?' Then having risen, he rebuked the winds and the sea, and there was a great calm;
translations.web: He said to them, “Why are you fearful, O you of little faith?” Then he got up, rebuked the wind and the sea, and there was a great calm.

translations.kjv: But the men marvelled, saying, What manner of man is this, that even the winds and the sea obey him!
translations.ylt: and the men wondered, saying, `What kind--is this, that even the wind and the sea do obey him?'
translations.web: The men marveled, saying, “What kind of man is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?”

translations.kjv: And when he was come to the other side into the country of the Gergesenes, there met him two possessed with devils, coming out of the tombs, exceeding fierce, so that no man might pass by that way.
translations.ylt: And he having come to the other side, to the region of the Gergesenes, there met him two demoniacs, coming forth out of the tombs, very fierce, so that no one was able to pass over by that way,
translations.web: When he came to the other side, into the country of the Gergesenes, two people possessed by demons met him there, coming out of the tombs, exceedingly fierce, so that nobody could pass that way.

translations.kjv: And, behold, they cried out, saying, What have we to do with thee, Jesus, thou Son of God? art thou come hither to torment us before the time?
translations.ylt: and lo, they cried out, saying, `What--to us and to thee, Jesus, Son of God? didst thou come hither, before the time, to afflict us?'
translations.web: Behold, they cried out, saying, “What do we have to do with you, Jesus, Son of God? Have you come here to torment us before the time?”

translations.kjv: And there was a good way off from them an herd of many swine feeding.
translations.ylt: And there was far off from them a herd of many swine feeding,
translations.web: Now there was a herd of many pigs feeding far away from them.

translations.kjv: So the devils besought him, saying, If thou cast us out, suffer us to go away into the herd of swine.
translations.ylt: and the demons were calling on him, saying, `If thou dost cast us forth, permit us to go away to the herd of the swine;'
translations.web: The demons begged him, saying, “If you cast us out, permit us to go away into the herd of pigs.”

translations.kjv: And he said unto them, Go. And when they were come out, they went into the herd of swine: and, behold, the whole herd of swine ran violently down a steep place into the sea, and perished in the waters.
translations.ylt: and he saith to them, `Go.' And having come forth, they went to the herd of the swine, and lo, the whole herd of the swine rushed down the steep, to the sea, and died in the waters,
translations.web: He said to them, “Go!” They came out and went into the herd of pigs; and behold, the whole herd of pigs rushed down the cliff into the sea and died in the water.

translations.kjv: And they that kept them fled, and went their ways into the city, and told every thing, and what was befallen to the possessed of the devils.
translations.ylt: and those feeding did flee, and, having gone to the city, they declared all, and the matter of the demoniacs.
translations.web: Those who fed them fled and went away into the city and told everything, including what happened to those who were possessed with demons.

translations.kjv: And, behold, the whole city came out to meet Jesus: and when they saw him, they besought him that he would depart out of their coasts.
translations.ylt: And lo, all the city came forth to meet Jesus, and having seen him, they called on him that he might depart from their borders.
translations.web: Behold, all the city came out to meet Jesus. When they saw him, they begged that he would depart from their borders.

translations.kjv: And he entered into a ship, and passed over, and came into his own city.
translations.ylt: And having gone to the boat, he passed over, and came to his own city,
translations.web: He entered into a boat and crossed over, and came into his own city.

translations.kjv: And, behold, they brought to him a man sick of the palsy, lying on a bed: and Jesus seeing their faith said unto the sick of the palsy; Son, be of good cheer; thy sins be forgiven thee.
translations.ylt: and lo, they were bringing to him a paralytic, laid upon a couch, and Jesus having seen their faith, said to the paralytic, `Be of good courage, child, thy sins have been forgiven thee.'
translations.web: Behold, they brought to him a man who was paralyzed, lying on a bed. Jesus, seeing their faith, said to the paralytic, “Son, cheer up! Your sins are forgiven you.”

translations.kjv: And, behold, certain of the scribes said within themselves, This man blasphemeth.
translations.ylt: And lo, certain of the scribes said within themselves, `This one doth speak evil.'
translations.web: Behold, some of the scribes said to themselves, “This man blasphemes.”

translations.kjv: And Jesus knowing their thoughts said, Wherefore think ye evil in your hearts?
translations.ylt: And Jesus, having known their thoughts, said, `Why think ye evil in your hearts?
translations.web: Jesus, knowing their thoughts, said, “Why do you think evil in your hearts?

translations.kjv: For whether is easier, to say, Thy sins be forgiven thee; or to say, Arise, and walk?
translations.ylt: for which is easier? to say, The sins have been forgiven to thee; or to say, Rise, and walk?
translations.web: For which is easier, to say, ‘Your sins are forgiven;’ or to say, ‘Get up, and walk’?

translations.kjv: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power on earth to forgive sins, (then saith he to the sick of the palsy,) Arise, take up thy bed, and go unto thine house.
translations.ylt: `But, that ye may know that the Son of Man hath power upon the earth to forgive sins--(then saith he to the paralytic) --having risen, take up thy couch, and go to thy house.'
translations.web: But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins—” (then he said to the paralytic), “Get up, and take up your mat, and go to your house.”

translations.kjv: And he arose, and departed to his house.
translations.ylt: And he, having risen, went to his house,
translations.web: He arose and departed to his house.

translations.kjv: But when the multitudes saw it, they marvelled, and glorified God, which had given such power unto men.
translations.ylt: and the multitudes having seen, wondered, and glorified God, who did give such power to men.
translations.web: But when the multitudes saw it, they marveled and glorified God, who had given such authority to men.

translations.kjv: And as Jesus passed forth from thence, he saw a man, named Matthew, sitting at the receipt of custom: and he saith unto him, Follow me. And he arose, and followed him.
translations.ylt: And Jesus passing by thence, saw a man sitting at the tax-office, named Matthew, and saith to him, `Be following me,' and he, having risen, did follow him.
translations.web: As Jesus passed by from there, he saw a man called Matthew sitting at the tax collection office. He said to him, “Follow me.” He got up and followed him.

translations.kjv: And it came to pass, as Jesus sat at meat in the house, behold, many publicans and sinners came and sat down with him and his disciples.
translations.ylt: And it came to pass, he reclining (at meat) in the house, that lo, many tax-gatherers and sinners having come, were lying (at meat) with Jesus and his disciples,
translations.web: As he sat in the house, behold, many tax collectors and sinners came and sat down with Jesus and his disciples.

translations.kjv: And when the Pharisees saw it, they said unto his disciples, Why eateth your Master with publicans and sinners?
translations.ylt: and the Pharisees having seen, said to his disciples, `Wherefore with the tax-gatherers and sinners doth your teacher eat?'
translations.web: When the Pharisees saw it, they said to his disciples, “Why does your teacher eat with tax collectors and sinners?”

translations.kjv: But when Jesus heard that, he said unto them, They that be whole need not a physician, but they that are sick.
translations.ylt: And Jesus having heard, said to them, `They who are whole have no need of a physician, but they who are ill;
translations.web: When Jesus heard it, he said to them, “Those who are healthy have no need for a physician, but those who are sick do.

translations.kjv: But go ye and learn what that meaneth, I will have mercy, and not sacrifice: for I am not come to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.
translations.ylt: but having gone, learn ye what is, Kindness I will, and not sacrifice, for I did not come to call righteous men, but sinners, to reformation.'
translations.web: But you go and learn what this means: ‘I desire mercy, and not sacrifice,’ for I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.”

translations.kjv: Then came to him the disciples of John, saying, Why do we and the Pharisees fast oft, but thy disciples fast not?
translations.ylt: Then come to him do the disciples of John, saying, `Wherefore do we and the Pharisees fast much, and thy disciples fast not?'
translations.web: Then John’s disciples came to him, saying, “Why do we and the Pharisees fast often, but your disciples don’t fast?”

translations.kjv: And Jesus said unto them, Can the children of the bridechamber mourn, as long as the bridegroom is with them? but the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken from them, and then shall they fast.
translations.ylt: And Jesus said to them, `Can the sons of the bride-chamber mourn, so long as the bridegroom is with them? but days shall come when the bridegroom may be taken from them, and then they shall fast.
translations.web: Jesus said to them, “Can the friends of the bridegroom mourn as long as the bridegroom is with them? But the days will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them, and then they will fast.

translations.kjv: No man putteth a piece of new cloth unto an old garment, for that which is put in to fill it up taketh from the garment, and the rent is made worse.
translations.ylt: `And no one doth put a patch of undressed cloth on an old garment, for its filling up doth take from the garment, and a worse rent is made.
translations.web: No one puts a piece of unshrunk cloth on an old garment; for the patch would tear away from the garment, and a worse hole is made.

translations.kjv: Neither do men put new wine into old bottles: else the bottles break, and the wine runneth out, and the bottles perish: but they put new wine into new bottles, and both are preserved.
translations.ylt: `Nor do they put new wine into old skins, and if not--the skins burst, and the wine doth run out, and the skins are destroyed, but they put new wine into new skins, and both are preserved together.'
translations.web: Neither do people put new wine into old wineskins, or else the skins would burst, and the wine be spilled, and the skins ruined. No, they put new wine into fresh wineskins, and both are preserved.”

translations.kjv: While he spake these things unto them, behold, there came a certain ruler, and worshipped him, saying, My daughter is even now dead: but come and lay thy hand upon her, and she shall live.
translations.ylt: While he is speaking these things to them, lo, a ruler having come, was bowing to him, saying that `My daughter just now died, but, having come, lay thy hand upon her, and she shall live.'
translations.web: While he told these things to them, behold, a ruler came and worshiped him, saying, “My daughter has just died, but come and lay your hand on her, and she will live.”

translations.kjv: And Jesus arose, and followed him, and so did his disciples.
translations.ylt: And Jesus having risen, did follow him, also his disciples,
translations.web: Jesus got up and followed him, as did his disciples.

translations.kjv: And, behold, a woman, which was diseased with an issue of blood twelve years, came behind him, and touched the hem of his garment:
translations.ylt: and lo, a woman having an issue of blood twelve years, having come to him behind, did touch the fringe of his garments,
translations.web: Behold, a woman who had a discharge of blood for twelve years came behind him, and touched the fringe of his garment;

translations.kjv: For she said within herself, If I may but touch his garment, I shall be whole.
translations.ylt: for she said within herself, `If only I may touch his garment, I shall be saved.'
translations.web: for she said within herself, “If I just touch his garment, I will be made well.”

translations.kjv: But Jesus turned him about, and when he saw her, he said, Daughter, be of good comfort; thy faith hath made thee whole. And the woman was made whole from that hour.
translations.ylt: And Jesus having turned about, and having seen her, said, `Be of good courage, daughter, thy faith hath saved thee,' and the woman was saved from that hour.
translations.web: But Jesus, turning around and seeing her, said, “Daughter, cheer up! Your faith has made you well.” And the woman was made well from that hour.

translations.kjv: And when Jesus came into the ruler’s house, and saw the minstrels and the people making a noise,
translations.ylt: And Jesus having come to the house of the ruler, and having seen the minstrels and the multitude making tumult,
translations.web: When Jesus came into the ruler’s house and saw the flute players and the crowd in noisy disorder,

translations.kjv: He said unto them, Give place: for the maid is not dead, but sleepeth. And they laughed him to scorn.
translations.ylt: he saith to them, `Withdraw, for the damsel did not die, but doth sleep,' and they were deriding him;
translations.web: he said to them, “Make room, because the girl isn’t dead, but sleeping.” They were ridiculing him.

translations.kjv: But when the people were put forth, he went in, and took her by the hand, and the maid arose.
translations.ylt: but, when the multitude was put forth, having gone in, he took hold of her hand, and the damsel arose,
translations.web: But when the crowd was sent out, he entered in, took her by the hand, and the girl arose.

translations.kjv: And the fame hereof went abroad into all that land.
translations.ylt: and the fame of this went forth to all the land.
translations.web: The report of this went out into all that land.

translations.kjv: And when Jesus departed thence, two blind men followed him, crying, and saying, Thou Son of David, have mercy on us.
translations.ylt: And Jesus passing on thence, two blind men followed him, calling and saying, `Deal kindly with us, Son of David.'
translations.web: As Jesus passed by from there, two blind men followed him, calling out and saying, “Have mercy on us, son of David!”

translations.kjv: And when he was come into the house, the blind men came to him: and Jesus saith unto them, Believe ye that I am able to do this? They said unto him, Yea, Lord.
translations.ylt: And he having come to the house, the blind men came to him, and Jesus saith to them, `Believe ye that I am able to do this?' They say to him, `Yes, sir.'
translations.web: When he had come into the house, the blind men came to him. Jesus said to them, “Do you believe that I am able to do this?” They told him, “Yes, Lord.”

translations.kjv: Then touched he their eyes, saying, According to your faith be it unto you.
translations.ylt: Then touched he their eyes, saying, `According to your faith let it be to you,'
translations.web: Then he touched their eyes, saying, “According to your faith be it done to you.”

translations.kjv: And their eyes were opened; and Jesus straitly charged them, saying, See that no man know it.
translations.ylt: and their eyes were opened, and Jesus strictly charged them, saying, `See, let no one know;'
translations.web: Then their eyes were opened. Jesus strictly commanded them, saying, “See that no one knows about this.”

translations.kjv: But they, when they were departed, spread abroad his fame in all that country.
translations.ylt: but they, having gone forth, did spread his fame in all that land.
translations.web: But they went out and spread abroad his fame in all that land.

translations.kjv: As they went out, behold, they brought to him a dumb man possessed with a devil.
translations.ylt: And as they are coming forth, lo, they brought to him a man dumb, a demoniac,
translations.web: As they went out, behold, a mute man who was demon possessed was brought to him.

translations.kjv: And when the devil was cast out, the dumb spake: and the multitudes marvelled, saying, It was never so seen in Israel.
translations.ylt: and the demon having been cast out, the dumb spake, and the multitude did wonder, saying that `It was never so seen in Israel:'
translations.web: When the demon was cast out, the mute man spoke. The multitudes marveled, saying, “Nothing like this has ever been seen in Israel!”

translations.kjv: But the Pharisees said, He casteth out devils through the prince of the devils.
translations.ylt: but the Pharisees said, `By the ruler of the demons he doth cast out the demons.'
translations.web: But the Pharisees said, “By the prince of the demons, he casts out demons.”

translations.kjv: And Jesus went about all the cities and villages, teaching in their synagogues, and preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing every sickness and every disease among the people.
translations.ylt: And Jesus was going up and down all the cities and the villages, teaching in their synagogues, and proclaiming the good news of the reign, and healing every sickness and every malady among the people.
translations.web: Jesus went about all the cities and the villages, teaching in their synagogues and preaching the Good News of the Kingdom, and healing every disease and every sickness among the people.

translations.kjv: But when he saw the multitudes, he was moved with compassion on them, because they fainted, and were scattered abroad, as sheep having no shepherd.
translations.ylt: And having seen the multitudes, he was moved with compassion for them, that they were faint and cast aside, as sheep not having a shepherd,
translations.web: But when he saw the multitudes, he was moved with compassion for them because they were harassed and scattered, like sheep without a shepherd.

translations.kjv: Then saith he unto his disciples, The harvest truly is plenteous, but the labourers are few;
translations.ylt: then saith he to his disciples, `The harvest indeed is abundant, but the workmen few;
translations.web: Then he said to his disciples, “The harvest indeed is plentiful, but the laborers are few.

translations.kjv: Pray ye therefore the Lord of the harvest, that he will send forth labourers into his harvest.
translations.ylt: beseech ye therefore the Lord of the harvest, that he may put forth workmen to His harvest.'
translations.web: Pray therefore that the Lord of the harvest will send out laborers into his harvest.”

translations.kjv: And when he had called unto him his twelve disciples, he gave them power against unclean spirits, to cast them out, and to heal all manner of sickness and all manner of disease.
translations.ylt: And having called to him his twelve disciples, he gave to them power over unclean spirits, so as to be casting them out, and to be healing every sickness, and every malady.
translations.web: He called to himself his twelve disciples, and gave them authority over unclean spirits, to cast them out, and to heal every disease and every sickness.

translations.kjv: Now the names of the twelve apostles are these; The first, Simon, who is called Peter, and Andrew his brother; James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother;
translations.ylt: And of the twelve apostles the names are these: first, Simon, who is called Peter, and Andrew his brother; James of Zebedee, and John his brother;
translations.web: Now the names of the twelve apostles are these. The first, Simon, who is called Peter; Andrew, his brother; James the son of Zebedee; John, his brother;

translations.kjv: Philip, and Bartholomew; Thomas, and Matthew the publican; James the son of Alpheus, and Lebbeus, whose surname was Thaddeus;
translations.ylt: Philip, and Bartholomew; Thomas, and Matthew the tax-gatherer; James of Alpheus, and Lebbeus who was surnamed Thaddeus;
translations.web: Philip; Bartholomew; Thomas; Matthew the tax collector; James the son of Alphaeus; Lebbaeus, who was also called Thaddaeus;

translations.kjv: Simon the Canaanite, and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him.
translations.ylt: Simon the Cananite, and Judas Iscariot, who did also deliver him up.
translations.web: Simon the Zealot; and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him.

translations.kjv: These twelve Jesus sent forth, and commanded them, saying, Go not into the way of the Gentiles, and into any city of the Samaritans enter ye not:
translations.ylt: These twelve did Jesus send forth, having given command to them, saying, `To the way of the nations go not away, and into a city of the Samaritans go not in,
translations.web: Jesus sent these twelve out and commanded them, saying, “Don’t go among the Gentiles, and don’t enter into any city of the Samaritans.

translations.kjv: But go rather to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.
translations.ylt: and be going rather unto the lost sheep of the house of Israel.
translations.web: Rather, go to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.

translations.kjv: And as ye go, preach, saying, The kingdom of heaven is at hand.
translations.ylt: `And, going on, proclaim saying that, the reign of the heavens hath come nigh;
translations.web: As you go, preach, saying, ‘The Kingdom of Heaven is at hand!’

translations.kjv: Heal the sick, cleanse the lepers, raise the dead, cast out devils: freely ye have received, freely give.
translations.ylt: infirm ones be healing, lepers be cleansing, dead be raising, demons be casting out--freely ye did receive, freely give.
translations.web: Heal the sick, cleanse the lepers, and cast out demons. Freely you received, so freely give.

translations.kjv: Provide neither gold, nor silver, nor brass in your purses,
translations.ylt: `Provide not gold, nor silver, nor brass in your girdles,
translations.web: Don’t take any gold, silver, or brass in your money belts.

translations.kjv: Nor scrip for your journey, neither two coats, neither shoes, nor yet staves: for the workman is worthy of his meat.
translations.ylt: nor scrip for the way, nor two coats, nor sandals, nor staff--for the workman is worthy of his nourishment.
translations.web: Take no bag for your journey, neither two coats, nor sandals, nor staff: for the laborer is worthy of his food.

translations.kjv: And into whatsoever city or town ye shall enter, enquire who in it is worthy; and there abide till ye go thence.
translations.ylt: `And into whatever city or village ye may enter, inquire ye who in it is worthy, and there abide, till ye may go forth.
translations.web: Into whatever city or village you enter, find out who in it is worthy, and stay there until you go on.

translations.kjv: And when ye come into an house, salute it.
translations.ylt: And coming to the house salute it,
translations.web: As you enter into the household, greet it.

translations.kjv: And if the house be worthy, let your peace come upon it: but if it be not worthy, let your peace return to you.
translations.ylt: and if indeed the house be worthy, let your peace come upon it; and if it be not worthy, let your peace turn back to you.
translations.web: If the household is worthy, let your peace come on it, but if it isn’t worthy, let your peace return to you.

translations.kjv: And whosoever shall not receive you, nor hear your words, when ye depart out of that house or city, shake off the dust of your feet.
translations.ylt: `And whoever may not receive you nor hear your words, coming forth from that house or city, shake off the dust of your feet,
translations.web: Whoever doesn’t receive you or hear your words, as you go out of that house or that city, shake the dust off your feet.

translations.kjv: Verily I say unto you, It shall be more tolerable for the land of Sodom and Gomorrha in the day of judgment, than for that city.
translations.ylt: verily I say to you, It shall be more tolerable for the land of Sodom and Gomorrah in the day of judgment than for that city.
translations.web: Most certainly I tell you, it will be more tolerable for the land of Sodom and Gomorrah in the day of judgment than for that city.

translations.kjv: Behold, I send you forth as sheep in the midst of wolves: be ye therefore wise as serpents, and harmless as doves.
translations.ylt: `Lo, I do send you forth as sheep in the midst of wolves, be ye therefore wise as the serpents, and simple as the doves.
translations.web: “Behold, I send you out as sheep among wolves. Therefore be wise as serpents and harmless as doves.

translations.kjv: But beware of men: for they will deliver you up to the councils, and they will scourge you in their synagogues;
translations.ylt: And, take ye heed of men, for they will give you up to sanhedrims, and in their synagogues they will scourge you,
translations.web: But beware of men, for they will deliver you up to councils, and in their synagogues they will scourge you.

translations.kjv: And ye shall be brought before governors and kings for my sake, for a testimony against them and the Gentiles.
translations.ylt: and before governors and kings ye shall be brought for my sake, for a testimony to them and to the nations.
translations.web: Yes, and you will be brought before governors and kings for my sake, for a testimony to them and to the nations.

translations.kjv: But when they deliver you up, take no thought how or what ye shall speak: for it shall be given you in that same hour what ye shall speak.
translations.ylt: `And whenever they may deliver you up, be not anxious how or what ye may speak, for it shall be given you in that hour what ye shall speak;
translations.web: But when they deliver you up, don’t be anxious how or what you will say, for it will be given you in that hour what you will say.

translations.kjv: For it is not ye that speak, but the Spirit of your Father which speaketh in you.
translations.ylt: for ye are not the speakers, but the Spirit of your Father that is speaking in you.
translations.web: For it is not you who speak, but the Spirit of your Father who speaks in you.

translations.kjv: And the brother shall deliver up the brother to death, and the father the child: and the children shall rise up against their parents, and cause them to be put to death.
translations.ylt: `And brother shall deliver up brother to death, and father child, and children shall rise up against parents, and shall put them to death,
translations.web: “Brother will deliver up brother to death, and the father his child. Children will rise up against parents and cause them to be put to death.

translations.kjv: And ye shall be hated of all men for my name’s sake: but he that endureth to the end shall be saved.
translations.ylt: and ye shall be hated by all because of my name, but he who hath endured to the end, he shall be saved.
translations.web: You will be hated by all men for my name’s sake, but he who endures to the end will be saved.

translations.kjv: But when they persecute you in this city, flee ye into another: for verily I say unto you, Ye shall not have gone over the cities of Israel, till the Son of man be come.
translations.ylt: `And whenever they may persecute you in this city, flee to the other, for verily I say to you, ye may not have completed the cities of Israel till the Son of Man may come.
translations.web: But when they persecute you in this city, flee into the next, for most certainly I tell you, you will not have gone through the cities of Israel until the Son of Man has come.

translations.kjv: The disciple is not above his master, nor the servant above his lord.
translations.ylt: `A disciple is not above the teacher, nor a servant above his lord;
translations.web: “A disciple is not above his teacher, nor a servant above his lord.

translations.kjv: It is enough for the disciple that he be as his master, and the servant as his lord. If they have called the master of the house Beelzebub, how much more shall they call them of his household?
translations.ylt: sufficient to the disciple that he may be as his teacher, and the servant as his lord; if the master of the house they did call Beelzeboul, how much more those of his household?
translations.web: It is enough for the disciple that he be like his teacher, and the servant like his lord. If they have called the master of the house Beelzebul, how much more those of his household!

translations.kjv: Fear them not therefore: for there is nothing covered, that shall not be revealed; and hid, that shall not be known.
translations.ylt: `Ye may not, therefore, fear them, for there is nothing covered, that shall not be revealed, and hid, that shall not be known;
translations.web: Therefore don’t be afraid of them, for there is nothing covered that will not be revealed, or hidden that will not be known.

translations.kjv: What I tell you in darkness, that speak ye in light: and what ye hear in the ear, that preach ye upon the housetops.
translations.ylt: that which I tell you in the darkness, speak in the light, and that which you hear at the ear, proclaim on the house-tops.
translations.web: What I tell you in the darkness, speak in the light; and what you hear whispered in the ear, proclaim on the housetops.

translations.kjv: And fear not them which kill the body, but are not able to kill the soul: but rather fear him which is able to destroy both soul and body in hell.
translations.ylt: `And be not afraid of those killing the body, and are not able to kill the soul, but fear rather Him who is able both soul and body to destroy in gehenna.
translations.web: Don’t be afraid of those who kill the body, but are not able to kill the soul. Rather, fear him who is able to destroy both soul and body in Gehenna.

translations.kjv: Are not two sparrows sold for a farthing? and one of them shall not fall on the ground without your Father.
translations.ylt: `Are not two sparrows sold for an assar? and one of them shall not fall on the ground without your Father;
translations.web: “Aren’t two sparrows sold for an assarion coin? Not one of them falls to the ground apart from your Father’s will.

translations.kjv: But the very hairs of your head are all numbered.
translations.ylt: and of you--even the hairs of the head are all numbered;
translations.web: But the very hairs of your head are all numbered.

translations.kjv: Fear ye not therefore, ye are of more value than many sparrows.
translations.ylt: be not therefore afraid, than many sparrows ye are better.
translations.web: Therefore don’t be afraid. You are of more value than many sparrows.

translations.kjv: Whosoever therefore shall confess me before men, him will I confess also before my Father which is in heaven.
translations.ylt: `Every one, therefore, who shall confess in me before men, I also will confess in him before my Father who is in the heavens;
translations.web: Everyone therefore who confesses me before men, I will also confess him before my Father who is in heaven.

translations.kjv: But whosoever shall deny me before men, him will I also deny before my Father which is in heaven.
translations.ylt: and whoever shall deny me before men, I also will deny him before my Father who is in the heavens.
translations.web: But whoever denies me before men, I will also deny him before my Father who is in heaven.

translations.kjv: Think not that I am come to send peace on earth: I came not to send peace, but a sword.
translations.ylt: `Ye may not suppose that I came to put peace on the earth; I did not come to put peace, but a sword;
translations.web: “Don’t think that I came to send peace on the earth. I didn’t come to send peace, but a sword.

translations.kjv: For I am come to set a man at variance against his father, and the daughter against her mother, and the daughter in law against her mother in law.
translations.ylt: for I came to set a man at variance against his father, and a daughter against her mother, and a daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law,
translations.web: For I came to set a man at odds against his father, and a daughter against her mother, and a daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law.

translations.kjv: And a man’s foes shall be they of his own household.
translations.ylt: and the enemies of a man are those of his household.
translations.web: A man’s foes will be those of his own household.

translations.kjv: He that loveth father or mother more than me is not worthy of me: and he that loveth son or daughter more than me is not worthy of me.
translations.ylt: `He who is loving father or mother above me, is not worthy of me, and he who is loving son or daughter above me, is not worthy of me,
translations.web: He who loves father or mother more than me is not worthy of me; and he who loves son or daughter more than me isn’t worthy of me.

translations.kjv: And he that taketh not his cross, and followeth after me, is not worthy of me.
translations.ylt: and whoever doth not receive his cross and follow after me, is not worthy of me.
translations.web: He who doesn’t take his cross and follow after me isn’t worthy of me.

translations.kjv: He that findeth his life shall lose it: and he that loseth his life for my sake shall find it.
translations.ylt: `He who found his life shall lose it, and he who lost his life for my sake shall find it.
translations.web: He who seeks his life will lose it; and he who loses his life for my sake will find it.

translations.kjv: He that receiveth you receiveth me, and he that receiveth me receiveth him that sent me.
translations.ylt: `He who is receiving you doth receive me, and he who is receiving me doth receive Him who sent me,
translations.web: “He who receives you receives me, and he who receives me receives him who sent me.

translations.kjv: He that receiveth a prophet in the name of a prophet shall receive a prophet’s reward; and he that receiveth a righteous man in the name of a righteous man shall receive a righteous man’s reward.
translations.ylt: he who is receiving a prophet in the name of a prophet, shall receive a prophet's reward, and he who is receiving a righteous man in the name of a righteous man, shall receive a righteous man's reward,
translations.web: He who receives a prophet in the name of a prophet will receive a prophet’s reward. He who receives a righteous man in the name of a righteous man will receive a righteous man’s reward.

translations.kjv: And whosoever shall give to drink unto one of these little ones a cup of cold water only in the name of a disciple, verily I say unto you, he shall in no wise lose his reward.
translations.ylt: and whoever may give to drink to one of these little ones a cup of cold water only in the name of a disciple, verily I say to you, he may not lose his reward.'
translations.web: Whoever gives one of these little ones just a cup of cold water to drink in the name of a disciple, most certainly I tell you, he will in no way lose his reward.”

translations.kjv: And it came to pass, when Jesus had made an end of commanding his twelve disciples, he departed thence to teach and to preach in their cities.
translations.ylt: And it came to pass, when Jesus ended directing his twelve disciples, he departed thence to teach and to preach in their cities.
translations.web: When Jesus had finished directing his twelve disciples, he departed from there to teach and preach in their cities.

translations.kjv: Now when John had heard in the prison the works of Christ, he sent two of his disciples,
translations.ylt: And John having heard in the prison the works of the Christ, having sent two of his disciples,
translations.web: Now when John heard in the prison the works of Christ, he sent two of his disciples

translations.kjv: And said unto him, Art thou he that should come, or do we look for another?
translations.ylt: said to him, `Art thou He who is coming, or for another do we look?'
translations.web: and said to him, “Are you he who comes, or should we look for another?”

translations.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto them, Go and shew John again those things which ye do hear and see:
translations.ylt: And Jesus answering said to them, `Having gone, declare to John the things that ye hear and see,
translations.web: Jesus answered them, “Go and tell John the things which you hear and see:

translations.kjv: The blind receive their sight, and the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, and the deaf hear, the dead are raised up, and the poor have the gospel preached to them.
translations.ylt: blind receive sight, and lame walk, lepers are cleansed, and deaf hear, dead are raised, and poor have good news proclaimed,
translations.web: the blind receive their sight, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised up, and the poor have good news preached to them.

translations.kjv: And blessed is he, whosoever shall not be offended in me.
translations.ylt: and happy is he who may not be stumbled in me.'
translations.web: Blessed is he who finds no occasion for stumbling in me.”

translations.kjv: And as they departed, Jesus began to say unto the multitudes concerning John, What went ye out into the wilderness to see? A reed shaken with the wind?
translations.ylt: And as they are going, Jesus began to say to the multitudes concerning John, `What went ye out to the wilderness to view? --a reed shaken by the wind?
translations.web: As these went their way, Jesus began to say to the multitudes concerning John, “What did you go out into the wilderness to see? A reed shaken by the wind?

translations.kjv: But what went ye out for to see? A man clothed in soft raiment? behold, they that wear soft clothing are in kings’ houses.
translations.ylt: `But what went ye out to see? --a man clothed in soft garments? lo, those wearing the soft things are in the kings' houses.
translations.web: But what did you go out to see? A man in soft clothing? Behold, those who wear soft clothing are in kings’ houses.

translations.kjv: But what went ye out for to see? A prophet? yea, I say unto you, and more than a prophet.
translations.ylt: `But what went ye out to see? --a prophet? yes, I say to you, and more than a prophet,
translations.web: But why did you go out? To see a prophet? Yes, I tell you, and much more than a prophet.

translations.kjv: For this is he, of whom it is written, Behold, I send my messenger before thy face, which shall prepare thy way before thee.
translations.ylt: for this is he of whom it hath been written, Lo, I do send My messenger before thy face, who shall prepare thy way before thee.
translations.web: For this is he, of whom it is written, ‘Behold, I send my messenger before your face, who will prepare your way before you.’

translations.kjv: Verily I say unto you, Among them that are born of women there hath not risen a greater than John the Baptist: notwithstanding he that is least in the kingdom of heaven is greater than he.
translations.ylt: Verily I say to you, there hath not risen, among those born of women, a greater than John the Baptist, but he who is least in the reign of the heavens is greater than he.
translations.web: Most certainly I tell you, among those who are born of women there has not arisen anyone greater than John the Baptizer; yet he who is least in the Kingdom of Heaven is greater than he.

translations.kjv: And from the days of John the Baptist until now the kingdom of heaven suffereth violence, and the violent take it by force.
translations.ylt: `And, from the days of John the Baptist till now, the reign of the heavens doth suffer violence, and violent men do take it by force,
translations.web: From the days of John the Baptizer until now, the Kingdom of Heaven suffers violence, and the violent take it by force.

translations.kjv: For all the prophets and the law prophesied until John.
translations.ylt: for all the prophets and the law till John did prophesy,
translations.web: For all the prophets and the law prophesied until John.

translations.kjv: And if ye will receive it, this is Elias, which was for to come.
translations.ylt: and if ye are willing to receive it, he is Elijah who was about to come;
translations.web: If you are willing to receive it, this is Elijah, who is to come.

translations.kjv: He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.
translations.ylt: he who is having ears to hear--let him hear.
translations.web: He who has ears to hear, let him hear.

translations.kjv: But whereunto shall I liken this generation? It is like unto children sitting in the markets, and calling unto their fellows,
translations.ylt: `And to what shall I liken this generation? it is like little children in market-places, sitting and calling to their comrades,
translations.web: “But to what shall I compare this generation? It is like children sitting in the marketplaces, who call to their companions

translations.kjv: And saying, We have piped unto you, and ye have not danced; we have mourned unto you, and ye have not lamented.
translations.ylt: and saying, We piped unto you, and ye did not dance, we lamented to you, and ye did not smite the breast.
translations.web: and say, ‘We played the flute for you, and you didn’t dance. We mourned for you, and you didn’t lament.’

translations.kjv: For John came neither eating nor drinking, and they say, He hath a devil.
translations.ylt: `For John came neither eating nor drinking, and they say, He hath a demon;
translations.web: For John came neither eating nor drinking, and they say, ‘He has a demon.’

translations.kjv: The Son of man came eating and drinking, and they say, Behold a man gluttonous, and a winebibber, a friend of publicans and sinners. But wisdom is justified of her children.
translations.ylt: the Son of Man came eating and drinking, and they say, Lo, a man, a glutton, and a wine-drinker, a friend of tax-gatherers and sinners, and wisdom was justified of her children.'
translations.web: The Son of Man came eating and drinking, and they say, ‘Behold, a gluttonous man and a drunkard, a friend of tax collectors and sinners!’ But wisdom is justified by her children.”

translations.kjv: Then began he to upbraid the cities wherein most of his mighty works were done, because they repented not:
translations.ylt: Then began he to reproach the cities in which were done most of his mighty works, because they did not reform.
translations.web: Then he began to denounce the cities in which most of his mighty works had been done, because they didn’t repent.

translations.kjv: Woe unto thee, Chorazin! woe unto thee, Bethsaida! for if the mighty works, which were done in you, had been done in Tyre and Sidon, they would have repented long ago in sackcloth and ashes.
translations.ylt: `Woe to thee, Chorazin! woe to thee, Bethsaida! because, if in Tyre and Sidon had been done the mighty works that were done in you, long ago in sackcloth and ashes they had reformed;
translations.web: “Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the mighty works had been done in Tyre and Sidon which were done in you, they would have repented long ago in sackcloth and ashes.

translations.kjv: But I say unto you, It shall be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon at the day of judgment, than for you.
translations.ylt: but I say to you, to Tyre and Sidon it shall be more tolerable in a day of judgment than for you.
translations.web: But I tell you, it will be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon on the day of judgment than for you.

translations.kjv: And thou, Capernaum, which art exalted unto heaven, shalt be brought down to hell: for if the mighty works, which have been done in thee, had been done in Sodom, it would have remained until this day.
translations.ylt: `And thou, Capernaum, which unto the heaven wast exalted, unto hades shalt be brought down, because if in Sodom had been done the mighty works that were done in thee, it had remained unto this day;
translations.web: You, Capernaum, who are exalted to heaven, you will go down to Hades. For if the mighty works had been done in Sodom which were done in you, it would have remained until today.

translations.kjv: But I say unto you, That it shall be more tolerable for the land of Sodom in the day of judgment, than for thee.
translations.ylt: but I say to you, to the land of Sodom it shall be more tolerable in a day of judgment than to thee.'
translations.web: But I tell you that it will be more tolerable for the land of Sodom on the day of judgment, than for you.”

translations.kjv: At that time Jesus answered and said, I thank thee, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, because thou hast hid these things from the wise and prudent, and hast revealed them unto babes.
translations.ylt: At that time Jesus answering said, `I do confess to Thee, Father, Lord of the heavens and of the earth, that thou didst hide these things from wise and understanding ones, and didst reveal them to babes.
translations.web: At that time, Jesus answered, “I thank you, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that you hid these things from the wise and understanding, and revealed them to infants.

translations.kjv: Even so, Father: for so it seemed good in thy sight.
translations.ylt: Yes, Father, because so it was good pleasure before Thee.
translations.web: Yes, Father, for so it was well-pleasing in your sight.

translations.kjv: All things are delivered unto me of my Father: and no man knoweth the Son, but the Father; neither knoweth any man the Father, save the Son, and he to whomsoever the Son will reveal him.
translations.ylt: `All things were delivered to me by my Father, and none doth know the Son, except the Father, nor doth any know the Father, except the Son, and he to whom the Son may wish to reveal Him.
translations.web: All things have been delivered to me by my Father. No one knows the Son, except the Father; neither does anyone know the Father, except the Son and he to whom the Son desires to reveal him.

translations.kjv: Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.
translations.ylt: `Come unto me, all ye labouring and burdened ones, and I will give you rest,
translations.web: “Come to me, all you who labor and are heavily burdened, and I will give you rest.

translations.kjv: Take my yoke upon you, and learn of me; for I am meek and lowly in heart: and ye shall find rest unto your souls.
translations.ylt: take up my yoke upon you, and learn from me, because I am meek and humble in heart, and ye shall find rest to your souls,
translations.web: Take my yoke upon you and learn from me, for I am gentle and humble in heart; and you will find rest for your souls.

translations.kjv: For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.
translations.ylt: for my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.'
translations.web: For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.”

translations.kjv: At that time Jesus went on the sabbath day through the corn; and his disciples were an hungred, and began to pluck the ears of corn, and to eat.
translations.ylt: At that time did Jesus go on the sabbaths through the corn, and his disciples were hungry, and they began to pluck ears, and to eat,
translations.web: At that time, Jesus went on the Sabbath day through the grain fields. His disciples were hungry and began to pluck heads of grain and to eat.

translations.kjv: But when the Pharisees saw it, they said unto him, Behold, thy disciples do that which is not lawful to do upon the sabbath day.
translations.ylt: and the Pharisees having seen, said to him, `Lo, thy disciples do that which it is not lawful to do on a sabbath.'
translations.web: But the Pharisees, when they saw it, said to him, “Behold, your disciples do what is not lawful to do on the Sabbath.”

translations.kjv: But he said unto them, Have ye not read what David did, when he was an hungred, and they that were with him;
translations.ylt: And he said to them, `Did ye not read what David did, when he was hungry, himself and those with him--
translations.web: But he said to them, “Haven’t you read what David did when he was hungry, and those who were with him:

translations.kjv: How he entered into the house of God, and did eat the shewbread, which was not lawful for him to eat, neither for them which were with him, but only for the priests?
translations.ylt: how he went into the house of God, and the loaves of the presentation did eat, which it is not lawful to him to eat, nor to those with him, except to the priests alone?
translations.web: how he entered into God’s house and ate the show bread, which was not lawful for him to eat, nor for those who were with him, but only for the priests?

translations.kjv: Or have ye not read in the law, how that on the sabbath days the priests in the temple profane the sabbath, and are blameless?
translations.ylt: `Or did ye not read in the Law, that on the sabbaths the priests in the temple do profane the sabbath, and are blameless?
translations.web: Or have you not read in the law that on the Sabbath day the priests in the temple profane the Sabbath and are guiltless?

translations.kjv: But I say unto you, That in this place is one greater than the temple.
translations.ylt: and I say to you, that a greater than the temple is here;
translations.web: But I tell you that one greater than the temple is here.

translations.kjv: But if ye had known what this meaneth, I will have mercy, and not sacrifice, ye would not have condemned the guiltless.
translations.ylt: and if ye had known what is: Kindness I will, and not sacrifice--ye had not condemned the blameless,
translations.web: But if you had known what this means, ‘I desire mercy, and not sacrifice,’ you wouldn’t have condemned the guiltless.

translations.kjv: For the Son of man is Lord even of the sabbath day.
translations.ylt: for the son of man is lord even of the sabbath.'
translations.web: For the Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath.”

translations.kjv: And when he was departed thence, he went into their synagogue:
translations.ylt: And having departed thence, he went to their synagogue,
translations.web: He departed from there and went into their synagogue.

translations.kjv: And, behold, there was a man which had his hand withered. And they asked him, saying, Is it lawful to heal on the sabbath days? that they might accuse him.
translations.ylt: and lo, there was a man having the hand withered, and they questioned him, saying, `Is it lawful to heal on the sabbaths?' that they might accuse him.
translations.web: And behold, there was a man with a withered hand. They asked him, “Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath day?” so that they might accuse him.

translations.kjv: And he said unto them, What man shall there be among you, that shall have one sheep, and if it fall into a pit on the sabbath day, will he not lay hold on it, and lift it out?
translations.ylt: And he said to them, `What man shall be of you, who shall have one sheep, and if this may fall on the sabbaths into a ditch, will not lay hold on it and raise it?
translations.web: He said to them, “What man is there among you who has one sheep, and if this one falls into a pit on the Sabbath day, won’t he grab on to it and lift it out?

translations.kjv: How much then is a man better than a sheep? Wherefore it is lawful to do well on the sabbath days.
translations.ylt: How much better, therefore, is a man than a sheep? --so that it is lawful on the sabbaths to do good.'
translations.web: Of how much more value then is a man than a sheep! Therefore it is lawful to do good on the Sabbath day.”

translations.kjv: Then saith he to the man, Stretch forth thine hand. And he stretched it forth; and it was restored whole, like as the other.
translations.ylt: Then saith he to the man, `Stretch forth thy hand,' and he stretched it forth, and it was restored whole as the other.
translations.web: Then he told the man, “Stretch out your hand.” He stretched it out; and it was restored whole, just like the other.

translations.kjv: Then the Pharisees went out, and held a council against him, how they might destroy him.
translations.ylt: And the Pharisees having gone forth, held a consultation against him, how they might destroy him,
translations.web: But the Pharisees went out and conspired against him, how they might destroy him.

translations.kjv: But when Jesus knew it, he withdrew himself from thence: and great multitudes followed him, and he healed them all;
translations.ylt: and Jesus having known, withdrew thence, and there followed him great multitudes, and he healed them all,
translations.web: Jesus, perceiving that, withdrew from there. Great multitudes followed him; and he healed them all,

translations.kjv: And charged them that they should not make him known:
translations.ylt: and did charge them that they might not make him manifest,
translations.web: and commanded them that they should not make him known,

translations.kjv: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet, saying,
translations.ylt: that it might be fulfilled that was spoken through Isaiah the prophet, saying,
translations.web: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through Isaiah the prophet, saying,

translations.kjv: Behold my servant, whom I have chosen; my beloved, in whom my soul is well pleased: I will put my spirit upon him, and he shall shew judgment to the Gentiles.
translations.ylt: `Lo, My servant, whom I did choose, My beloved, in whom My soul did delight, I will put My Spirit upon him, and judgment to the nations he shall declare,
translations.web: “Behold, my servant whom I have chosen, my beloved in whom my soul is well pleased. I will put my Spirit on him. He will proclaim justice to the nations.

translations.kjv: He shall not strive, nor cry; neither shall any man hear his voice in the streets.
translations.ylt: he shall not strive nor cry, nor shall any hear in the broad places his voice,
translations.web: He will not strive, nor shout, neither will anyone hear his voice in the streets.

translations.kjv: A bruised reed shall he not break, and smoking flax shall he not quench, till he send forth judgment unto victory.
translations.ylt: a bruised reed he shall not break, and smoking flax he shall not quench, till he may put forth judgment to victory,
translations.web: He won’t break a bruised reed. He won’t quench a smoking flax, until he leads justice to victory.

translations.kjv: And in his name shall the Gentiles trust.
translations.ylt: and in his name shall nations hope.'
translations.web: In his name, the nations will hope.”

translations.kjv: Then was brought unto him one possessed with a devil, blind, and dumb: and he healed him, insomuch that the blind and dumb both spake and saw.
translations.ylt: Then was brought to him a demoniac, blind and dumb, and he healed him, so that the blind and dumb both spake and saw.
translations.web: Then one possessed by a demon, blind and mute, was brought to him; and he healed him, so that the blind and mute man both spoke and saw.

translations.kjv: And all the people were amazed, and said, Is not this the son of David?
translations.ylt: And all the multitudes were amazed, and said, `Is this the Son of David?'
translations.web: All the multitudes were amazed, and said, “Can this be the son of David?”

translations.kjv: But when the Pharisees heard it, they said, This fellow doth not cast out devils, but by Beelzebub the prince of the devils.
translations.ylt: but the Pharisees having heard, said, `This one doth not cast out demons, except by Beelzeboul, ruler of the demons.'
translations.web: But when the Pharisees heard it, they said, “This man does not cast out demons except by Beelzebul, the prince of the demons.”

translations.kjv: And Jesus knew their thoughts, and said unto them, Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation; and every city or house divided against itself shall not stand:
translations.ylt: And Jesus, knowing their thoughts, said to them, `Every kingdom having been divided against itself is desolated, and no city or house having been divided against itself, doth stand,
translations.web: Knowing their thoughts, Jesus said to them, “Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation, and every city or house divided against itself will not stand.

translations.kjv: And if Satan cast out Satan, he is divided against himself; how shall then his kingdom stand?
translations.ylt: and if the Adversary doth cast out the Adversary, against himself he was divided, how then doth his kingdom stand?
translations.web: If Satan casts out Satan, he is divided against himself. How then will his kingdom stand?

translations.kjv: And if I by Beelzebub cast out devils, by whom do your children cast them out? therefore they shall be your judges.
translations.ylt: `And if I, by Beelzeboul, do cast out the demons, your sons--by whom do they cast out? because of this they--they shall be your judges.
translations.web: If I by Beelzebul cast out demons, by whom do your children cast them out? Therefore they will be your judges.

translations.kjv: But if I cast out devils by the Spirit of God, then the kingdom of God is come unto you.
translations.ylt: `But if I, by the Spirit of God, do cast out the demons, then come already unto you did the reign of God.
translations.web: But if I by the Spirit of God cast out demons, then God’s Kingdom has come upon you.

translations.kjv: Or else how can one enter into a strong man’s house, and spoil his goods, except he first bind the strong man? and then he will spoil his house.
translations.ylt: `Or how is one able to go into the house of the strong man, and to plunder his goods, if first he may not bind the strong man? and then his house he will plunder.
translations.web: Or how can one enter into the house of the strong man and plunder his goods, unless he first bind the strong man? Then he will plunder his house.

translations.kjv: He that is not with me is against me; and he that gathereth not with me scattereth abroad.
translations.ylt: `He who is not with me is against me, and he who is not gathering with me, doth scatter.
translations.web: “He who is not with me is against me, and he who doesn’t gather with me, scatters.

translations.kjv: Wherefore I say unto you, All manner of sin and blasphemy shall be forgiven unto men: but the blasphemy against the Holy Ghost shall not be forgiven unto men.
translations.ylt: Because of this I say to you, all sin and evil speaking shall be forgiven to men, but the evil speaking of the Spirit shall not be forgiven to men.
translations.web: Therefore I tell you, every sin and blasphemy will be forgiven men, but the blasphemy against the Spirit will not be forgiven men.

translations.kjv: And whosoever speaketh a word against the Son of man, it shall be forgiven him: but whosoever speaketh against the Holy Ghost, it shall not be forgiven him, neither in this world, neither in the world to come.
translations.ylt: And whoever may speak a word against the Son of Man it shall be forgiven to him, but whoever may speak against the Holy Spirit, it shall not be forgiven him, neither in this age, nor in that which is coming.
translations.web: Whoever speaks a word against the Son of Man, it will be forgiven him; but whoever speaks against the Holy Spirit, it will not be forgiven him, either in this age, or in that which is to come.

translations.kjv: Either make the tree good, and his fruit good; or else make the tree corrupt, and his fruit corrupt: for the tree is known by his fruit.
translations.ylt: `Either make the tree good, and its fruit good, or make the tree bad, and its fruit bad, for from the fruit is the tree known.
translations.web: “Either make the tree good and its fruit good, or make the tree corrupt and its fruit corrupt; for the tree is known by its fruit.

translations.kjv: O generation of vipers, how can ye, being evil, speak good things? for out of the abundance of the heart the mouth speaketh.
translations.ylt: `Brood of vipers! how are ye able to speak good things--being evil? for out of the abundance of the heart doth the mouth speak.
translations.web: You offspring of vipers, how can you, being evil, speak good things? For out of the abundance of the heart, the mouth speaks.

translations.kjv: A good man out of the good treasure of the heart bringeth forth good things: and an evil man out of the evil treasure bringeth forth evil things.
translations.ylt: The good man out of the good treasure of the heart doth put forth the good things, and the evil man out of the evil treasure doth put forth evil things.
translations.web: The good man out of his good treasure brings out good things, and the evil man out of his evil treasure brings out evil things.

translations.kjv: But I say unto you, That every idle word that men shall speak, they shall give account thereof in the day of judgment.
translations.ylt: `And I say to you, that every idle word that men may speak, they shall give for it a reckoning in a day of judgment;
translations.web: I tell you that every idle word that men speak, they will give account of it in the day of judgment.

translations.kjv: For by thy words thou shalt be justified, and by thy words thou shalt be condemned.
translations.ylt: for from thy words thou shalt be declared righteous, and from thy words thou shalt be declared unrighteous.'
translations.web: For by your words you will be justified, and by your words you will be condemned.”

translations.kjv: Then certain of the scribes and of the Pharisees answered, saying, Master, we would see a sign from thee.
translations.ylt: Then answered certain of the scribes and Pharisees, saying, `Teacher, we will to see a sign from thee.'
translations.web: Then certain of the scribes and Pharisees answered, “Teacher, we want to see a sign from you.”

translations.kjv: But he answered and said unto them, An evil and adulterous generation seeketh after a sign; and there shall no sign be given to it, but the sign of the prophet Jonas:
translations.ylt: And he answering said to them, `A generation, evil and adulterous, doth seek a sign, and a sign shall not be given to it, except the sign of Jonah the prophet;
translations.web: But he answered them, “An evil and adulterous generation seeks after a sign, but no sign will be given to it but the sign of Jonah the prophet.

translations.kjv: For as Jonas was three days and three nights in the whale’s belly; so shall the Son of man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.
translations.ylt: for, as Jonah was in the belly of the fish three days and three nights, so shall the Son of Man be in the heart of the earth three days and three nights.
translations.web: For as Jonah was three days and three nights in the belly of the huge fish, so will the Son of Man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.

translations.kjv: The men of Nineveh shall rise in judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: because they repented at the preaching of Jonas; and, behold, a greater than Jonas is here.
translations.ylt: `Men of Nineveh shall stand up in the judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it, for they reformed at the proclamation of Jonah, and lo, a greater than Jonah here!
translations.web: The men of Nineveh will stand up in the judgment with this generation and will condemn it, for they repented at the preaching of Jonah; and behold, someone greater than Jonah is here.

translations.kjv: The queen of the south shall rise up in the judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: for she came from the uttermost parts of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and, behold, a greater than Solomon is here.
translations.ylt: `A queen of the south shall rise up in the judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it, for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon, and lo, a greater than Solomon here!
translations.web: The Queen of the South will rise up in the judgment with this generation and will condemn it, for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and behold, someone greater than Solomon is here.

translations.kjv: When the unclean spirit is gone out of a man, he walketh through dry places, seeking rest, and findeth none.
translations.ylt: `And, when the unclean spirit may go forth from the man, it doth walk through dry places seeking rest, and doth not find;
translations.web: “When an unclean spirit has gone out of a man, he passes through waterless places seeking rest, and doesn’t find it.

translations.kjv: Then he saith, I will return into my house from whence I came out; and when he is come, he findeth it empty, swept, and garnished.
translations.ylt: then it saith, I will turn back to my house whence I came forth; and having come, it findeth it unoccupied, swept, and adorned:
translations.web: Then he says, ‘I will return into my house from which I came;’ and when he has come back, he finds it empty, swept, and put in order.

translations.kjv: Then goeth he, and taketh with himself seven other spirits more wicked than himself, and they enter in and dwell there: and the last state of that man is worse than the first. Even so shall it be also unto this wicked generation.
translations.ylt: then doth it go, and take with itself seven other spirits more evil than itself, and having gone in they dwell there, and the last of that man doth become worse than the first; so shall it be also to this evil generation.'
translations.web: Then he goes and takes with himself seven other spirits more evil than he is, and they enter in and dwell there. The last state of that man becomes worse than the first. Even so will it be also to this evil generation.”

translations.kjv: While he yet talked to the people, behold, his mother and his brethren stood without, desiring to speak with him.
translations.ylt: And while he was yet speaking to the multitudes, lo, his mother and brethren had stood without, seeking to speak to him,
translations.web: While he was yet speaking to the multitudes, behold, his mother and his brothers stood outside, seeking to speak to him.

translations.kjv: Then one said unto him, Behold, thy mother and thy brethren stand without, desiring to speak with thee.
translations.ylt: and one said to him, `Lo, thy mother and thy brethren do stand without, seeking to speak to thee.'
translations.web: One said to him, “Behold, your mother and your brothers stand outside, seeking to speak to you.”

translations.kjv: But he answered and said unto him that told him, Who is my mother? and who are my brethren?
translations.ylt: And he answering said to him who spake to him, `Who is my mother? and who are my brethren?'
translations.web: But he answered him who spoke to him, “Who is my mother? Who are my brothers?”

translations.kjv: And he stretched forth his hand toward his disciples, and said, Behold my mother and my brethren!
