translations.ylt: And having stretched forth his hand toward his disciples, he said, `Lo, my mother and my brethren!
translations.web: He stretched out his hand toward his disciples, and said, “Behold, my mother and my brothers!

translations.kjv: For whosoever shall do the will of my Father which is in heaven, the same is my brother, and sister, and mother.
translations.ylt: for whoever may do the will of my Father who is in the heavens, he is my brother, and sister, and mother.'
translations.web: For whoever does the will of my Father who is in heaven, he is my brother, and sister, and mother.”

translations.kjv: The same day went Jesus out of the house, and sat by the sea side.
translations.ylt: And in that day Jesus, having gone forth from the house, was sitting by the sea,
translations.web: On that day Jesus went out of the house and sat by the seaside.

translations.kjv: And great multitudes were gathered together unto him, so that he went into a ship, and sat; and the whole multitude stood on the shore.
translations.ylt: and gathered together unto him were many multitudes, so that he having gone into the boat did sit down, and all the multitude on the beach did stand,
translations.web: Great multitudes gathered to him, so that he entered into a boat and sat; and all the multitude stood on the beach.

translations.kjv: And he spake many things unto them in parables, saying, Behold, a sower went forth to sow;
translations.ylt: and he spake to them many things in similes, saying: `Lo, the sower went forth to sow,
translations.web: He spoke to them many things in parables, saying, “Behold, a farmer went out to sow.

translations.kjv: And when he sowed, some seeds fell by the way side, and the fowls came and devoured them up:
translations.ylt: and in his sowing, some indeed fell by the way, and the fowls did come and devour them,
translations.web: As he sowed, some seeds fell by the roadside, and the birds came and devoured them.

translations.kjv: Some fell upon stony places, where they had not much earth: and forthwith they sprung up, because they had no deepness of earth:
translations.ylt: and others fell upon the rocky places, where they had not much earth, and immediately they sprang forth, through not having depth of earth,
translations.web: Others fell on rocky ground, where they didn’t have much soil, and immediately they sprang up, because they had no depth of earth.

translations.kjv: And when the sun was up, they were scorched; and because they had no root, they withered away.
translations.ylt: and the sun having risen they were scorched, and through not having root, they withered,
translations.web: When the sun had risen, they were scorched. Because they had no root, they withered away.

translations.kjv: And some fell among thorns; and the thorns sprung up, and choked them:
translations.ylt: and others fell upon the thorns, and the thorns did come up and choke them,
translations.web: Others fell among thorns. The thorns grew up and choked them.

translations.kjv: But other fell into good ground, and brought forth fruit, some an hundredfold, some sixtyfold, some thirtyfold.
translations.ylt: and others fell upon the good ground, and were giving fruit, some indeed a hundredfold, and some sixty, and some thirty.
translations.web: Others fell on good soil and yielded fruit: some one hundred times as much, some sixty, and some thirty.

translations.kjv: Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.
translations.ylt: He who is having ears to hear--let him hear.'
translations.web: He who has ears to hear, let him hear.”

translations.kjv: And the disciples came, and said unto him, Why speakest thou unto them in parables?
translations.ylt: And the disciples having come near, said to him, `Wherefore in similes dost thou speak to them?'
translations.web: The disciples came, and said to him, “Why do you speak to them in parables?”

translations.kjv: He answered and said unto them, Because it is given unto you to know the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven, but to them it is not given.
translations.ylt: And he answering said to them that--`To you it hath been given to know the secrets of the reign of the heavens, and to these it hath not been given,
translations.web: He answered them, “To you it is given to know the mysteries of the Kingdom of Heaven, but it is not given to them.

translations.kjv: For whosoever hath, to him shall be given, and he shall have more abundance: but whosoever hath not, from him shall be taken away even that he hath.
translations.ylt: for whoever hath, it shall be given to him, and he shall have overabundance, and whoever hath not, even that which he hath shall be taken from him.
translations.web: For whoever has, to him will be given, and he will have abundance; but whoever doesn’t have, from him will be taken away even that which he has.

translations.kjv: Therefore speak I to them in parables: because they seeing see not; and hearing they hear not, neither do they understand.
translations.ylt: `Because of this, in similes do I speak to them, because seeing they do not see, and hearing they do not hear, nor understand,
translations.web: Therefore I speak to them in parables, because seeing they don’t see, and hearing, they don’t hear, neither do they understand.

translations.kjv: And in them is fulfilled the prophecy of Esaias, which saith, By hearing ye shall hear, and shall not understand; and seeing ye shall see, and shall not perceive:
translations.ylt: and fulfilled on them is the prophecy of Isaiah, that saith, With hearing ye shall hear, and ye shall not understand, and seeing ye shall see, and ye shall not perceive,
translations.web: In them the prophecy of Isaiah is fulfilled, which says, ‘By hearing you will hear, and will in no way understand; Seeing you will see, and will in no way perceive;

translations.kjv: For this people’s heart is waxed gross, and their ears are dull of hearing, and their eyes they have closed; lest at any time they should see with their eyes, and hear with their ears, and should understand with their heart, and should be converted, and I should heal them.
translations.ylt: for made gross was the heart of this people, and with the ears they heard heavily, and their eyes they did close, lest they might see with the eyes, and with the ears might hear, and with the heart understand, and turn back, and I might heal them.
translations.web: for this people’s heart has grown callous, their ears are dull of hearing, and they have closed their eyes; or else perhaps they might perceive with their eyes, hear with their ears, understand with their heart, and would turn again, and I would heal them.’

translations.kjv: But blessed are your eyes, for they see: and your ears, for they hear.
translations.ylt: `And happy are your eyes because they see, and your ears because they hear,
translations.web: “But blessed are your eyes, for they see; and your ears, for they hear.

translations.kjv: For verily I say unto you, That many prophets and righteous men have desired to see those things which ye see, and have not seen them; and to hear those things which ye hear, and have not heard them.
translations.ylt: for verily I say to you, that many prophets and righteous men did desire to see that which ye look on, and they did not see, and to hear that which ye hear, and they did not hear.
translations.web: For most certainly I tell you that many prophets and righteous men desired to see the things which you see, and didn’t see them; and to hear the things which you hear, and didn’t hear them.

translations.kjv: Hear ye therefore the parable of the sower.
translations.ylt: `Ye, therefore, hear ye the simile of the sower:
translations.web: “Hear, then, the parable of the farmer.

translations.kjv: When any one heareth the word of the kingdom, and understandeth it not, then cometh the wicked one, and catcheth away that which was sown in his heart. This is he which received seed by the way side.
translations.ylt: Every one hearing the word of the reign, and not understanding--the evil one doth come, and doth catch that which hath been sown in his heart; this is that sown by the way.
translations.web: When anyone hears the word of the Kingdom and doesn’t understand it, the evil one comes and snatches away that which has been sown in his heart. This is what was sown by the roadside.

translations.kjv: But he that received the seed into stony places, the same is he that heareth the word, and anon with joy receiveth it;
translations.ylt: `And that sown on the rocky places, this is he who is hearing the word, and immediately with joy is receiving it,
translations.web: What was sown on the rocky places, this is he who hears the word and immediately with joy receives it;

translations.kjv: Yet hath he not root in himself, but dureth for a while: for when tribulation or persecution ariseth because of the word, by and by he is offended.
translations.ylt: and he hath not root in himself, but is temporary, and persecution or tribulation having happened because of the word, immediately he is stumbled.
translations.web: yet he has no root in himself, but endures for a while. When oppression or persecution arises because of the word, immediately he stumbles.

translations.kjv: He also that received seed among the thorns is he that heareth the word; and the care of this world, and the deceitfulness of riches, choke the word, and he becometh unfruitful.
translations.ylt: `And that sown toward the thorns, this is he who is hearing the word, and the anxiety of this age, and the deceitfulness of the riches, do choke the word, and it becometh unfruitful.
translations.web: What was sown among the thorns, this is he who hears the word, but the cares of this age and the deceitfulness of riches choke the word, and he becomes unfruitful.

translations.kjv: But he that received seed into the good ground is he that heareth the word, and understandeth it; which also beareth fruit, and bringeth forth, some an hundredfold, some sixty, some thirty.
translations.ylt: `And that sown on the good ground: this is he who is hearing the word, and is understanding, who indeed doth bear fruit, and doth make, some indeed a hundredfold, and some sixty, and some thirty.'
translations.web: What was sown on the good ground, this is he who hears the word and understands it, who most certainly bears fruit and produces, some one hundred times as much, some sixty, and some thirty.”

translations.kjv: Another parable put he forth unto them, saying, The kingdom of heaven is likened unto a man which sowed good seed in his field:
translations.ylt: Another simile he set before them, saying: `The reign of the heavens was likened to a man sowing good seed in his field,
translations.web: He set another parable before them, saying, “The Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who sowed good seed in his field,

translations.kjv: But while men slept, his enemy came and sowed tares among the wheat, and went his way.
translations.ylt: and, while men are sleeping, his enemy came and sowed darnel in the midst of the wheat, and went away,
translations.web: but while people slept, his enemy came and sowed darnel weeds also among the wheat, and went away.

translations.kjv: But when the blade was sprung up, and brought forth fruit, then appeared the tares also.
translations.ylt: and when the herb sprang up, and yielded fruit, then appeared also the darnel.
translations.web: But when the blade sprang up and produced grain, then the darnel weeds appeared also.

translations.kjv: So the servants of the householder came and said unto him, Sir, didst not thou sow good seed in thy field? from whence then hath it tares?
translations.ylt: `And the servants of the householder, having come near, said to him, Sir, good seed didst thou not sow in thy field? whence then hath it the darnel?
translations.web: The servants of the householder came and said to him, ‘Sir, didn’t you sow good seed in your field? Where did these darnel weeds come from?’

translations.kjv: He said unto them, An enemy hath done this. The servants said unto him, Wilt thou then that we go and gather them up?
translations.ylt: And he saith to them, A man, an enemy, did this; and the servants said to him, Wilt thou, then, that having gone away we may gather it up?
translations.web: “He said to them, ‘An enemy has done this.’ “The servants asked him, ‘Do you want us to go and gather them up?’

translations.kjv: But he said, Nay; lest while ye gather up the tares, ye root up also the wheat with them.
translations.ylt: `And he said, No, lest--gathering up the darnel--ye root up with it the wheat,
translations.web: “But he said, ‘No, lest perhaps while you gather up the darnel weeds, you root up the wheat with them.

translations.kjv: Let both grow together until the harvest: and in the time of harvest I will say to the reapers, Gather ye together first the tares, and bind them in bundles to burn them: but gather the wheat into my barn.
translations.ylt: suffer both to grow together till the harvest, and in the time of the harvest I will say to the reapers, Gather up first the darnel, and bind it in bundles, to burn it, and the wheat gather up into my storehouse.'
translations.web: Let both grow together until the harvest, and in the harvest time I will tell the reapers, “First, gather up the darnel weeds, and bind them in bundles to burn them; but gather the wheat into my barn.”’”

translations.kjv: Another parable put he forth unto them, saying, The kingdom of heaven is like to a grain of mustard seed, which a man took, and sowed in his field:
translations.ylt: Another simile he set before them, saying: `The reign of the heavens is like to a grain of mustard, which a man having taken, did sow in his field,
translations.web: He set another parable before them, saying, “The Kingdom of Heaven is like a grain of mustard seed which a man took, and sowed in his field,

translations.kjv: Which indeed is the least of all seeds: but when it is grown, it is the greatest among herbs, and becometh a tree, so that the birds of the air come and lodge in the branches thereof.
translations.ylt: which less, indeed, is than all the seeds, but when it may be grown, is greatest of the herbs, and becometh a tree, so that the birds of the heaven do come and rest in its branches.'
translations.web: which indeed is smaller than all seeds. But when it is grown, it is greater than the herbs and becomes a tree, so that the birds of the air come and lodge in its branches.”

translations.kjv: Another parable spake he unto them; The kingdom of heaven is like unto leaven, which a woman took, and hid in three measures of meal, till the whole was leavened.
translations.ylt: Another simile spake he to them: `The reign of the heavens is like to leaven, which a woman having taken, hid in three measures of meal, till the whole was leavened.'
translations.web: He spoke another parable to them. “The Kingdom of Heaven is like yeast which a woman took and hid in three measures of meal, until it was all leavened.”

translations.kjv: All these things spake Jesus unto the multitude in parables; and without a parable spake he not unto them:
translations.ylt: All these things spake Jesus in similes to the multitudes, and without a simile he was not speaking to them,
translations.web: Jesus spoke all these things in parables to the multitudes; and without a parable, he didn’t speak to them,

translations.kjv: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, saying, I will open my mouth in parables; I will utter things which have been kept secret from the foundation of the world.
translations.ylt: that it might be fulfilled that was spoken through the prophet, saying, `I will open in similes my mouth, I will utter things having been hidden from the foundation of the world.'
translations.web: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through the prophet, saying, “I will open my mouth in parables; I will utter things hidden from the foundation of the world.”

translations.kjv: Then Jesus sent the multitude away, and went into the house: and his disciples came unto him, saying, Declare unto us the parable of the tares of the field.
translations.ylt: Then having let away the multitudes, Jesus came to the house, and his disciples came near to him, saying, `Explain to us the simile of the darnel of the field.'
translations.web: Then Jesus sent the multitudes away, and went into the house. His disciples came to him, saying, “Explain to us the parable of the darnel weeds of the field.”

translations.kjv: He answered and said unto them, He that soweth the good seed is the Son of man;
translations.ylt: And he answering said to them, `He who is sowing the good seed is the Son of Man,
translations.web: He answered them, “He who sows the good seed is the Son of Man,

translations.kjv: The field is the world; the good seed are the children of the kingdom; but the tares are the children of the wicked one;
translations.ylt: and the field is the world, and the good seed, these are the sons of the reign, and the darnel are the sons of the evil one,
translations.web: the field is the world, the good seeds are the children of the Kingdom, and the darnel weeds are the children of the evil one.

translations.kjv: The enemy that sowed them is the devil; the harvest is the end of the world; and the reapers are the angels.
translations.ylt: and the enemy who sowed them is the devil, and the harvest is a full end of the age, and the reapers are messengers.
translations.web: The enemy who sowed them is the devil. The harvest is the end of the age, and the reapers are angels.

translations.kjv: As therefore the tares are gathered and burned in the fire; so shall it be in the end of this world.
translations.ylt: `As, then, the darnel is gathered up, and is burned with fire, so shall it be in the full end of this age,
translations.web: As therefore the darnel weeds are gathered up and burned with fire; so will it be at the end of this age.

translations.kjv: The Son of man shall send forth his angels, and they shall gather out of his kingdom all things that offend, and them which do iniquity;
translations.ylt: the Son of Man shall send forth his messengers, and they shall gather up out of his kingdom all the stumbling-blocks, and those doing the unlawlessness,
translations.web: The Son of Man will send out his angels, and they will gather out of his Kingdom all things that cause stumbling and those who do iniquity,

translations.kjv: And shall cast them into a furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.
translations.ylt: and shall cast them to the furnace of the fire; there shall be the weeping and the gnashing of the teeth.
translations.web: and will cast them into the furnace of fire. There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

translations.kjv: Then shall the righteous shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their Father. Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.
translations.ylt: `Then shall the righteous shine forth as the sun in the reign of their Father. He who is having ears to hear--let him hear.
translations.web: Then the righteous will shine like the sun in the Kingdom of their Father. He who has ears to hear, let him hear.

translations.kjv: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto treasure hid in a field; the which when a man hath found, he hideth, and for joy thereof goeth and selleth all that he hath, and buyeth that field.
translations.ylt: `Again, the reign of the heavens is like to treasure hid in the field, which a man having found did hide, and from his joy goeth, and all, as much as he hath, he selleth, and buyeth that field.
translations.web: “Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like treasure hidden in the field, which a man found and hid. In his joy, he goes and sells all that he has and buys that field.

translations.kjv: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto a merchant man, seeking goodly pearls:
translations.ylt: `Again, the reign of the heavens is like to a man, a merchant, seeking goodly pearls,
translations.web: “Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who is a merchant seeking fine pearls,

translations.kjv: Who, when he had found one pearl of great price, went and sold all that he had, and bought it.
translations.ylt: who having found one pearl of great price, having gone away, hath sold all, as much as he had, and bought it.
translations.web: who having found one pearl of great price, he went and sold all that he had and bought it.

translations.kjv: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto a net, that was cast into the sea, and gathered of every kind:
translations.ylt: `Again, the reign of the heavens is like to a net that was cast into the sea, and did gather together of every kind,
translations.web: “Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like a dragnet that was cast into the sea and gathered some fish of every kind,

translations.kjv: Which, when it was full, they drew to shore, and sat down, and gathered the good into vessels, but cast the bad away.
translations.ylt: which, when it was filled, having drawn up again upon the beach, and having sat down, they gathered the good into vessels, and the bad they did cast out,
translations.web: which, when it was filled, fishermen drew up on the beach. They sat down and gathered the good into containers, but the bad they threw away.

translations.kjv: So shall it be at the end of the world: the angels shall come forth, and sever the wicked from among the just,
translations.ylt: so shall it be in the full end of the age, the messengers shall come forth and separate the evil out of the midst of the righteous,
translations.web: So it will be in the end of the world. The angels will come and separate the wicked from among the righteous,

translations.kjv: And shall cast them into the furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.
translations.ylt: and shall cast them to the furnace of the fire, there shall be the weeping and the gnashing of the teeth.'
translations.web: and will cast them into the furnace of fire. There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.”

translations.kjv: Jesus saith unto them, Have ye understood all these things? They say unto him, Yea, Lord.
translations.ylt: Jesus saith to them, `Did ye understand all these?' They say to him, `Yes, sir.'
translations.web: Jesus said to them, “Have you understood all these things?” They answered him, “Yes, Lord.”

translations.kjv: Then said he unto them, Therefore every scribe which is instructed unto the kingdom of heaven is like unto a man that is an householder, which bringeth forth out of his treasure things new and old.
translations.ylt: And he said to them, `Because of this every scribe having been discipled in regard to the reign of the heavens, is like to a man, a householder, who doth bring forth out of his treasure things new and old.'
translations.web: He said to them, “Therefore every scribe who has been made a disciple in the Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who is a householder, who brings out of his treasure new and old things.”

translations.kjv: And it came to pass, that when Jesus had finished these parables, he departed thence.
translations.ylt: And it came to pass, when Jesus finished these similes, he removed thence,
translations.web: When Jesus had finished these parables, he departed from there.

translations.kjv: And when he was come into his own country, he taught them in their synagogue, insomuch that they were astonished, and said, Whence hath this man this wisdom, and these mighty works?
translations.ylt: and having come to his own country, he was teaching them in their synagogue, so that they were astonished, and were saying, `Whence to this one this wisdom and the mighty works?
translations.web: Coming into his own country, he taught them in their synagogue, so that they were astonished and said, “Where did this man get this wisdom and these mighty works?

translations.kjv: Is not this the carpenter’s son? is not his mother called Mary? and his brethren, James, and Joses, and Simon, and Judas?
translations.ylt: is not this the carpenter's son? is not his mother called Mary, and his brethren James, and Joses, and Simon, and Judas?
translations.web: Isn’t this the carpenter’s son? Isn’t his mother called Mary, and his brothers James, Joses, Simon, and Judas?

translations.kjv: And his sisters, are they not all with us? Whence then hath this man all these things?
translations.ylt: and his sisters--are they not all with us? whence, then, to this one all these?'
translations.web: Aren’t all of his sisters with us? Where then did this man get all of these things?”

translations.kjv: And they were offended in him. But Jesus said unto them, A prophet is not without honour, save in his own country, and in his own house.
translations.ylt: and they were stumbled at him. And Jesus said to them, `A prophet is not without honour except in his own country, and in his own house:'
translations.web: They were offended by him. But Jesus said to them, “A prophet is not without honor, except in his own country and in his own house.”

translations.kjv: And he did not many mighty works there because of their unbelief.
translations.ylt: and he did not there many mighty works, because of their unbelief.
translations.web: He didn’t do many mighty works there because of their unbelief.

translations.kjv: At that time Herod the tetrarch heard of the fame of Jesus,
translations.ylt: At that time did Herod the tetrarch hear the fame of Jesus,
translations.web: At that time, Herod the tetrarch heard the report concerning Jesus,

translations.kjv: And said unto his servants, This is John the Baptist; he is risen from the dead; and therefore mighty works do shew forth themselves in him.
translations.ylt: and said to his servants, `This is John the Baptist, he did rise from the dead, and because of this the mighty energies are working in him.'
translations.web: and said to his servants, “This is John the Baptizer. He is risen from the dead. That is why these powers work in him.”

translations.kjv: For Herod had laid hold on John, and bound him, and put him in prison for Herodias’ sake, his brother Philip’s wife.
translations.ylt: For Herod having laid hold on John, did bind him, and did put him in prison, because of Herodias his brother Philip's wife,
translations.web: For Herod had arrested John, bound him, and put him in prison for the sake of Herodias, his brother Philip’s wife.

translations.kjv: For John said unto him, It is not lawful for thee to have her.
translations.ylt: for John was saying to him, `It is not lawful to thee to have her,'
translations.web: For John said to him, “It is not lawful for you to have her.”

translations.kjv: And when he would have put him to death, he feared the multitude, because they counted him as a prophet.
translations.ylt: and, willing to kill him, he feared the multitude, because as a prophet they were holding him.
translations.web: When he would have put him to death, he feared the multitude, because they counted him as a prophet.

translations.kjv: But when Herod’s birthday was kept, the daughter of Herodias danced before them, and pleased Herod.
translations.ylt: But the birthday of Herod being kept, the daughter of Herodias danced in the midst, and did please Herod,
translations.web: But when Herod’s birthday came, the daughter of Herodias danced among them and pleased Herod.

translations.kjv: Whereupon he promised with an oath to give her whatsoever she would ask.
translations.ylt: whereupon with an oath he professed to give her whatever she might ask.
translations.web: Therefore he promised with an oath to give her whatever she should ask.

translations.kjv: And she, being before instructed of her mother, said, Give me here John Baptist’s head in a charger.
translations.ylt: And she having been instigated by her mother--`Give me (says she) here upon a plate the head of John the Baptist;
translations.web: She, being prompted by her mother, said, “Give me here on a platter the head of John the Baptizer.”

translations.kjv: And the king was sorry: nevertheless for the oath’s sake, and them which sat with him at meat, he commanded it to be given her.
translations.ylt: and the king was grieved, but because of the oaths and of those reclining with him, he commanded it to be given;
translations.web: The king was grieved, but for the sake of his oaths and of those who sat at the table with him, he commanded it to be given,

translations.kjv: And he sent, and beheaded John in the prison.
translations.ylt: and having sent, he beheaded John in the prison,
translations.web: and he sent and beheaded John in the prison.

translations.kjv: And his head was brought in a charger, and given to the damsel: and she brought it to her mother.
translations.ylt: and his head was brought upon a plate, and was given to the damsel, and she brought it nigh to her mother.
translations.web: His head was brought on a platter and given to the young lady; and she brought it to her mother.

translations.kjv: And his disciples came, and took up the body, and buried it, and went and told Jesus.
translations.ylt: And his disciples having come, took up the body, and buried it, and having come, they told Jesus,
translations.web: His disciples came, took the body, and buried it. Then they went and told Jesus.

translations.kjv: When Jesus heard of it, he departed thence by ship into a desert place apart: and when the people had heard thereof, they followed him on foot out of the cities.
translations.ylt: and Jesus having heard, withdrew thence in a boat to a desolate place by himself, and the multitudes having heard did follow him on land from the cities.
translations.web: Now when Jesus heard this, he withdrew from there in a boat to a deserted place apart. When the multitudes heard it, they followed him on foot from the cities.

translations.kjv: And Jesus went forth, and saw a great multitude, and was moved with compassion toward them, and he healed their sick.
translations.ylt: And Jesus having come forth, saw a great multitude, and was moved with compassion upon them, and did heal their infirm;
translations.web: Jesus went out, and he saw a great multitude. He had compassion on them and healed their sick.

translations.kjv: And when it was evening, his disciples came to him, saying, This is a desert place, and the time is now past; send the multitude away, that they may go into the villages, and buy themselves victuals.
translations.ylt: and evening having come, his disciples came to him, saying, `The place is desolate, and the hour hath now past, let away the multitudes that, having gone to the villages, they may buy to themselves food.'
translations.web: When evening had come, his disciples came to him, saying, “This place is deserted, and the hour is already late. Send the multitudes away, that they may go into the villages, and buy themselves food.”

translations.kjv: But Jesus said unto them, They need not depart; give ye them to eat.
translations.ylt: And Jesus said to them, `They have no need to go away--give ye them to eat.'
translations.web: But Jesus said to them, “They don’t need to go away. You give them something to eat.”

translations.kjv: And they say unto him, We have here but five loaves, and two fishes.
translations.ylt: And they say to him, `We have not here except five loaves, and two fishes.'
translations.web: They told him, “We only have here five loaves and two fish.”

translations.kjv: He said, Bring them hither to me.
translations.ylt: And he said, `Bring ye them to me hither.'
translations.web: He said, “Bring them here to me.”

translations.kjv: And he commanded the multitude to sit down on the grass, and took the five loaves, and the two fishes, and looking up to heaven, he blessed, and brake, and gave the loaves to his disciples, and the disciples to the multitude.
translations.ylt: And having commanded the multitudes to recline upon the grass, and having taken the five loaves and the two fishes, having looked up to the heaven, he did bless, and having broken, he gave the loaves to the disciples, and the disciples to the multitudes,
translations.web: He commanded the multitudes to sit down on the grass; and he took the five loaves and the two fish, and looking up to heaven, he blessed, broke and gave the loaves to the disciples; and the disciples gave to the multitudes.

translations.kjv: And they did all eat, and were filled: and they took up of the fragments that remained twelve baskets full.
translations.ylt: and they did all eat, and were filled, and they took up what was over of the broken pieces twelve hand-baskets full;
translations.web: They all ate and were filled. They took up twelve baskets full of that which remained left over from the broken pieces.

translations.kjv: And they that had eaten were about five thousand men, beside women and children.
translations.ylt: and those eating were about five thousand men, apart from women and children.
translations.web: Those who ate were about five thousand men, in addition to women and children.

translations.kjv: And straightway Jesus constrained his disciples to get into a ship, and to go before him unto the other side, while he sent the multitudes away.
translations.ylt: And immediately Jesus constrained his disciples to go into the boat, and to go before him to the other side, till he might let away the multitudes;
translations.web: Immediately Jesus made the disciples get into the boat and go ahead of him to the other side, while he sent the multitudes away.

translations.kjv: And when he had sent the multitudes away, he went up into a mountain apart to pray: and when the evening was come, he was there alone.
translations.ylt: and having let away the multitudes, he went up to the mountain by himself to pray, and evening having come, he was there alone,
translations.web: After he had sent the multitudes away, he went up into the mountain by himself to pray. When evening had come, he was there alone.

translations.kjv: But the ship was now in the midst of the sea, tossed with waves: for the wind was contrary.
translations.ylt: and the boat was now in the midst of the sea, distressed by the waves, for the wind was contrary.
translations.web: But the boat was now in the middle of the sea, distressed by the waves, for the wind was contrary.

translations.kjv: And in the fourth watch of the night Jesus went unto them, walking on the sea.
translations.ylt: And in the fourth watch of the night Jesus went away to them, walking upon the sea,
translations.web: In the fourth watch of the night, Jesus came to them, walking on the sea.

translations.kjv: And when the disciples saw him walking on the sea, they were troubled, saying, It is a spirit; and they cried out for fear.
translations.ylt: and the disciples having seen him walking upon the sea, were troubled saying--`It is an apparition,' and from the fear they cried out;
translations.web: When the disciples saw him walking on the sea, they were troubled, saying, “It’s a ghost!” and they cried out for fear.

translations.kjv: But straightway Jesus spake unto them, saying, Be of good cheer; it is I; be not afraid.
translations.ylt: and immediately Jesus spake to them, saying, `Be of good courage, I am he, be not afraid.'
translations.web: But immediately Jesus spoke to them, saying, “Cheer up! It is I! Don’t be afraid.”

translations.kjv: And Peter answered him and said, Lord, if it be thou, bid me come unto thee on the water.
translations.ylt: And Peter answering him said, `Sir, if it is thou, bid me come to thee upon the waters;'
translations.web: Peter answered him and said, “Lord, if it is you, command me to come to you on the waters.”

translations.kjv: And he said, Come. And when Peter was come down out of the ship, he walked on the water, to go to Jesus.
translations.ylt: and he said, `Come;' and having gone down from the boat, Peter walked upon the waters to come unto Jesus,
translations.web: He said, “Come!” Peter stepped down from the boat and walked on the waters to come to Jesus.

translations.kjv: But when he saw the wind boisterous, he was afraid; and beginning to sink, he cried, saying, Lord, save me.
translations.ylt: but seeing the wind vehement, he was afraid, and having begun to sink, he cried out, saying, `Sir, save me.'
translations.web: But when he saw that the wind was strong, he was afraid, and beginning to sink, he cried out, saying, “Lord, save me!”

translations.kjv: And immediately Jesus stretched forth his hand, and caught him, and said unto him, O thou of little faith, wherefore didst thou doubt?
translations.ylt: And immediately Jesus, having stretched forth the hand, laid hold of him, and saith to him, `Little faith! for what didst thou waver?'
translations.web: Immediately Jesus stretched out his hand, took hold of him, and said to him, “You of little faith, why did you doubt?”

translations.kjv: And when they were come into the ship, the wind ceased.
translations.ylt: and they having gone to the boat the wind lulled,
translations.web: When they got up into the boat, the wind ceased.

translations.kjv: Then they that were in the ship came and worshipped him, saying, Of a truth thou art the Son of God.
translations.ylt: and those in the boat having come, did bow to him, saying, `Truly--God's Son art thou.'
translations.web: Those who were in the boat came and worshiped him, saying, “You are truly the Son of God!”

translations.kjv: And when they were gone over, they came into the land of Gennesaret.
translations.ylt: And having passed over, they came to the land of Gennesaret,
translations.web: When they had crossed over, they came to the land of Gennesaret.

translations.kjv: And when the men of that place had knowledge of him, they sent out into all that country round about, and brought unto him all that were diseased;
translations.ylt: and having recognized him, the men of that place sent forth to all that region round about, and they brought to him all who were ill,
translations.web: When the people of that place recognized him, they sent into all that surrounding region and brought to him all who were sick;

translations.kjv: And besought him that they might only touch the hem of his garment: and as many as touched were made perfectly whole.
translations.ylt: and were calling on him that they might only touch the fringe of his garment, and as many as did touch were saved.
translations.web: and they begged him that they might just touch the fringe of his garment. As many as touched it were made whole.

translations.kjv: Then came to Jesus scribes and Pharisees, which were of Jerusalem, saying,
translations.ylt: Then come unto Jesus do they from Jerusalem--scribes and Pharisees--saying,
translations.web: Then Pharisees and scribes came to Jesus from Jerusalem, saying,

translations.kjv: Why do thy disciples transgress the tradition of the elders? for they wash not their hands when they eat bread.
translations.ylt: `Wherefore do thy disciples transgress the tradition of the elders? for they do not wash their hands when they may eat bread.'
translations.web: “Why do your disciples disobey the tradition of the elders? For they don’t wash their hands when they eat bread.”

translations.kjv: But he answered and said unto them, Why do ye also transgress the commandment of God by your tradition?
translations.ylt: And he answering said to them, `Wherefore also do ye transgress the command of God because of your tradition?
translations.web: He answered them, “Why do you also disobey the commandment of God because of your tradition?

translations.kjv: For God commanded, saying, Honour thy father and mother: and, He that curseth father or mother, let him die the death.
translations.ylt: for God did command, saying, Honour thy father and mother; and, He who is speaking evil of father or mother--let him die the death;
translations.web: For God commanded, ‘Honor your father and your mother,’ and, ‘He who speaks evil of father or mother, let him be put to death.’

translations.kjv: But ye say, Whosoever shall say to his father or his mother, It is a gift, by whatsoever thou mightest be profited by me;
translations.ylt: but ye say, Whoever may say to father or mother, An offering is whatever thou mayest be profited by me; --
translations.web: But you say, ‘Whoever may tell his father or his mother, “Whatever help you might otherwise have gotten from me is a gift devoted to God,”

translations.kjv: And honour not his father or his mother, he shall be free. Thus have ye made the commandment of God of none effect by your tradition.
translations.ylt: and he may not honour his father or his mother, and ye did set aside the command of God because of your tradition.
translations.web: he shall not honor his father or mother.’ You have made the commandment of God void because of your tradition.

translations.kjv: Ye hypocrites, well did Esaias prophesy of you, saying,
translations.ylt: `Hypocrites, well did Isaiah prophesy of you, saying,
translations.web: You hypocrites! Well did Isaiah prophesy of you, saying,

translations.kjv: This people draweth nigh unto me with their mouth, and honoureth me with their lips; but their heart is far from me.
translations.ylt: This people doth draw nigh to Me with their mouth, and with the lips it doth honour Me, but their heart is far off from Me;
translations.web: ‘These people draw near to me with their mouth, and honor me with their lips; but their heart is far from me.

translations.kjv: But in vain they do worship me, teaching for doctrines the commandments of men.
translations.ylt: and in vain do they worship Me, teaching teachings--commands of men.'
translations.web: And they worship me in vain, teaching as doctrine rules made by men.’”

translations.kjv: And he called the multitude, and said unto them, Hear, and understand:
translations.ylt: And having called near the multitude, he said to them, `Hear and understand:
translations.web: He summoned the multitude, and said to them, “Hear, and understand.

translations.kjv: Not that which goeth into the mouth defileth a man; but that which cometh out of the mouth, this defileth a man.
translations.ylt: not that which is coming into the mouth doth defile the man, but that which is coming forth from the mouth, this defileth the man.'
translations.web: That which enters into the mouth doesn’t defile the man; but that which proceeds out of the mouth, this defiles the man.”

translations.kjv: Then came his disciples, and said unto him, Knowest thou that the Pharisees were offended, after they heard this saying?
translations.ylt: Then his disciples having come near, said to him, `Hast thou known that the Pharisees, having heard the word, were stumbled?'
translations.web: Then the disciples came and said to him, “Do you know that the Pharisees were offended when they heard this saying?”

translations.kjv: But he answered and said, Every plant, which my heavenly Father hath not planted, shall be rooted up.
translations.ylt: And he answering said, `Every plant that my heavenly Father did not plant shall be rooted up;
translations.web: But he answered, “Every plant which my heavenly Father didn’t plant will be uprooted.

translations.kjv: Let them alone: they be blind leaders of the blind. And if the blind lead the blind, both shall fall into the ditch.
translations.ylt: let them alone, guides they are--blind of blind; and if blind may guide blind, both into a ditch shall fall.'
translations.web: Leave them alone. They are blind guides of the blind. If the blind guide the blind, both will fall into a pit.”

translations.kjv: Then answered Peter and said unto him, Declare unto us this parable.
translations.ylt: And Peter answering said to him, `Explain to us this simile.'
translations.web: Peter answered him, “Explain the parable to us.”

translations.kjv: And Jesus said, Are ye also yet without understanding?
translations.ylt: And Jesus said, `Are ye also yet without understanding?
translations.web: So Jesus said, “Do you also still not understand?

translations.kjv: Do not ye yet understand, that whatsoever entereth in at the mouth goeth into the belly, and is cast out into the draught?
translations.ylt: do ye not understand that all that is going into the mouth doth pass into the belly, and into the drain is cast forth?
translations.web: Don’t you understand that whatever goes into the mouth passes into the belly and then out of the body?

translations.kjv: But those things which proceed out of the mouth come forth from the heart; and they defile the man.
translations.ylt: but the things coming forth from the mouth from the heart do come forth, and these defile the man;
translations.web: But the things which proceed out of the mouth come out of the heart, and they defile the man.

translations.kjv: For out of the heart proceed evil thoughts, murders, adulteries, fornications, thefts, false witness, blasphemies:
translations.ylt: for out of the heart come forth evil thoughts, murders, adulteries, whoredoms, thefts, false witnessings, evil speakings:
translations.web: For out of the heart come evil thoughts, murders, adulteries, sexual sins, thefts, false testimony, and blasphemies.

translations.kjv: These are the things which defile a man: but to eat with unwashen hands defileth not a man.
translations.ylt: these are the things defiling the man; but to eat with unwashen hands doth not defile the man.'
translations.web: These are the things which defile the man; but to eat with unwashed hands doesn’t defile the man.”

translations.kjv: Then Jesus went thence, and departed into the coasts of Tyre and Sidon.
translations.ylt: And Jesus having come forth thence, withdrew to the parts of Tyre and Sidon,
translations.web: Jesus went out from there and withdrew into the region of Tyre and Sidon.

translations.kjv: And, behold, a woman of Canaan came out of the same coasts, and cried unto him, saying, Have mercy on me, O Lord, thou Son of David; my daughter is grievously vexed with a devil.
translations.ylt: and lo, a woman, a Canaanitess, from those borders having come forth, did call to him, saying, `Deal kindly with me, Sir--Son of David; my daughter is miserably demonized.'
translations.web: Behold, a Canaanite woman came out from those borders and cried, saying, “Have mercy on me, Lord, you son of David! My daughter is severely possessed by a demon!”

translations.kjv: But he answered her not a word. And his disciples came and besought him, saying, Send her away; for she crieth after us.
translations.ylt: And he did not answer her a word; and his disciples having come to him, were asking him, saying--`Let her away, because she crieth after us;'
translations.web: But he answered her not a word. His disciples came and begged him, saying, “Send her away; for she cries after us.”

translations.kjv: But he answered and said, I am not sent but unto the lost sheep of the house of Israel.
translations.ylt: and he answering said, `I was not sent except to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.'
translations.web: But he answered, “I wasn’t sent to anyone but the lost sheep of the house of Israel.”

translations.kjv: Then came she and worshipped him, saying, Lord, help me.
translations.ylt: And having come, she was bowing to him, saying, `Sir, help me;'
translations.web: But she came and worshiped him, saying, “Lord, help me.”

translations.kjv: But he answered and said, It is not meet to take the children’s bread, and to cast it to dogs.
translations.ylt: and he answering said, `It is not good to take the children's bread, and to cast to the little dogs.'
translations.web: But he answered, “It is not appropriate to take the children’s bread and throw it to the dogs.”

translations.kjv: And she said, Truth, Lord: yet the dogs eat of the crumbs which fall from their masters’ table.
translations.ylt: And she said, `Yes, sir, for even the little dogs do eat of the crumbs that are falling from their lords' table;'
translations.web: But she said, “Yes, Lord, but even the dogs eat the crumbs which fall from their masters’ table.”

translations.kjv: Then Jesus answered and said unto her, O woman, great is thy faith: be it unto thee even as thou wilt. And her daughter was made whole from that very hour.
translations.ylt: then answering, Jesus said to her, `O woman, great is thy faith, let it be to thee as thou wilt;' and her daughter was healed from that hour.
translations.web: Then Jesus answered her, “Woman, great is your faith! Be it done to you even as you desire.” And her daughter was healed from that hour.

translations.kjv: And Jesus departed from thence, and came nigh unto the sea of Galilee; and went up into a mountain, and sat down there.
translations.ylt: And Jesus having passed thence, came nigh unto the sea of Galilee, and having gone up to the mountain, he was sitting there,
translations.web: Jesus departed from there and came near to the sea of Galilee; and he went up on the mountain and sat there.

translations.kjv: And great multitudes came unto him, having with them those that were lame, blind, dumb, maimed, and many others, and cast them down at Jesus’ feet; and he healed them:
translations.ylt: and there came to him great multitudes, having with them lame, blind, dumb, maimed, and many others, and they did cast them at the feet of Jesus, and he healed them,
translations.web: Great multitudes came to him, having with them the lame, blind, mute, maimed, and many others, and they put them down at his feet. He healed them,

translations.kjv: Insomuch that the multitude wondered, when they saw the dumb to speak, the maimed to be whole, the lame to walk, and the blind to see: and they glorified the God of Israel.
translations.ylt: so that the multitudes did wonder, seeing dumb ones speaking, maimed whole, lame walking, and blind seeing; and they glorified the God of Israel.
translations.web: so that the multitude wondered when they saw the mute speaking, the injured healed, the lame walking, and the blind seeing—and they glorified the God of Israel.

translations.kjv: Then Jesus called his disciples unto him, and said, I have compassion on the multitude, because they continue with me now three days, and have nothing to eat: and I will not send them away fasting, lest they faint in the way.
translations.ylt: And Jesus having called near his disciples, said, `I have compassion upon the multitude, because now three days they continue with me, and they have not what they may eat; and to let them away fasting I will not, lest they faint in the way.'
translations.web: Jesus summoned his disciples and said, “I have compassion on the multitude, because they have continued with me now three days and have nothing to eat. I don’t want to send them away fasting, or they might faint on the way.”

translations.kjv: And his disciples say unto him, Whence should we have so much bread in the wilderness, as to fill so great a multitude?
translations.ylt: And his disciples say to him, `Whence to us, in a wilderness, so many loaves, as to fill so great a multitude?'
translations.web: The disciples said to him, “Where could we get so many loaves in a deserted place as to satisfy so great a multitude?”

translations.kjv: And Jesus saith unto them, How many loaves have ye? And they said, Seven, and a few little fishes.
translations.ylt: And Jesus saith to them, `How many loaves have ye?' and they said, `Seven, and a few little fishes.'
translations.web: Jesus said to them, “How many loaves do you have?” They said, “Seven, and a few small fish.”

translations.kjv: And he commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground.
translations.ylt: And he commanded the multitudes to sit down upon the ground,
translations.web: He commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground;

translations.kjv: And he took the seven loaves and the fishes, and gave thanks, and brake them, and gave to his disciples, and the disciples to the multitude.
translations.ylt: and having taken the seven loaves and the fishes, having given thanks, he did break, and gave to his disciples, and the disciples to the multitude.
translations.web: and he took the seven loaves and the fish. He gave thanks and broke them, and gave to the disciples, and the disciples to the multitudes.

translations.kjv: And they did all eat, and were filled: and they took up of the broken meat that was left seven baskets full.
translations.ylt: And they did all eat, and were filled, and they took up what was over of the broken pieces seven baskets full,
translations.web: They all ate and were filled. They took up seven baskets full of the broken pieces that were left over.

translations.kjv: And they that did eat were four thousand men, beside women and children.
translations.ylt: and those eating were four thousand men, apart from women and children.
translations.web: Those who ate were four thousand men, in addition to women and children.

translations.kjv: And he sent away the multitude, and took ship, and came into the coasts of Magdala.
translations.ylt: And having let away the multitudes, he went into the boat, and did come to the borders of Magdala.
translations.web: Then he sent away the multitudes, got into the boat, and came into the borders of Magdala.

translations.kjv: The Pharisees also with the Sadducees came, and tempting desired him that he would shew them a sign from heaven.
translations.ylt: And the Pharisees and Sadducees having come, tempting, did question him, to shew to them a sign from the heaven,
translations.web: The Pharisees and Sadducees came, and testing him, asked him to show them a sign from heaven.

translations.kjv: He answered and said unto them, When it is evening, ye say, It will be fair weather: for the sky is red.
translations.ylt: and he answering said to them, `Evening having come, ye say, Fair weather, for the heaven is red,
translations.web: But he answered them, “When it is evening, you say, ‘It will be fair weather, for the sky is red.’

translations.kjv: And in the morning, It will be foul weather to day: for the sky is red and lowring. O ye hypocrites, ye can discern the face of the sky; but can ye not discern the signs of the times?
translations.ylt: and at morning, Foul weather to-day, for the heaven is red--gloomy; hypocrites, the face of the heavens indeed ye do know to discern, but the signs of the times ye are not able!
translations.web: In the morning, ‘It will be foul weather today, for the sky is red and threatening.’ Hypocrites! You know how to discern the appearance of the sky, but you can’t discern the signs of the times!

translations.kjv: A wicked and adulterous generation seeketh after a sign; and there shall no sign be given unto it, but the sign of the prophet Jonas. And he left them, and departed.
translations.ylt: `A generation evil and adulterous doth seek a sign, and a sign shall not be given to it, except the sign of Jonah the prophet;' and having left them he went away.
translations.web: An evil and adulterous generation seeks after a sign, and there will be no sign given to it, except the sign of the prophet Jonah.” He left them and departed.

translations.kjv: And when his disciples were come to the other side, they had forgotten to take bread.
translations.ylt: And his disciples having come to the other side, forgot to take loaves,
translations.web: The disciples came to the other side and had forgotten to take bread.

translations.kjv: Then Jesus said unto them, Take heed and beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees.
translations.ylt: and Jesus said to them, `Beware, and take heed of the leaven of the Pharisees and Sadducees;'
translations.web: Jesus said to them, “Take heed and beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees.”

translations.kjv: And they reasoned among themselves, saying, It is because we have taken no bread.
translations.ylt: and they were reasoning in themselves, saying, `Because we took no loaves.'
translations.web: They reasoned among themselves, saying, “We brought no bread.”

translations.kjv: Which when Jesus perceived, he said unto them, O ye of little faith, why reason ye among yourselves, because ye have brought no bread?
translations.ylt: And Jesus having known, said to them, `Why reason ye in yourselves, ye of little faith, because ye took no loaves?
translations.web: Jesus, perceiving it, said, “Why do you reason among yourselves, you of little faith, because you have brought no bread?

translations.kjv: Do ye not yet understand, neither remember the five loaves of the five thousand, and how many baskets ye took up?
translations.ylt: do ye not yet understand, nor remember the five loaves of the five thousand, and how many hand-baskets ye took up?
translations.web: Don’t you yet perceive or remember the five loaves for the five thousand, and how many baskets you took up,

translations.kjv: Neither the seven loaves of the four thousand, and how many baskets ye took up?
translations.ylt: nor the seven loaves of the four thousand, and how many baskets ye took up?
translations.web: or the seven loaves for the four thousand, and how many baskets you took up?

translations.kjv: How is it that ye do not understand that I spake it not to you concerning bread, that ye should beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees?
translations.ylt: how do ye not understand that I did not speak to you of bread--to take heed of the leaven of the Pharisees and Sadducees?'
translations.web: How is it that you don’t perceive that I didn’t speak to you concerning bread? But beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees.”

translations.kjv: Then understood they how that he bade them not beware of the leaven of bread, but of the doctrine of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees.
translations.ylt: Then they understood that he did not say to take heed of the leaven of the bread, but of the teaching, of the Pharisees and Sadducees.
translations.web: Then they understood that he didn’t tell them to beware of the yeast of bread, but of the teaching of the Pharisees and Sadducees.

translations.kjv: When Jesus came into the coasts of Cesarea Philippi, he asked his disciples, saying, Whom do men say that I the Son of man am?
translations.ylt: And Jesus, having come to the parts of Caesarea Philippi, was asking his disciples, saying, `Who do men say me to be--the Son of Man?'
translations.web: Now when Jesus came into the parts of Caesarea Philippi, he asked his disciples, saying, “Who do men say that I, the Son of Man, am?”

translations.kjv: And they said, Some say that thou art John the Baptist: some, Elias; and others, Jeremias, or one of the prophets.
translations.ylt: and they said, `Some, John the Baptist, and others, Elijah, and others, Jeremiah, or one of the prophets.'
translations.web: They said, “Some say John the Baptizer, some, Elijah, and others, Jeremiah or one of the prophets.”

translations.kjv: He saith unto them, But whom say ye that I am?
translations.ylt: He saith to them, `And ye--who do ye say me to be?'
translations.web: He said to them, “But who do you say that I am?”

translations.kjv: And Simon Peter answered and said, Thou art the Christ, the Son of the living God.
translations.ylt: and Simon Peter answering said, `Thou art the Christ, the Son of the living God.'
translations.web: Simon Peter answered, “You are the Christ, the Son of the living God.”

translations.kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto him, Blessed art thou, Simon Bar–jona: for flesh and blood hath not revealed it unto thee, but my Father which is in heaven.
translations.ylt: And Jesus answering said to him, `Happy art thou, Simon Bar-Jona, because flesh and blood did not reveal it to thee, but my Father who is in the heavens.
translations.web: Jesus answered him, “Blessed are you, Simon Bar Jonah, for flesh and blood has not revealed this to you, but my Father who is in heaven.

translations.kjv: And I say also unto thee, That thou art Peter, and upon this rock I will build my church; and the gates of hell shall not prevail against it.
translations.ylt: `And I also say to thee, that thou art a rock, and upon this rock I will build my assembly, and gates of Hades shall not prevail against it;
translations.web: I also tell you that you are Peter, and on this rock I will build my assembly, and the gates of Hades will not prevail against it.

translations.kjv: And I will give unto thee the keys of the kingdom of heaven: and whatsoever thou shalt bind on earth shall be bound in heaven: and whatsoever thou shalt loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven.
translations.ylt: and I will give to thee the keys of the reign of the heavens, and whatever thou mayest bind upon the earth shall be having been bound in the heavens, and whatever thou mayest loose upon the earth shall be having been loosed in the heavens.'
translations.web: I will give to you the keys of the Kingdom of Heaven, and whatever you bind on earth will have been bound in heaven; and whatever you release on earth will have been released in heaven.”

translations.kjv: Then charged he his disciples that they should tell no man that he was Jesus the Christ.
translations.ylt: Then did he charge his disciples that they may say to no one that he is Jesus the Christ.
translations.web: Then he commanded the disciples that they should tell no one that he was Jesus the Christ.

translations.kjv: From that time forth began Jesus to shew unto his disciples, how that he must go unto Jerusalem, and suffer many things of the elders and chief priests and scribes, and be killed, and be raised again the third day.
translations.ylt: From that time began Jesus to shew to his disciples that it is necessary for him to go away to Jerusalem, and to suffer many things from the elders, and chief priests, and scribes, and to be put to death, and the third day to rise.
translations.web: From that time, Jesus began to show his disciples that he must go to Jerusalem and suffer many things from the elders, chief priests, and scribes, and be killed, and the third day be raised up.

translations.kjv: Then Peter took him, and began to rebuke him, saying, Be it far from thee, Lord: this shall not be unto thee.
translations.ylt: And having taken him aside, Peter began to rebuke him, saying, `Be kind to thyself, sir; this shall not be to thee;'
translations.web: Peter took him aside and began to rebuke him, saying, “Far be it from you, Lord! This will never be done to you.”

translations.kjv: But he turned, and said unto Peter, Get thee behind me, Satan: thou art an offence unto me: for thou savourest not the things that be of God, but those that be of men.
translations.ylt: and he having turned, said to Peter, `Get thee behind me, adversary! thou art a stumbling-block to me, for thou dost not mind the things of God, but the things of men.'
translations.web: But he turned and said to Peter, “Get behind me, Satan! You are a stumbling block to me, for you are not setting your mind on the things of God, but on the things of men.”

translations.kjv: Then said Jesus unto his disciples, If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.
translations.ylt: Then said Jesus to his disciples, `If any one doth will to come after me, let him disown himself, and take up his cross, and follow me,
translations.web: Then Jesus said to his disciples, “If anyone desires to come after me, let him deny himself, take up his cross, and follow me.

translations.kjv: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it: and whosoever will lose his life for my sake shall find it.
translations.ylt: for whoever may will to save his life, shall lose it, and whoever may lose his life for my sake shall find it,
translations.web: For whoever desires to save his life will lose it, and whoever will lose his life for my sake will find it.

translations.kjv: For what is a man profited, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul? or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul?
translations.ylt: for what is a man profited if he may gain the whole world, but of his life suffer loss? or what shall a man give as an exchange for his life?
translations.web: For what will it profit a man if he gains the whole world and forfeits his life? Or what will a man give in exchange for his life?

translations.kjv: For the Son of man shall come in the glory of his Father with his angels; and then he shall reward every man according to his works.
translations.ylt: `For, the Son of Man is about to come in the glory of his Father, with his messengers, and then he will reward each, according to his work.
translations.web: For the Son of Man will come in the glory of his Father with his angels, and then he will give to everyone according to his deeds.

translations.kjv: Verily I say unto you, There be some standing here, which shall not taste of death, till they see the Son of man coming in his kingdom.
translations.ylt: Verily I say to you, there are certain of those standing here who shall not taste of death till they may see the Son of Man coming in his reign.'
translations.web: Most certainly I tell you, there are some standing here who will in no way taste of death until they see the Son of Man coming in his Kingdom.”

translations.kjv: And after six days Jesus taketh Peter, James, and John his brother, and bringeth them up into an high mountain apart,
translations.ylt: And after six days Jesus taketh Peter, and James, and John his brother, and doth bring them up to a high mount by themselves,
translations.web: After six days, Jesus took with him Peter, James, and John his brother, and brought them up into a high mountain by themselves.

translations.kjv: And was transfigured before them: and his face did shine as the sun, and his raiment was white as the light.
translations.ylt: and he was transfigured before them, and his face shone as the sun, and his garments did become white as the light,
translations.web: He was changed before them. His face shone like the sun, and his garments became as white as the light.

translations.kjv: And, behold, there appeared unto them Moses and Elias talking with him.
translations.ylt: and lo, appear to them did Moses and Elijah, talking together with him.
translations.web: Behold, Moses and Elijah appeared to them talking with him.

translations.kjv: Then answered Peter, and said unto Jesus, Lord, it is good for us to be here: if thou wilt, let us make here three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elias.
translations.ylt: And Peter answering said to Jesus, `Sir, it is good to us to be here; if thou wilt, we may make here three booths--for thee one, and for Moses one, and one for Elijah.'
translations.web: Peter answered and said to Jesus, “Lord, it is good for us to be here. If you want, let’s make three tents here: one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.”

translations.kjv: While he yet spake, behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them: and behold a voice out of the cloud, which said, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased; hear ye him.
translations.ylt: While he is yet speaking, lo, a bright cloud overshadowed them, and lo, a voice out of the cloud, saying, `This is My Son, --the Beloved, in whom I did delight; hear him.'
translations.web: While he was still speaking, behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them. Behold, a voice came out of the cloud, saying, “This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased. Listen to him.”

translations.kjv: And when the disciples heard it, they fell on their face, and were sore afraid.
translations.ylt: And the disciples having heard, did fall upon their face, and were exceedingly afraid,
translations.web: When the disciples heard it, they fell on their faces, and were very afraid.

translations.kjv: And Jesus came and touched them, and said, Arise, and be not afraid.
translations.ylt: and Jesus having come near, touched them, and said, `Rise, be not afraid,'
translations.web: Jesus came and touched them and said, “Get up, and don’t be afraid.”

translations.kjv: And when they had lifted up their eyes, they saw no man, save Jesus only.
translations.ylt: and having lifted up their eyes, they saw no one, except Jesus only.
translations.web: Lifting up their eyes, they saw no one, except Jesus alone.

translations.kjv: And as they came down from the mountain, Jesus charged them, saying, Tell the vision to no man, until the Son of man be risen again from the dead.
translations.ylt: And as they are coming down from the mount, Jesus charged them, saying, `Say to no one the vision, till the Son of Man out of the dead may rise.'
translations.web: As they were coming down from the mountain, Jesus commanded them, saying, “Don’t tell anyone what you saw, until the Son of Man has risen from the dead.”

translations.kjv: And his disciples asked him, saying, Why then say the scribes that Elias must first come?
translations.ylt: And his disciples questioned him, saying, `Why then do the scribes say that Elijah it behoveth to come first?'
translations.web: His disciples asked him, saying, “Then why do the scribes say that Elijah must come first?”

translations.kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto them, Elias truly shall first come, and restore all things.
translations.ylt: And Jesus answering said to them, `Elijah doth indeed come first, and shall restore all things,
translations.web: Jesus answered them, “Elijah indeed comes first, and will restore all things;

translations.kjv: But I say unto you, That Elias is come already, and they knew him not, but have done unto him whatsoever they listed. Likewise shall also the Son of man suffer of them.
translations.ylt: and I say to you--Elijah did already come, and they did not know him, but did with him whatever they would, so also the Son of Man is about to suffer by them.'
translations.web: but I tell you that Elijah has come already, and they didn’t recognize him, but did to him whatever they wanted to. Even so the Son of Man will also suffer by them.”

translations.kjv: Then the disciples understood that he spake unto them of John the Baptist.
translations.ylt: Then understood the disciples that concerning John the Baptist he spake to them.
translations.web: Then the disciples understood that he spoke to them of John the Baptizer.

translations.kjv: And when they were come to the multitude, there came to him a certain man, kneeling down to him, and saying,
translations.ylt: And when they came unto the multitude, there came to him a man, kneeling down to him,
translations.web: When they came to the multitude, a man came to him, kneeling down to him and saying,

translations.kjv: Lord, have mercy on my son: for he is lunatick, and sore vexed: for ofttimes he falleth into the fire, and oft into the water.
translations.ylt: and saying, `Sir, deal kindly with my son, for he is lunatic, and doth suffer miserably, for often he doth fall into the fire, and often into the water,
translations.web: “Lord, have mercy on my son, for he is epileptic and suffers grievously; for he often falls into the fire, and often into the water.

translations.kjv: And I brought him to thy disciples, and they could not cure him.
translations.ylt: and I brought him near to thy disciples, and they were not able to heal him.'
translations.web: So I brought him to your disciples, and they could not cure him.”

translations.kjv: Then Jesus answered and said, O faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you? how long shall I suffer you? bring him hither to me.
translations.ylt: And Jesus answering said, `O generation, unstedfast and perverse, till when shall I be with you? till when shall I bear you? bring him to me hither;'
translations.web: Jesus answered, “Faithless and perverse generation! How long will I be with you? How long will I bear with you? Bring him here to me.”

translations.kjv: And Jesus rebuked the devil; and he departed out of him: and the child was cured from that very hour.
translations.ylt: and Jesus rebuked him, and the demon went out of him, and the lad was healed from that hour.
translations.web: Jesus rebuked the demon, and it went out of him, and the boy was cured from that hour.

translations.kjv: Then came the disciples to Jesus apart, and said, Why could not we cast him out?
translations.ylt: Then the disciples having come to Jesus by himself, said, `Wherefore were we not able to cast him out?'
translations.web: Then the disciples came to Jesus privately, and said, “Why weren’t we able to cast it out?”

translations.kjv: And Jesus said unto them, Because of your unbelief: for verily I say unto you, If ye have faith as a grain of mustard seed, ye shall say unto this mountain, Remove hence to yonder place; and it shall remove; and nothing shall be impossible unto you.
translations.ylt: And Jesus said to them, `Through your want of faith; for verily I say to you, if ye may have faith as a grain of mustard, ye shall say to this mount, Remove hence to yonder place, and it shall remove, and nothing shall be impossible to you,
translations.web: He said to them, “Because of your unbelief. For most certainly I tell you, if you have faith as a grain of mustard seed, you will tell this mountain, ‘Move from here to there,’ and it will move; and nothing will be impossible for you.

translations.kjv: And while they abode in Galilee, Jesus said unto them, The Son of man shall be betrayed into the hands of men:
translations.ylt: And while they are living in Galilee, Jesus said to them, `The Son of Man is about to be delivered up to the hands of men,
translations.web: While they were staying in Galilee, Jesus said to them, “The Son of Man is about to be delivered up into the hands of men,

translations.kjv: And they shall kill him, and the third day he shall be raised again. And they were exceeding sorry.
translations.ylt: and they shall kill him, and the third day he shall rise,' and they were exceeding sorry.
translations.web: and they will kill him, and the third day he will be raised up.” They were exceedingly sorry.

translations.kjv: And when they were come to Capernaum, they that received tribute money came to Peter, and said, Doth not your master pay tribute?
translations.ylt: And they having come to Capernaum, those receiving the didrachms came near to Peter, and said, `Your teacher--doth he not pay the didrachms?' He saith, `Yes.'
translations.web: When they had come to Capernaum, those who collected the didrachma coins came to Peter, and said, “Doesn’t your teacher pay the didrachma?”

translations.kjv: He saith, Yes. And when he was come into the house, Jesus prevented him, saying, What thinkest thou, Simon? of whom do the kings of the earth take custom or tribute? of their own children, or of strangers?
translations.ylt: And when he came into the house, Jesus anticipated him, saying, `What thinkest thou, Simon? the kings of the earth--from whom do they receive custom or poll-tax? from their sons or from the strangers?'
translations.web: He said, “Yes.” When he came into the house, Jesus anticipated him, saying, “What do you think, Simon? From whom do the kings of the earth receive toll or tribute? From their children, or from strangers?”

translations.kjv: Peter saith unto him, Of strangers. Jesus saith unto him, Then are the children free.
translations.ylt: Peter saith to him, `From the strangers.' Jesus said to him, `Then are the sons free;
translations.web: Peter said to him, “From strangers.” Jesus said to him, “Therefore the children are exempt.

translations.kjv: Notwithstanding, lest we should offend them, go thou to the sea, and cast an hook, and take up the fish that first cometh up; and when thou hast opened his mouth, thou shalt find a piece of money: that take, and give unto them for me and thee.
translations.ylt: but, that we may not cause them to stumble, having gone to the sea, cast a hook, and the fish that hath come up first take thou up, and having opened its mouth, thou shalt find a stater, that having taken, give to them for me and thee.'
translations.web: But, lest we cause them to stumble, go to the sea, cast a hook, and take up the first fish that comes up. When you have opened its mouth, you will find a stater coin. Take that, and give it to them for me and you.”

translations.kjv: At the same time came the disciples unto Jesus, saying, Who is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven?
translations.ylt: At that hour came the disciples near to Jesus, saying, `Who, now, is greater in the reign of the heavens?'
translations.web: In that hour the disciples came to Jesus, saying, “Who then is greatest in the Kingdom of Heaven?”

translations.kjv: And Jesus called a little child unto him, and set him in the midst of them,
translations.ylt: And Jesus having called near a child, did set him in the midst of them,
translations.web: Jesus called a little child to himself, and set him in the middle of them

translations.kjv: And said, Verily I say unto you, Except ye be converted, and become as little children, ye shall not enter into the kingdom of heaven.
translations.ylt: and said, `Verily I say to you, if ye may not be turned and become as the children, ye may not enter into the reign of the heavens;
translations.web: and said, “Most certainly I tell you, unless you turn and become as little children, you will in no way enter into the Kingdom of Heaven.

translations.kjv: Whosoever therefore shall humble himself as this little child, the same is greatest in the kingdom of heaven.
translations.ylt: whoever then may humble himself as this child, he is the greater in the reign of the heavens.
translations.web: Whoever therefore humbles himself as this little child is the greatest in the Kingdom of Heaven.

translations.kjv: And whoso shall receive one such little child in my name receiveth me.
translations.ylt: `And he who may receive one such child in my name, doth receive me,
translations.web: Whoever receives one such little child in my name receives me,

translations.kjv: But whoso shall offend one of these little ones which believe in me, it were better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and that he were drowned in the depth of the sea.
translations.ylt: and whoever may cause to stumble one of those little ones who are believing in me, it is better for him that a weighty millstone may be hanged upon his neck, and he may be sunk in the depth of the sea.
translations.web: but whoever causes one of these little ones who believe in me to stumble, it would be better for him if a huge millstone were hung around his neck and that he were sunk in the depths of the sea.

translations.kjv: Woe unto the world because of offences! for it must needs be that offences come; but woe to that man by whom the offence cometh!
translations.ylt: `Woe to the world from the stumbling-blocks! for there is a necessity for the stumbling-blocks to come, but woe to that man through whom the stumbling-block doth come!
translations.web: “Woe to the world because of occasions of stumbling! For it must be that the occasions come, but woe to that person through whom the occasion comes!

translations.kjv: Wherefore if thy hand or thy foot offend thee, cut them off, and cast them from thee: it is better for thee to enter into life halt or maimed, rather than having two hands or two feet to be cast into everlasting fire.
translations.ylt: `And if thy hand or thy foot doth cause thee to stumble, cut them off and cast from thee; it is good for thee to enter into the life lame or maimed, rather than having two hands or two feet, to be cast to the fire the age-during.
translations.web: If your hand or your foot causes you to stumble, cut it off and cast it from you. It is better for you to enter into life maimed or crippled, rather than having two hands or two feet to be cast into the eternal fire.
