translations.kjv: Ye fools and blind: for whether is greater, the gold, or the temple that sanctifieth the gold?
translations.ylt: Fools and blind! for which is greater, the gold, or the sanctuary that is sanctifying the gold?
translations.web: You blind fools! For which is greater, the gold or the temple that sanctifies the gold?

translations.kjv: And, Whosoever shall swear by the altar, it is nothing; but whosoever sweareth by the gift that is upon it, he is guilty.
translations.ylt: `And, whoever may swear by the altar, it is nothing; but whoever may swear by the gift that is upon it--is debtor!
translations.web: And, ‘Whoever swears by the altar, it is nothing; but whoever swears by the gift that is on it, he is obligated.’

translations.kjv: Ye fools and blind: for whether is greater, the gift, or the altar that sanctifieth the gift?
translations.ylt: Fools and blind! for which is greater, the gift, or the altar that is sanctifying the gift?
translations.web: You blind fools! For which is greater, the gift, or the altar that sanctifies the gift?

translations.kjv: Whoso therefore shall swear by the altar, sweareth by it, and by all things thereon.
translations.ylt: `He therefore who did swear by the altar, doth swear by it, and by all things on it;
translations.web: He therefore who swears by the altar, swears by it and by everything on it.

translations.kjv: And whoso shall swear by the temple, sweareth by it, and by him that dwelleth therein.
translations.ylt: and he who did swear by the sanctuary, doth swear by it, and by Him who is dwelling in it;
translations.web: He who swears by the temple, swears by it and by him who has been living in it.

translations.kjv: And he that shall swear by heaven, sweareth by the throne of God, and by him that sitteth thereon.
translations.ylt: and he who did swear by the heaven, doth swear by the throne of God, and by Him who is sitting upon it.
translations.web: He who swears by heaven, swears by the throne of God and by him who sits on it.

translations.kjv: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye pay tithe of mint and anise and cummin, and have omitted the weightier matters of the law, judgment, mercy, and faith: these ought ye to have done, and not to leave the other undone.
translations.ylt: `Woe to you, Scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! because ye give tithe of the mint, and the dill, and the cumin, and did neglect the weightier things of the Law--the judgment, and the kindness, and the faith; these it behoved you to do, and those not to neglect.
translations.web: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you tithe mint, dill, and cumin, and have left undone the weightier matters of the law: justice, mercy, and faith. But you ought to have done these, and not to have left the other undone.

translations.kjv: Ye blind guides, which strain at a gnat, and swallow a camel.
translations.ylt: `Blind guides! who are straining out the gnat, and the camel are swallowing.
translations.web: You blind guides, who strain out a gnat, and swallow a camel!

translations.kjv: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye make clean the outside of the cup and of the platter, but within they are full of extortion and excess.
translations.ylt: `Woe to you, Scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! because ye make clean the outside of the cup and the plate, and within they are full of rapine and incontinence.
translations.web: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you clean the outside of the cup and of the platter, but within they are full of extortion and unrighteousness.

translations.kjv: Thou blind Pharisee, cleanse first that which is within the cup and platter, that the outside of them may be clean also.
translations.ylt: `Blind Pharisee! cleanse first the inside of the cup and the plate, that the outside of them also may become clean.
translations.web: You blind Pharisee, first clean the inside of the cup and of the platter, that its outside may become clean also.

translations.kjv: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye are like unto whited sepulchres, which indeed appear beautiful outward, but are within full of dead men’s bones, and of all uncleanness.
translations.ylt: `Woe to you, Scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! because ye are like to whitewashed sepulchres, which outwardly indeed do appear beautiful, and within are full of bones of dead men, and of all uncleanness;
translations.web: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you are like whitened tombs, which outwardly appear beautiful, but inwardly are full of dead men’s bones and of all uncleanness.

translations.kjv: Even so ye also outwardly appear righteous unto men, but within ye are full of hypocrisy and iniquity.
translations.ylt: so also ye outwardly indeed do appear to men righteous, and within ye are full of hypocrisy and lawlessness.
translations.web: Even so you also outwardly appear righteous to men, but inwardly you are full of hypocrisy and iniquity.

translations.kjv: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! because ye build the tombs of the prophets, and garnish the sepulchres of the righteous,
translations.ylt: `Woe to you, Scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! because ye build the sepulchres of the prophets, and adorn the tombs of the righteous,
translations.web: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you build the tombs of the prophets and decorate the tombs of the righteous,

translations.kjv: And say, If we had been in the days of our fathers, we would not have been partakers with them in the blood of the prophets.
translations.ylt: and say, If we had been in the days of our fathers, we would not have been partakers with them in the blood of the prophets.
translations.web: and say, ‘If we had lived in the days of our fathers, we wouldn’t have been partakers with them in the blood of the prophets.’

translations.kjv: Wherefore ye be witnesses unto yourselves, that ye are the children of them which killed the prophets.
translations.ylt: So that ye testify to yourselves, that ye are sons of them who did murder the prophets;
translations.web: Therefore you testify to yourselves that you are children of those who killed the prophets.

translations.kjv: Fill ye up then the measure of your fathers.
translations.ylt: and ye--ye fill up the measure of your fathers.
translations.web: Fill up, then, the measure of your fathers.

translations.kjv: Ye serpents, ye generation of vipers, how can ye escape the damnation of hell?
translations.ylt: `Serpents! brood of vipers! how may ye escape from the judgment of the gehenna?
translations.web: You serpents, you offspring of vipers, how will you escape the judgment of Gehenna?

translations.kjv: Wherefore, behold, I send unto you prophets, and wise men, and scribes: and some of them ye shall kill and crucify; and some of them shall ye scourge in your synagogues, and persecute them from city to city:
translations.ylt: `Because of this, lo, I send to you prophets, and wise men, and scribes, and of them ye will kill and crucify, and of them ye will scourge in your synagogues, and will pursue from city to city;
translations.web: Therefore, behold, I send to you prophets, wise men, and scribes. Some of them you will kill and crucify; and some of them you will scourge in your synagogues and persecute from city to city,

translations.kjv: That upon you may come all the righteous blood shed upon the earth, from the blood of righteous Abel unto the blood of Zacharias son of Barachias, whom ye slew between the temple and the altar.
translations.ylt: that on you may come all the righteous blood being poured out on the earth from the blood of Abel the righteous, unto the blood of Zacharias son of Barachias, whom ye slew between the sanctuary and the altar:
translations.web: that on you may come all the righteous blood shed on the earth, from the blood of righteous Abel to the blood of Zachariah son of Barachiah, whom you killed between the sanctuary and the altar.

translations.kjv: Verily I say unto you, All these things shall come upon this generation.
translations.ylt: verily I say to you, all these things shall come upon this generation.
translations.web: Most certainly I tell you, all these things will come upon this generation.

translations.kjv: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, thou that killest the prophets, and stonest them which are sent unto thee, how often would I have gathered thy children together, even as a hen gathereth her chickens under her wings, and ye would not!
translations.ylt: `Jerusalem, Jerusalem, that art killing the prophets, and stoning those sent unto thee, how often did I will to gather thy children together, as a hen doth gather her own chickens under the wings, and ye did not will.
translations.web: “Jerusalem, Jerusalem, who kills the prophets and stones those who are sent to her! How often I would have gathered your children together, even as a hen gathers her chicks under her wings, and you would not!

translations.kjv: Behold, your house is left unto you desolate.
translations.ylt: Lo, left desolate to you is your house;
translations.web: Behold, your house is left to you desolate.

translations.kjv: For I say unto you, Ye shall not see me henceforth, till ye shall say, Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord.
translations.ylt: for I say to you, ye may not see me henceforth, till ye may say, Blessed is he who is coming in the name of the Lord.'
translations.web: For I tell you, you will not see me from now on, until you say, ‘Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!’”

translations.kjv: And Jesus went out, and departed from the temple: and his disciples came to him for to shew him the buildings of the temple.
translations.ylt: And having gone forth, Jesus departed from the temple, and his disciples came near to show him the buildings of the temple,
translations.web: Jesus went out from the temple, and was going on his way. His disciples came to him to show him the buildings of the temple.

translations.kjv: And Jesus said unto them, See ye not all these things? verily I say unto you, There shall not be left here one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.
translations.ylt: and Jesus said to them, `Do ye not see all these? verily I say to you, There may not be left here a stone upon a stone, that shall not be thrown down.'
translations.web: But he answered them, “You see all of these things, don’t you? Most certainly I tell you, there will not be left here one stone on another, that will not be thrown down.”

translations.kjv: And as he sat upon the mount of Olives, the disciples came unto him privately, saying, Tell us, when shall these things be? and what shall be the sign of thy coming, and of the end of the world?
translations.ylt: And when he is sitting on the mount of the Olives, the disciples came near to him by himself, saying, `Tell us, when shall these be? and what is the sign of thy presence, and of the full end of the age?'
translations.web: As he sat on the Mount of Olives, the disciples came to him privately, saying, “Tell us, when will these things be? What is the sign of your coming, and of the end of the age?”

translations.kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto them, Take heed that no man deceive you.
translations.ylt: And Jesus answering said to them, `Take heed that no one may lead you astray,
translations.web: Jesus answered them, “Be careful that no one leads you astray.

translations.kjv: For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and shall deceive many.
translations.ylt: for many shall come in my name, saying, I am the Christ, and they shall lead many astray,
translations.web: For many will come in my name, saying, ‘I am the Christ,’ and will lead many astray.

translations.kjv: And ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars: see that ye be not troubled: for all these things must come to pass, but the end is not yet.
translations.ylt: and ye shall begin to hear of wars, and reports of wars; see, be not troubled, for it behoveth all these to come to pass, but the end is not yet.
translations.web: You will hear of wars and rumors of wars. See that you aren’t troubled, for all this must happen, but the end is not yet.

translations.kjv: For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom: and there shall be famines, and pestilences, and earthquakes, in divers places.
translations.ylt: `For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom, and there shall be famines, and pestilences, and earthquakes, in divers places;
translations.web: For nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom; and there will be famines, plagues, and earthquakes in various places.

translations.kjv: All these are the beginning of sorrows.
translations.ylt: and all these are the beginning of sorrows;
translations.web: But all these things are the beginning of birth pains.

translations.kjv: Then shall they deliver you up to be afflicted, and shall kill you: and ye shall be hated of all nations for my name’s sake.
translations.ylt: then they shall deliver you up to tribulation, and shall kill you, and ye shall be hated by all the nations because of my name;
translations.web: “Then they will deliver you up to oppression and will kill you. You will be hated by all of the nations for my name’s sake.

translations.kjv: And then shall many be offended, and shall betray one another, and shall hate one another.
translations.ylt: and then shall many be stumbled, and they shall deliver up one another, and shall hate one another.
translations.web: Then many will stumble, and will deliver up one another, and will hate one another.

translations.kjv: And many false prophets shall rise, and shall deceive many.
translations.ylt: `And many false prophets shall arise, and shall lead many astray;
translations.web: Many false prophets will arise and will lead many astray.

translations.kjv: And because iniquity shall abound, the love of many shall wax cold.
translations.ylt: and because of the abounding of the lawlessness, the love of the many shall become cold;
translations.web: Because iniquity will be multiplied, the love of many will grow cold.

translations.kjv: But he that shall endure unto the end, the same shall be saved.
translations.ylt: but he who did endure to the end, he shall be saved;
translations.web: But he who endures to the end will be saved.

translations.kjv: And this gospel of the kingdom shall be preached in all the world for a witness unto all nations; and then shall the end come.
translations.ylt: and this good news of the reign shall be proclaimed in all the world, for a testimony to all the nations; and then shall the end arrive.
translations.web: This Good News of the Kingdom will be preached in the whole world for a testimony to all the nations, and then the end will come.

translations.kjv: When ye therefore shall see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, stand in the holy place, (whoso readeth, let him understand:)
translations.ylt: `Whenever, therefore, ye may see the abomination of the desolation, that was spoken of through Daniel the prophet, standing in the holy place (whoever is reading let him observe)
translations.web: “When, therefore, you see the abomination of desolation, which was spoken of through Daniel the prophet, standing in the holy place (let the reader understand),

translations.kjv: Then let them which be in Judea flee into the mountains:
translations.ylt: then those in Judea--let them flee to the mounts;
translations.web: then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains.

translations.kjv: Let him which is on the housetop not come down to take any thing out of his house:
translations.ylt: he on the house-top--let him not come down to take up any thing out of his house;
translations.web: Let him who is on the housetop not go down to take out the things that are in his house.

translations.kjv: Neither let him which is in the field return back to take his clothes.
translations.ylt: and he in the field--let him not turn back to take his garments.
translations.web: Let him who is in the field not return back to get his clothes.

translations.kjv: And woe unto them that are with child, and to them that give suck in those days!
translations.ylt: `And woe to those with child, and to those giving suck in those days;
translations.web: But woe to those who are with child and to nursing mothers in those days!

translations.kjv: But pray ye that your flight be not in the winter, neither on the sabbath day:
translations.ylt: and pray ye that your flight may not be in winter, nor on a sabbath;
translations.web: Pray that your flight will not be in the winter nor on a Sabbath,

translations.kjv: For then shall be great tribulation, such as was not since the beginning of the world to this time, no, nor ever shall be.
translations.ylt: for there shall be then great tribulation, such as was not from the beginning of the world till now, no, nor may be.
translations.web: for then there will be great suffering, such as has not been from the beginning of the world until now, no, nor ever will be.

translations.kjv: And except those days should be shortened, there should no flesh be saved: but for the elect’s sake those days shall be shortened.
translations.ylt: And if those days were not shortened, no flesh would have been saved; but because of the chosen, shall those days be shortened.
translations.web: Unless those days had been shortened, no flesh would have been saved. But for the sake of the chosen ones, those days will be shortened.

translations.kjv: Then if any man shall say unto you, Lo, here is Christ, or there; believe it not.
translations.ylt: `Then if any one may say to you, Lo, here is the Christ! or here! ye may not believe;
translations.web: “Then if any man tells you, ‘Behold, here is the Christ!’ or, ‘There!’ don’t believe it.

translations.kjv: For there shall arise false Christs, and false prophets, and shall shew great signs and wonders; insomuch that, if it were possible, they shall deceive the very elect.
translations.ylt: for there shall arise false Christs, and false prophets, and they shall give great signs and wonders, so as to lead astray, if possible, also the chosen.
translations.web: For false christs and false prophets will arise, and they will show great signs and wonders, so as to lead astray, if possible, even the chosen ones.

translations.kjv: Behold, I have told you before.
translations.ylt: Lo, I did tell you beforehand.
translations.web: “Behold, I have told you beforehand.

translations.kjv: Wherefore if they shall say unto you, Behold, he is in the desert; go not forth: behold, he is in the secret chambers; believe it not.
translations.ylt: `If therefore they may say to you, Lo, in the wilderness he is, ye may not go forth; lo, in the inner chambers, ye may not believe;
translations.web: “If therefore they tell you, ‘Behold, he is in the wilderness,’ don’t go out; or ‘Behold, he is in the inner rooms,’ don’t believe it.

translations.kjv: For as the lightning cometh out of the east, and shineth even unto the west; so shall also the coming of the Son of man be.
translations.ylt: for as the lightning doth come forth from the east, and doth appear unto the west, so shall be also the presence of the Son of Man;
translations.web: For as the lightning flashes from the east, and is seen even to the west, so will the coming of the Son of Man be.

translations.kjv: For wheresoever the carcase is, there will the eagles be gathered together.
translations.ylt: for wherever the carcase may be, there shall the eagles be gathered together.
translations.web: For wherever the carcass is, that is where the vultures gather together.

translations.kjv: Immediately after the tribulation of those days shall the sun be darkened, and the moon shall not give her light, and the stars shall fall from heaven, and the powers of the heavens shall be shaken:
translations.ylt: `And immediately after the tribulation of those days, the sun shall be darkened, and the moon shall not give her light, and the stars shall fall from the heaven, and the powers of the heavens shall be shaken;
translations.web: “But immediately after the suffering of those days, the sun will be darkened, the moon will not give its light, the stars will fall from the sky, and the powers of the heavens will be shaken;

translations.kjv: And then shall appear the sign of the Son of man in heaven: and then shall all the tribes of the earth mourn, and they shall see the Son of man coming in the clouds of heaven with power and great glory.
translations.ylt: and then shall appear the sign of the Son of Man in the heaven; and then shall all the tribes of the earth smite the breast, and they shall see the Son of Man coming upon the clouds of the heaven, with power and much glory;
translations.web: and then the sign of the Son of Man will appear in the sky. Then all the tribes of the earth will mourn, and they will see the Son of Man coming on the clouds of the sky with power and great glory.

translations.kjv: And he shall send his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from one end of heaven to the other.
translations.ylt: and he shall send his messengers with a great sound of a trumpet, and they shall gather together his chosen from the four winds, from the ends of the heavens unto the ends thereof.
translations.web: He will send out his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they will gather together his chosen ones from the four winds, from one end of the sky to the other.

translations.kjv: Now learn a parable of the fig tree; When his branch is yet tender, and putteth forth leaves, ye know that summer is nigh:
translations.ylt: `And from the fig-tree learn ye the simile: When already its branch may have become tender, and the leaves it may put forth, ye know that summer is nigh,
translations.web: “Now from the fig tree learn this parable: When its branch has now become tender and produces its leaves, you know that the summer is near.

translations.kjv: So likewise ye, when ye shall see all these things, know that it is near, even at the doors.
translations.ylt: so also ye, when ye may see all these, ye know that it is nigh--at the doors.
translations.web: Even so you also, when you see all these things, know that he is near, even at the doors.

translations.kjv: Verily I say unto you, This generation shall not pass, till all these things be fulfilled.
translations.ylt: Verily I say to you, this generation may not pass away till all these may come to pass.
translations.web: Most certainly I tell you, this generation will not pass away until all these things are accomplished.

translations.kjv: Heaven and earth shall pass away, but my words shall not pass away.
translations.ylt: The heaven and the earth shall pass away, but my words shall not pass away.
translations.web: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will not pass away.

translations.kjv: But of that day and hour knoweth no man, no, not the angels of heaven, but my Father only.
translations.ylt: `And concerning that day and the hour no one hath known--not even the messengers of the heavens--except my Father only;
translations.web: “But no one knows of that day and hour, not even the angels of heaven, but my Father only.

translations.kjv: But as the days of Noe were, so shall also the coming of the Son of man be.
translations.ylt: and as the days of Noah--so shall be also the presence of the Son of Man;
translations.web: As the days of Noah were, so will the coming of the Son of Man be.

translations.kjv: For as in the days that were before the flood they were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, until the day that Noe entered into the ark,
translations.ylt: for as they were, in the days before the flood, eating, and drinking, marrying, and giving in marriage, till the day Noah entered into the ark,
translations.web: For as in those days which were before the flood they were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, until the day that Noah entered into the ship,

translations.kjv: And knew not until the flood came, and took them all away; so shall also the coming of the Son of man be.
translations.ylt: and they did not know till the flood came and took all away; so shall be also the presence of the Son of Man.
translations.web: and they didn’t know until the flood came and took them all away, so will the coming of the Son of Man be.

translations.kjv: Then shall two be in the field; the one shall be taken, and the other left.
translations.ylt: Then two men shall be in the field, the one is received, and the one is left;
translations.web: Then two men will be in the field: one will be taken and one will be left.

translations.kjv: Two women shall be grinding at the mill; the one shall be taken, and the other left.
translations.ylt: two women shall be grinding in the mill, one is received, and one is left.
translations.web: Two women will be grinding at the mill: one will be taken and one will be left.

translations.kjv: Watch therefore: for ye know not what hour your Lord doth come.
translations.ylt: `Watch ye therefore, because ye have not known in what hour your Lord doth come;
translations.web: Watch therefore, for you don’t know in what hour your Lord comes.

translations.kjv: But know this, that if the goodman of the house had known in what watch the thief would come, he would have watched, and would not have suffered his house to be broken up.
translations.ylt: and this know, that if the master of the house had known in what watch the thief doth come, he had watched, and not suffered his house to be broken through;
translations.web: But know this, that if the master of the house had known in what watch of the night the thief was coming, he would have watched, and would not have allowed his house to be broken into.

translations.kjv: Therefore be ye also ready: for in such an hour as ye think not the Son of man cometh.
translations.ylt: because of this also ye, become ye ready, because in what hour ye do not think, the Son of Man doth come.
translations.web: Therefore also be ready, for in an hour that you don’t expect, the Son of Man will come.

translations.kjv: Who then is a faithful and wise servant, whom his lord hath made ruler over his household, to give them meat in due season?
translations.ylt: `Who, then, is the servant, faithful and wise, whom his lord did set over his household, to give them the nourishment in season?
translations.web: “Who then is the faithful and wise servant, whom his lord has set over his household, to give them their food in due season?

translations.kjv: Blessed is that servant, whom his lord when he cometh shall find so doing.
translations.ylt: Happy that servant, whom his lord, having come, shall find doing so;
translations.web: Blessed is that servant whom his lord finds doing so when he comes.

translations.kjv: Verily I say unto you, That he shall make him ruler over all his goods.
translations.ylt: verily I say to you, that over all his substance he will set him.
translations.web: Most certainly I tell you that he will set him over all that he has.

translations.kjv: But and if that evil servant shall say in his heart, My lord delayeth his coming;
translations.ylt: `And, if that evil servant may say in his heart, My Lord doth delay to come,
translations.web: But if that evil servant should say in his heart, ‘My lord is delaying his coming,’

translations.kjv: And shall begin to smite his fellowservants, and to eat and drink with the drunken;
translations.ylt: and may begin to beat the fellow-servants, and to eat and to drink with the drunken,
translations.web: and begins to beat his fellow servants, and eat and drink with the drunkards,

translations.kjv: The lord of that servant shall come in a day when he looketh not for him, and in an hour that he is not aware of,
translations.ylt: the lord of that servant will arrive in a day when he doth not expect, and in an hour of which he doth not know,
translations.web: the lord of that servant will come in a day when he doesn’t expect it and in an hour when he doesn’t know it,

translations.kjv: And shall cut him asunder, and appoint him his portion with the hypocrites: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
translations.ylt: and will cut him off, and his portion with the hypocrites will appoint; there shall be the weeping and the gnashing of the teeth.
translations.web: and will cut him in pieces and appoint his portion with the hypocrites. That is where the weeping and grinding of teeth will be.

translations.kjv: Then shall the kingdom of heaven be likened unto ten virgins, which took their lamps, and went forth to meet the bridegroom.
translations.ylt: `Then shall the reign of the heavens be likened to ten virgins, who, having taken their lamps, went forth to meet the bridegroom;
translations.web: “Then the Kingdom of Heaven will be like ten virgins who took their lamps and went out to meet the bridegroom.

translations.kjv: And five of them were wise, and five were foolish.
translations.ylt: and five of them were prudent, and five foolish;
translations.web: Five of them were foolish, and five were wise.

translations.kjv: They that were foolish took their lamps, and took no oil with them:
translations.ylt: they who were foolish having taken their lamps, did not take with themselves oil;
translations.web: Those who were foolish, when they took their lamps, took no oil with them,

translations.kjv: But the wise took oil in their vessels with their lamps.
translations.ylt: and the prudent took oil in their vessels, with their lamps.
translations.web: but the wise took oil in their vessels with their lamps.

translations.kjv: While the bridegroom tarried, they all slumbered and slept.
translations.ylt: `And the bridegroom tarrying, they all nodded and were sleeping,
translations.web: Now while the bridegroom delayed, they all slumbered and slept.

translations.kjv: And at midnight there was a cry made, Behold, the bridegroom cometh; go ye out to meet him.
translations.ylt: and in the middle of the night a cry was made, Lo, the bridegroom doth come; go ye forth to meet him.
translations.web: But at midnight there was a cry, ‘Behold! The bridegroom is coming! Come out to meet him!’

translations.kjv: Then all those virgins arose, and trimmed their lamps.
translations.ylt: `Then rose all those virgins, and trimmed their lamps,
translations.web: Then all those virgins arose, and trimmed their lamps.

translations.kjv: And the foolish said unto the wise, Give us of your oil; for our lamps are gone out.
translations.ylt: and the foolish said to the prudent, Give us of your oil, because our lamps are going out;
translations.web: The foolish said to the wise, ‘Give us some of your oil, for our lamps are going out.’

translations.kjv: But the wise answered, saying, Not so; lest there be not enough for us and you: but go ye rather to them that sell, and buy for yourselves.
translations.ylt: and the prudent answered, saying--Lest there may not be sufficient for us and you, go ye rather unto those selling, and buy for yourselves.
translations.web: But the wise answered, saying, ‘What if there isn’t enough for us and you? You go rather to those who sell, and buy for yourselves.’

translations.kjv: And while they went to buy, the bridegroom came; and they that were ready went in with him to the marriage: and the door was shut.
translations.ylt: `And while they are going away to buy, the bridegroom came, and those ready went in with him to the marriage-feasts, and the door was shut;
translations.web: While they went away to buy, the bridegroom came, and those who were ready went in with him to the wedding feast, and the door was shut.

translations.kjv: Afterward came also the other virgins, saying, Lord, Lord, open to us.
translations.ylt: and afterwards come also do the rest of the virgins, saying, Sir, sir, open to us;
translations.web: Afterward the other virgins also came, saying, ‘Lord, Lord, open to us.’

translations.kjv: But he answered and said, Verily I say unto you, I know you not.
translations.ylt: and he answering said, Verily I say to you, I have not known you.
translations.web: But he answered, ‘Most certainly I tell you, I don’t know you.’

translations.kjv: Watch therefore, for ye know neither the day nor the hour wherein the Son of man cometh.
translations.ylt: `Watch therefore, for ye have not known the day nor the hour in which the Son of Man doth come.
translations.web: Watch therefore, for you don’t know the day nor the hour in which the Son of Man is coming.

translations.kjv: For the kingdom of heaven is as a man travelling into a far country, who called his own servants, and delivered unto them his goods.
translations.ylt: `For--as a man going abroad did call his own servants, and did deliver to them his substance,
translations.web: “For it is like a man going into another country, who called his own servants and entrusted his goods to them.

translations.kjv: And unto one he gave five talents, to another two, and to another one; to every man according to his several ability; and straightway took his journey.
translations.ylt: and to one he gave five talents, and to another two, and to another one, to each according to his several ability, went abroad immediately.
translations.web: To one he gave five talents, to another two, to another one, to each according to his own ability. Then he went on his journey.

translations.kjv: Then he that had received the five talents went and traded with the same, and made them other five talents.
translations.ylt: `And he who did receive the five talents, having gone, wrought with them, and made other five talents;
translations.web: Immediately he who received the five talents went and traded with them, and made another five talents.

translations.kjv: And likewise he that had received two, he also gained other two.
translations.ylt: in like manner also he who received the two, he gained, also he, other two;
translations.web: In the same way, he also who got the two gained another two.

translations.kjv: But he that had received one went and digged in the earth, and hid his lord’s money.
translations.ylt: and he who did receive the one, having gone away, digged in the earth, and hid his lord's money.
translations.web: But he who received the one talent went away and dug in the earth and hid his lord’s money.

translations.kjv: After a long time the lord of those servants cometh, and reckoneth with them.
translations.ylt: `And after a long time cometh the lord of those servants, and taketh reckoning with them;
translations.web: “Now after a long time the lord of those servants came, and settled accounts with them.

translations.kjv: And so he that had received five talents came and brought other five talents, saying, Lord, thou deliveredst unto me five talents: behold, I have gained beside them five talents more.
translations.ylt: and he who did receive the five talents having come, brought other five talents, saying, `Sir, five talents thou didst deliver to me; lo, other five talents did I gain besides them.
translations.web: He who received the five talents came and brought another five talents, saying, ‘Lord, you delivered to me five talents. Behold, I have gained another five talents in addition to them.’

translations.kjv: His lord said unto him, Well done, thou good and faithful servant: thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things: enter thou into the joy of thy lord.
translations.ylt: `And his lord said to him, Well done, servant, good and faithful, over a few things thou wast faithful, over many things I will set thee; enter into the joy of thy lord.
translations.web: “His lord said to him, ‘Well done, good and faithful servant. You have been faithful over a few things, I will set you over many things. Enter into the joy of your lord.’

translations.kjv: He also that had received two talents came and said, Lord, thou deliveredst unto me two talents: behold, I have gained two other talents beside them.
translations.ylt: `And he who also did receive the two talents having come, said, Sir, two talents thou didst deliver to me; lo, other two talents I did gain besides them.
translations.web: “He also who got the two talents came and said, ‘Lord, you delivered to me two talents. Behold, I have gained another two talents in addition to them.’

translations.kjv: His lord said unto him, Well done, good and faithful servant; thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things: enter thou into the joy of thy lord.
translations.ylt: `His lord said to him, Well done, servant, good and faithful, over a few things thou wast faithful, over many things I will set thee; enter into the joy of thy lord.
translations.web: “His lord said to him, ‘Well done, good and faithful servant. You have been faithful over a few things. I will set you over many things. Enter into the joy of your lord.’

translations.kjv: Then he which had received the one talent came and said, Lord, I knew thee that thou art an hard man, reaping where thou hast not sown, and gathering where thou hast not strawed:
translations.ylt: `And he also who hath received the one talent having come, said, Sir, I knew thee, that thou art a hard man, reaping where thou didst not sow, and gathering from whence thou didst not scatter;
translations.web: “He also who had received the one talent came and said, ‘Lord, I knew you that you are a hard man, reaping where you didn’t sow, and gathering where you didn’t scatter.

translations.kjv: And I was afraid, and went and hid thy talent in the earth: lo, there thou hast that is thine.
translations.ylt: and having been afraid, having gone away, I hid thy talent in the earth; lo, thou hast thine own!
translations.web: I was afraid, and went away and hid your talent in the earth. Behold, you have what is yours.’

translations.kjv: His lord answered and said unto him, Thou wicked and slothful servant, thou knewest that I reap where I sowed not, and gather where I have not strawed:
translations.ylt: `And his lord answering said to him, Evil servant, and slothful, thou hadst known that I reap where I did not sow, and I gather whence I did not scatter!
translations.web: “But his lord answered him, ‘You wicked and slothful servant. You knew that I reap where I didn’t sow, and gather where I didn’t scatter.

translations.kjv: Thou oughtest therefore to have put my money to the exchangers, and then at my coming I should have received mine own with usury.
translations.ylt: it behoved thee then to put my money to the money-lenders, and having come I had received mine own with increase.
translations.web: You ought therefore to have deposited my money with the bankers, and at my coming I should have received back my own with interest.

translations.kjv: Take therefore the talent from him, and give it unto him which hath ten talents.
translations.ylt: `Take therefore from him the talent, and give to him having the ten talents,
translations.web: Take away therefore the talent from him and give it to him who has the ten talents.

translations.kjv: For unto every one that hath shall be given, and he shall have abundance: but from him that hath not shall be taken away even that which he hath.
translations.ylt: for to every one having shall be given, and he shall have overabundance, and from him who is not having, even that which he hath shall be taken from him;
translations.web: For to everyone who has will be given, and he will have abundance, but from him who doesn’t have, even that which he has will be taken away.

translations.kjv: And cast ye the unprofitable servant into outer darkness: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
translations.ylt: and the unprofitable servant cast ye forth to the outer darkness; there shall be the weeping and the gnashing of the teeth.
translations.web: Throw out the unprofitable servant into the outer darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.’

translations.kjv: When the Son of man shall come in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then shall he sit upon the throne of his glory:
translations.ylt: `And whenever the Son of Man may come in his glory, and all the holy messengers with him, then he shall sit upon a throne of his glory;
translations.web: “But when the Son of Man comes in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then he will sit on the throne of his glory.

translations.kjv: And before him shall be gathered all nations: and he shall separate them one from another, as a shepherd divideth his sheep from the goats:
translations.ylt: and gathered together before him shall be all the nations, and he shall separate them from one another, as the shepherd doth separate the sheep from the goats,
translations.web: Before him all the nations will be gathered, and he will separate them one from another, as a shepherd separates the sheep from the goats.

translations.kjv: And he shall set the sheep on his right hand, but the goats on the left.
translations.ylt: and he shall set the sheep indeed on his right hand, and the goats on the left.
translations.web: He will set the sheep on his right hand, but the goats on the left.

translations.kjv: Then shall the King say unto them on his right hand, Come, ye blessed of my Father, inherit the kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world:
translations.ylt: `Then shall the king say to those on his right hand, Come ye, the blessed of my Father, inherit the reign that hath been prepared for you from the foundation of the world;
translations.web: Then the King will tell those on his right hand, ‘Come, blessed of my Father, inherit the Kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world;

translations.kjv: For I was an hungred, and ye gave me meat: I was thirsty, and ye gave me drink: I was a stranger, and ye took me in:
translations.ylt: for I did hunger, and ye gave me to eat; I did thirst, and ye gave me to drink; I was a stranger, and ye received me;
translations.web: for I was hungry and you gave me food to eat. I was thirsty and you gave me drink. I was a stranger and you took me in.

translations.kjv: Naked, and ye clothed me: I was sick, and ye visited me: I was in prison, and ye came unto me.
translations.ylt: naked, and ye put around me; I was infirm, and ye looked after me; in prison I was, and ye came unto me.
translations.web: I was naked and you clothed me. I was sick and you visited me. I was in prison and you came to me.’

translations.kjv: Then shall the righteous answer him, saying, Lord, when saw we thee an hungred, and fed thee? or thirsty, and gave thee drink?
translations.ylt: `Then shall the righteous answer him, saying, Lord, when did we see thee hungering, and we nourished? or thirsting, and we gave to drink?
translations.web: “Then the righteous will answer him, saying, ‘Lord, when did we see you hungry and feed you, or thirsty and give you a drink?

translations.kjv: When saw we thee a stranger, and took thee in? or naked, and clothed thee?
translations.ylt: and when did we see thee a stranger, and we received? or naked, and we put around?
translations.web: When did we see you as a stranger and take you in, or naked and clothe you?

translations.kjv: Or when saw we thee sick, or in prison, and came unto thee?
translations.ylt: and when did we see thee infirm, or in prison, and we came unto thee?
translations.web: When did we see you sick or in prison and come to you?’

translations.kjv: And the King shall answer and say unto them, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as ye have done it unto one of the least of these my brethren, ye have done it unto me.
translations.ylt: `And the king answering, shall say to them, Verily I say to you, Inasmuch as ye did it to one of these my brethren--the least--to me ye did it.
translations.web: “The King will answer them, ‘Most certainly I tell you, because you did it to one of the least of these my brothers, you did it to me.’

translations.kjv: Then shall he say also unto them on the left hand, Depart from me, ye cursed, into everlasting fire, prepared for the devil and his angels:
translations.ylt: Then shall he say also to those on the left hand, Go ye from me, the cursed, to the fire, the age-during, that hath been prepared for the Devil and his messengers;
translations.web: Then he will say also to those on the left hand, ‘Depart from me, you cursed, into the eternal fire which is prepared for the devil and his angels;

translations.kjv: For I was an hungred, and ye gave me no meat: I was thirsty, and ye gave me no drink:
translations.ylt: for I did hunger, and ye gave me not to eat; I did thirst, and ye gave me not to drink;
translations.web: for I was hungry, and you didn’t give me food to eat; I was thirsty, and you gave me no drink;

translations.kjv: I was a stranger, and ye took me not in: naked, and ye clothed me not: sick, and in prison, and ye visited me not.
translations.ylt: a stranger I was, and ye did not receive me; naked, and ye put not around me; infirm, and in prison, and ye did not look after me.
translations.web: I was a stranger, and you didn’t take me in; naked, and you didn’t clothe me; sick, and in prison, and you didn’t visit me.’

translations.kjv: Then shall they also answer him, saying, Lord, when saw we thee an hungred, or athirst, or a stranger, or naked, or sick, or in prison, and did not minister unto thee?
translations.ylt: `Then shall they answer, they also, saying, Lord, when did we see thee hungering, or thirsting, or a stranger, or naked, or infirm, or in prison, and we did not minister to thee?
translations.web: “Then they will also answer, saying, ‘Lord, when did we see you hungry, or thirsty, or a stranger, or naked, or sick, or in prison, and didn’t help you?’

translations.kjv: Then shall he answer them, saying, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as ye did it not to one of the least of these, ye did it not to me.
translations.ylt: `Then shall he answer them, saying, Verily I say to you, Inasmuch as ye did it not to one of these, the least, ye did it not to me.
translations.web: “Then he will answer them, saying, ‘Most certainly I tell you, because you didn’t do it to one of the least of these, you didn’t do it to me.’

translations.kjv: And these shall go away into everlasting punishment: but the righteous into life eternal.
translations.ylt: And these shall go away to punishment age-during, but the righteous to life age-during.'
translations.web: These will go away into eternal punishment, but the righteous into eternal life.”

translations.kjv: And it came to pass, when Jesus had finished all these sayings, he said unto his disciples,
translations.ylt: And it came to pass, when Jesus finished all these words, he said to his disciples,
translations.web: When Jesus had finished all these words, he said to his disciples,

translations.kjv: Ye know that after two days is the feast of the passover, and the Son of man is betrayed to be crucified.
translations.ylt: `Ye have known that after two days the passover cometh, and the Son of Man is delivered up to be crucified.'
translations.web: “You know that after two days the Passover is coming, and the Son of Man will be delivered up to be crucified.”

translations.kjv: Then assembled together the chief priests, and the scribes, and the elders of the people, unto the palace of the high priest, who was called Caiaphas,
translations.ylt: Then were gathered together the chief priests, and the scribes, and the elders of the people, to the court of the chief priest who was called Caiaphas;
translations.web: Then the chief priests, the scribes, and the elders of the people were gathered together in the court of the high priest, who was called Caiaphas.

translations.kjv: And consulted that they might take Jesus by subtilty, and kill him.
translations.ylt: and they consulted together that they might take Jesus by guile, and kill him,
translations.web: They took counsel together that they might take Jesus by deceit and kill him.

translations.kjv: But they said, Not on the feast day, lest there be an uproar among the people.
translations.ylt: and they said, `Not in the feast, that there may not be a tumult among the people.'
translations.web: But they said, “Not during the feast, lest a riot occur among the people.”

translations.kjv: Now when Jesus was in Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper,
translations.ylt: And Jesus having been in Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper,
translations.web: Now when Jesus was in Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper,

translations.kjv: There came unto him a woman having an alabaster box of very precious ointment, and poured it on his head, as he sat at meat.
translations.ylt: there came to him a woman having an alabaster box of ointment, very precious, and she poured on his head as he is reclining (at meat).
translations.web: a woman came to him having an alabaster jar of very expensive ointment, and she poured it on his head as he sat at the table.

translations.kjv: But when his disciples saw it, they had indignation, saying, To what purpose is this waste?
translations.ylt: And having seen it, his disciples were much displeased, saying, `To what purpose is this waste?
translations.web: But when his disciples saw this, they were indignant, saying, “Why this waste?

translations.kjv: For this ointment might have been sold for much, and given to the poor.
translations.ylt: for this ointment could have been sold for much, and given to the poor.'
translations.web: For this ointment might have been sold for much and given to the poor.”

translations.kjv: When Jesus understood it, he said unto them, Why trouble ye the woman? for she hath wrought a good work upon me.
translations.ylt: And Jesus having known, said to them, `Why do ye give trouble to the woman? for a good work she wrought for me;
translations.web: However, knowing this, Jesus said to them, “Why do you trouble the woman? She has done a good work for me.

translations.kjv: For ye have the poor always with you; but me ye have not always.
translations.ylt: for the poor always ye have with you, and me ye have not always;
translations.web: For you always have the poor with you, but you don’t always have me.

translations.kjv: For in that she hath poured this ointment on my body, she did it for my burial.
translations.ylt: for she having put this ointment on my body--for my burial she did it.
translations.web: For in pouring this ointment on my body, she did it to prepare me for burial.

translations.kjv: Verily I say unto you, Wheresoever this gospel shall be preached in the whole world, there shall also this, that this woman hath done, be told for a memorial of her.
translations.ylt: Verily I say to you, Wherever this good news may be proclaimed in the whole world, what this one did shall also be spoken of--for a memorial of her.'
translations.web: Most certainly I tell you, wherever this Good News is preached in the whole world, what this woman has done will also be spoken of as a memorial of her.”

translations.kjv: Then one of the twelve, called Judas Iscariot, went unto the chief priests,
translations.ylt: Then one of the twelve, who is called Judas Iscariot, having gone unto the chief priests, said,
translations.web: Then one of the twelve, who was called Judas Iscariot, went to the chief priests

translations.kjv: And said unto them, What will ye give me, and I will deliver him unto you? And they covenanted with him for thirty pieces of silver.
translations.ylt: `What are ye willing to give me, and I will deliver him up to you?' and they weighed out to him thirty silverlings,
translations.web: and said, “What are you willing to give me if I deliver him to you?” So they weighed out for him thirty pieces of silver.

translations.kjv: And from that time he sought opportunity to betray him.
translations.ylt: and from that time he was seeking a convenient season to deliver him up.
translations.web: From that time he sought opportunity to betray him.

translations.kjv: Now the first day of the feast of unleavened bread the disciples came to Jesus, saying unto him, Where wilt thou that we prepare for thee to eat the passover?
translations.ylt: And on the first day of the unleavened food came the disciples near to Jesus, saying to him, `Where wilt thou that we may prepare for thee to eat the passover?'
translations.web: Now on the first day of unleavened bread, the disciples came to Jesus, saying to him, “Where do you want us to prepare for you to eat the Passover?”

translations.kjv: And he said, Go into the city to such a man, and say unto him, The Master saith, My time is at hand; I will keep the passover at thy house with my disciples.
translations.ylt: and he said, `Go away to the city, unto such a one, and say to him, The Teacher saith, My time is nigh; near thee I keep the passover, with my disciples;'
translations.web: He said, “Go into the city to a certain person, and tell him, ‘The Teacher says, “My time is at hand. I will keep the Passover at your house with my disciples.”’”

translations.kjv: And the disciples did as Jesus had appointed them; and they made ready the passover.
translations.ylt: and the disciples did as Jesus appointed them, and prepared the passover.
translations.web: The disciples did as Jesus commanded them, and they prepared the Passover.

translations.kjv: Now when the even was come, he sat down with the twelve.
translations.ylt: And evening having come, he was reclining (at meat) with the twelve,
translations.web: Now when evening had come, he was reclining at the table with the twelve disciples.

translations.kjv: And as they did eat, he said, Verily I say unto you, that one of you shall betray me.
translations.ylt: and while they are eating, he said, `Verily I say to you, that one of you shall deliver me up.'
translations.web: As they were eating, he said, “Most certainly I tell you that one of you will betray me.”

translations.kjv: And they were exceeding sorrowful, and began every one of them to say unto him, Lord, is it I?
translations.ylt: And being grieved exceedingly, they began to say to him, each of them, `Is it I, Sir?'
translations.web: They were exceedingly sorrowful, and each began to ask him, “It isn’t me, is it, Lord?”

translations.kjv: And he answered and said, He that dippeth his hand with me in the dish, the same shall betray me.
translations.ylt: And he answering said, `He who did dip with me the hand in the dish, he will deliver me up;
translations.web: He answered, “He who dipped his hand with me in the dish will betray me.

translations.kjv: The Son of man goeth as it is written of him: but woe unto that man by whom the Son of man is betrayed! it had been good for that man if he had not been born.
translations.ylt: the Son of Man doth indeed go, as it hath been written concerning him, but woe to that man through whom the Son of Man is delivered up! good it were for him if that man had not been born.'
translations.web: The Son of Man goes even as it is written of him, but woe to that man through whom the Son of Man is betrayed! It would be better for that man if he had not been born.”

translations.kjv: Then Judas, which betrayed him, answered and said, Master, is it I? He said unto him, Thou hast said.
translations.ylt: And Judas--he who delivered him up--answering said, `Is it I, Rabbi?' He saith to him, `Thou hast said.'
translations.web: Judas, who betrayed him, answered, “It isn’t me, is it, Rabbi?” He said to him, “You said it.”

translations.kjv: And as they were eating, Jesus took bread, and blessed it, and brake it, and gave it to the disciples, and said, Take, eat; this is my body.
translations.ylt: And while they were eating, Jesus having taken the bread, and having blessed, did brake, and was giving to the disciples, and said, `Take, eat, this is my body;'
translations.web: As they were eating, Jesus took bread, gave thanks for it, and broke it. He gave to the disciples and said, “Take, eat; this is my body.”

translations.kjv: And he took the cup, and gave thanks, and gave it to them, saying, Drink ye all of it;
translations.ylt: and having taken the cup, and having given thanks, he gave to them, saying, `Drink ye of it--all;
translations.web: He took the cup, gave thanks, and gave to them, saying, “All of you drink it,

translations.kjv: For this is my blood of the new testament, which is shed for many for the remission of sins.
translations.ylt: for this is my blood of the new covenant, that for many is being poured out--to remission of sins;
translations.web: for this is my blood of the new covenant, which is poured out for many for the remission of sins.

translations.kjv: But I say unto you, I will not drink henceforth of this fruit of the vine, until that day when I drink it new with you in my Father’s kingdom.
translations.ylt: and I say to you, that I may not drink henceforth on this produce of the vine, till that day when I may drink it with you new in the reign of my Father.'
translations.web: But I tell you that I will not drink of this fruit of the vine from now on, until that day when I drink it anew with you in my Father’s Kingdom.”

translations.kjv: And when they had sung an hymn, they went out into the mount of Olives.
translations.ylt: And having sung a hymn, they went forth to the mount of the Olives;
translations.web: When they had sung a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.

translations.kjv: Then saith Jesus unto them, All ye shall be offended because of me this night: for it is written, I will smite the shepherd, and the sheep of the flock shall be scattered abroad.
translations.ylt: then saith Jesus to them, `All ye shall be stumbled at me this night; for it hath been written, I will smite the shepherd, and the sheep of the flock shall be scattered abroad;
translations.web: Then Jesus said to them, “All of you will be made to stumble because of me tonight, for it is written, ‘I will strike the shepherd, and the sheep of the flock will be scattered.’

translations.kjv: But after I am risen again, I will go before you into Galilee.
translations.ylt: but, after my having risen, I will go before you to Galilee.'
translations.web: But after I am raised up, I will go before you into Galilee.”

translations.kjv: Peter answered and said unto him, Though all men shall be offended because of thee, yet will I never be offended.
translations.ylt: And Peter answering said to him, `Even if all shall be stumbled at thee, I will never be stumbled.'
translations.web: But Peter answered him, “Even if all will be made to stumble because of you, I will never be made to stumble.”

translations.kjv: Jesus said unto him, Verily I say unto thee, That this night, before the cock crow, thou shalt deny me thrice.
translations.ylt: Jesus said to him, `Verily I say to thee, that, this night, before cock-crowing, thrice thou wilt deny me.'
translations.web: Jesus said to him, “Most certainly I tell you that tonight, before the rooster crows, you will deny me three times.”

translations.kjv: Peter said unto him, Though I should die with thee, yet will I not deny thee. Likewise also said all the disciples.
translations.ylt: Peter saith to him, `Even if it may be necessary for me to die with thee, I will not deny thee;' in like manner also said all the disciples.
translations.web: Peter said to him, “Even if I must die with you, I will not deny you.” All of the disciples also said likewise.

translations.kjv: Then cometh Jesus with them unto a place called Gethsemane, and saith unto the disciples, Sit ye here, while I go and pray yonder.
translations.ylt: Then come with them doth Jesus to a place called Gethsemane, and he saith to the disciples, `Sit ye here, till having gone away, I shall pray yonder.'
translations.web: Then Jesus came with them to a place called Gethsemane, and said to his disciples, “Sit here, while I go there and pray.”

translations.kjv: And he took with him Peter and the two sons of Zebedee, and began to be sorrowful and very heavy.
translations.ylt: And having taken Peter, and the two sons of Zebedee, he began to be sorrowful, and to be very heavy;
translations.web: He took with him Peter and the two sons of Zebedee, and began to be sorrowful and severely troubled.

translations.kjv: Then saith he unto them, My soul is exceeding sorrowful, even unto death: tarry ye here, and watch with me.
translations.ylt: then saith he to them, `Exceedingly sorrowful is my soul--unto death; abide ye here, and watch with me.'
translations.web: Then Jesus said to them, “My soul is exceedingly sorrowful, even to death. Stay here and watch with me.”

translations.kjv: And he went a little further, and fell on his face, and prayed, saying, O my Father, if it be possible, let this cup pass from me: nevertheless not as I will, but as thou wilt.
translations.ylt: And having gone forward a little, he fell on his face, praying, and saying, `My Father, if it be possible, let this cup pass from me; nevertheless, not as I will, but as Thou.'
translations.web: He went forward a little, fell on his face, and prayed, saying, “My Father, if it is possible, let this cup pass away from me; nevertheless, not what I desire, but what you desire.”

translations.kjv: And he cometh unto the disciples, and findeth them asleep, and saith unto Peter, What, could ye not watch with me one hour?
translations.ylt: And he cometh unto the disciples, and findeth them sleeping, and he saith to Peter, `So! ye were not able one hour to watch with me!
translations.web: He came to the disciples and found them sleeping, and said to Peter, “What, couldn’t you watch with me for one hour?

translations.kjv: Watch and pray, that ye enter not into temptation: the spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.
translations.ylt: watch, and pray, that ye may not enter into temptation: the spirit indeed is forward, but the flesh weak.'
translations.web: Watch and pray, that you don’t enter into temptation. The spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.”

translations.kjv: He went away again the second time, and prayed, saying, O my Father, if this cup may not pass away from me, except I drink it, thy will be done.
translations.ylt: Again, a second time, having gone away, he prayed, saying, `My Father, if this cup cannot pass away from me except I drink it, Thy will be done;'
translations.web: Again, a second time he went away and prayed, saying, “My Father, if this cup can’t pass away from me unless I drink it, your desire be done.”

translations.kjv: And he came and found them asleep again: for their eyes were heavy.
translations.ylt: and having come, he findeth them again sleeping, for their eyes were heavy.
translations.web: He came again and found them sleeping, for their eyes were heavy.

translations.kjv: And he left them, and went away again, and prayed the third time, saying the same words.
translations.ylt: And having left them, having gone away again, he prayed a third time, saying the same word;
translations.web: He left them again, went away, and prayed a third time, saying the same words.

translations.kjv: Then cometh he to his disciples, and saith unto them, Sleep on now, and take your rest: behold, the hour is at hand, and the Son of man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.
translations.ylt: then cometh he unto his disciples, and saith to them, `Sleep on henceforth, and rest! lo, the hour hath come nigh, and the Son of Man is delivered up to the hands of sinners.
translations.web: Then he came to his disciples and said to them, “Are you still sleeping and resting? Behold, the hour is at hand, and the Son of Man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.

translations.kjv: Rise, let us be going: behold, he is at hand that doth betray me.
translations.ylt: Rise, let us go; lo, he hath come nigh who is delivering me up.'
translations.web: Arise, let’s be going. Behold, he who betrays me is at hand.”

translations.kjv: And while he yet spake, lo, Judas, one of the twelve, came, and with him a great multitude with swords and staves, from the chief priests and elders of the people.
translations.ylt: And while he is yet speaking, lo, Judas, one of the twelve did come, and with him a great multitude, with swords and sticks, from the chief priests and elders of the people.
translations.web: While he was still speaking, behold, Judas, one of the twelve, came, and with him a great multitude with swords and clubs, from the chief priests and elders of the people.

translations.kjv: Now he that betrayed him gave them a sign, saying, Whomsoever I shall kiss, that same is he: hold him fast.
translations.ylt: And he who did deliver him up did give them a sign, saying, `Whomsoever I will kiss, it is he: lay hold on him;'
translations.web: Now he who betrayed him had given them a sign, saying, “Whoever I kiss, he is the one. Seize him.”

translations.kjv: And forthwith he came to Jesus, and said, Hail, master; and kissed him.
translations.ylt: and immediately, having come to Jesus, he said, `Hail, Rabbi,' and kissed him;
translations.web: Immediately he came to Jesus, and said, “Greetings, Rabbi!” and kissed him.

translations.kjv: And Jesus said unto him, Friend, wherefore art thou come? Then came they, and laid hands on Jesus, and took him.
translations.ylt: and Jesus said to him, `Comrade, for what art thou present?' Then having come near, they laid hands on Jesus, and took hold on him.
translations.web: Jesus said to him, “Friend, why are you here?” Then they came and laid hands on Jesus, and took him.

translations.kjv: And, behold, one of them which were with Jesus stretched out his hand, and drew his sword, and struck a servant of the high priest’s, and smote off his ear.
translations.ylt: And lo, one of those with Jesus, having stretched forth the hand, drew his sword, and having struck the servant of the chief priest, he took off his ear.
translations.web: Behold, one of those who were with Jesus stretched out his hand and drew his sword, and struck the servant of the high priest, and cut off his ear.

translations.kjv: Then said Jesus unto him, Put up again thy sword into his place: for all they that take the sword shall perish with the sword.
translations.ylt: Then saith Jesus to him, `Turn back thy sword to its place; for all who did take the sword, by the sword shall perish;
translations.web: Then Jesus said to him, “Put your sword back into its place, for all those who take the sword will die by the sword.

translations.kjv: Thinkest thou that I cannot now pray to my Father, and he shall presently give me more than twelve legions of angels?
translations.ylt: dost thou think that I am not able now to call upon my Father, and He will place beside me more than twelve legions of messengers?
translations.web: Or do you think that I couldn’t ask my Father, and he would even now send me more than twelve legions of angels?

translations.kjv: But how then shall the scriptures be fulfilled, that thus it must be?
translations.ylt: how then may the Writings be fulfilled, that thus it behoveth to happen?'
translations.web: How then would the Scriptures be fulfilled that it must be so?”

translations.kjv: In that same hour said Jesus to the multitudes, Are ye come out as against a thief with swords and staves for to take me? I sat daily with you teaching in the temple, and ye laid no hold on me.
translations.ylt: In that hour said Jesus to the multitudes, `As against a robber ye did come forth, with swords and sticks, to take me! daily with you I was sitting teaching in the temple, and ye did not lay hold on me;
translations.web: In that hour Jesus said to the multitudes, “Have you come out as against a robber with swords and clubs to seize me? I sat daily in the temple teaching, and you didn’t arrest me.

translations.kjv: But all this was done, that the scriptures of the prophets might be fulfilled. Then all the disciples forsook him, and fled.
translations.ylt: but all this hath come to pass, that the Writings of the prophets may be fulfilled;' then all the disciples, having left him, fled.
translations.web: But all this has happened that the Scriptures of the prophets might be fulfilled.” Then all the disciples left him and fled.

translations.kjv: And they that had laid hold on Jesus led him away to Caiaphas the high priest, where the scribes and the elders were assembled.
translations.ylt: And those laying hold on Jesus led him away unto Caiaphas the chief priest, where the scribes and the elders were gathered together,
translations.web: Those who had taken Jesus led him away to Caiaphas the high priest, where the scribes and the elders were gathered together.

translations.kjv: But Peter followed him afar off unto the high priest’s palace, and went in, and sat with the servants, to see the end.
translations.ylt: and Peter was following him afar off, unto the court of the chief priest, and having gone in within, he was sitting with the officers, to see the end.
translations.web: But Peter followed him from a distance to the court of the high priest, and entered in and sat with the officers, to see the end.

translations.kjv: Now the chief priests, and elders, and all the council, sought false witness against Jesus, to put him to death;
translations.ylt: And the chief priests, and the elders, and all the council, were seeking false witness against Jesus, that they might put him to death,
translations.web: Now the chief priests, the elders, and the whole council sought false testimony against Jesus, that they might put him to death,

translations.kjv: But found none: yea, though many false witnesses came, yet found they none. At the last came two false witnesses,
translations.ylt: and they did not find; and many false witnesses having come near, they did not find; and at last two false witnesses having come near,
translations.web: and they found none. Even though many false witnesses came forward, they found none. But at last two false witnesses came forward

translations.kjv: And said, This fellow said, I am able to destroy the temple of God, and to build it in three days.
translations.ylt: said, `This one said, I am able to throw down the sanctuary of God, and after three days to build it.'
translations.web: and said, “This man said, ‘I am able to destroy the temple of God, and to build it in three days.’”

translations.kjv: And the high priest arose, and said unto him, Answerest thou nothing? what is it which these witness against thee?
translations.ylt: And the chief priest having stood up, said to him, `Nothing thou dost answer! what do these witness against thee?
translations.web: The high priest stood up and said to him, “Have you no answer? What is this that these testify against you?”

translations.kjv: But Jesus held his peace. And the high priest answered and said unto him, I adjure thee by the living God, that thou tell us whether thou be the Christ, the Son of God.
translations.ylt: and Jesus was silent. And the chief priest answering said to him, `I adjure thee, by the living God, that thou mayest say to us, if thou art the Christ--the Son of God.'
translations.web: But Jesus stayed silent. The high priest answered him, “I adjure you by the living God that you tell us whether you are the Christ, the Son of God.”

translations.kjv: Jesus saith unto him, Thou hast said: nevertheless I say unto you, Hereafter shall ye see the Son of man sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven.
translations.ylt: Jesus saith to him, `Thou hast said; nevertheless I say to you, hereafter ye shall see the Son of Man sitting on the right hand of the power, and coming upon the clouds, of the heaven.'
translations.web: Jesus said to him, “You have said so. Nevertheless, I tell you, after this you will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of Power, and coming on the clouds of the sky.”

translations.kjv: Then the high priest rent his clothes, saying, He hath spoken blasphemy; what further need have we of witnesses? behold, now ye have heard his blasphemy.
translations.ylt: Then the chief priest rent his garments, saying, --`He hath spoken evil; what need have we yet of witnesses? lo, now ye heard his evil speaking;
translations.web: Then the high priest tore his clothing, saying, “He has spoken blasphemy! Why do we need any more witnesses? Behold, now you have heard his blasphemy.

translations.kjv: What think ye? They answered and said, He is guilty of death.
translations.ylt: what think ye?' and they answering said, `He is worthy of death.'
translations.web: What do you think?” They answered, “He is worthy of death!”

translations.kjv: Then did they spit in his face, and buffeted him; and others smote him with the palms of their hands,
translations.ylt: Then did they spit in his face and buffet him, and others did slap,
translations.web: Then they spat in his face and beat him with their fists, and some slapped him,

translations.kjv: Saying, Prophesy unto us, thou Christ, Who is he that smote thee?
translations.ylt: saying, `Declare to us, O Christ, who he is that struck thee?'
translations.web: saying, “Prophesy to us, you Christ! Who hit you?”

translations.kjv: Now Peter sat without in the palace: and a damsel came unto him, saying, Thou also wast with Jesus of Galilee.
translations.ylt: And Peter without was sitting in the court, and there came near to him a certain maid, saying, `And thou wast with Jesus of Galilee!'
translations.web: Now Peter was sitting outside in the court, and a maid came to him, saying, “You were also with Jesus, the Galilean!”

translations.kjv: But he denied before them all, saying, I know not what thou sayest.
translations.ylt: And he denied before all, saying, `I have not known what thou sayest.'
translations.web: But he denied it before them all, saying, “I don’t know what you are talking about.”

translations.kjv: And when he was gone out into the porch, another maid saw him, and said unto them that were there, This fellow was also with Jesus of Nazareth.
translations.ylt: And he having gone forth to the porch, another female saw him, and saith to those there, `And this one was with Jesus of Nazareth;'
translations.web: When he had gone out onto the porch, someone else saw him and said to those who were there, “This man also was with Jesus of Nazareth.”

translations.kjv: And again he denied with an oath, I do not know the man.
translations.ylt: and again did he deny with an oath--`I have not known the man.'
translations.web: Again he denied it with an oath, “I don’t know the man.”

translations.kjv: And after a while came unto him they that stood by, and said to Peter, Surely thou also art one of them; for thy speech bewrayeth thee.
translations.ylt: And after a little those standing near having come, said to Peter, `Truly thou also art of them, for even thy speech doth make thee manifest.'
translations.web: After a little while those who stood by came and said to Peter, “Surely you are also one of them, for your speech makes you known.”

translations.kjv: Then began he to curse and to swear, saying, I know not the man. And immediately the cock crew.
translations.ylt: Then began he to anathematise, and to swear--`I have not known the man;' and immediately did a cock crow,
translations.web: Then he began to curse and to swear, “I don’t know the man!” Immediately the rooster crowed.

translations.kjv: And Peter remembered the word of Jesus, which said unto him, Before the cock crow, thou shalt deny me thrice. And he went out, and wept bitterly.
translations.ylt: and Peter remembered the saying of Jesus, he having said to him--`Before cock-crowing, thrice thou wilt deny me;' and having gone without, he did weep bitterly.
translations.web: Peter remembered the word which Jesus had said to him, “Before the rooster crows, you will deny me three times.” Then he went out and wept bitterly.

translations.kjv: When the morning was come, all the chief priests and elders of the people took counsel against Jesus to put him to death:
translations.ylt: And morning having come, all the chief priests and the elders of the people took counsel against Jesus, so as to put him to death;
translations.web: Now when morning had come, all the chief priests and the elders of the people took counsel against Jesus to put him to death.

translations.kjv: And when they had bound him, they led him away, and delivered him to Pontius Pilate the governor.
translations.ylt: and having bound him, they did lead away, and delivered him up to Pontius Pilate, the governor.
translations.web: They bound him, led him away, and delivered him up to Pontius Pilate, the governor.

translations.kjv: Then Judas, which had betrayed him, when he saw that he was condemned, repented himself, and brought again the thirty pieces of silver to the chief priests and elders,
translations.ylt: Then Judas--he who delivered him up--having seen that he was condemned, having repented, brought back the thirty silverlings to the chief priests, and to the elders, saying,
translations.web: Then Judas, who betrayed him, when he saw that Jesus was condemned, felt remorse, and brought back the thirty pieces of silver to the chief priests and elders,

translations.kjv: Saying, I have sinned in that I have betrayed the innocent blood. And they said, What is that to us? see thou to that.
translations.ylt: `I did sin, having delivered up innocent blood;' and they said, `What--to us? thou shalt see!'
translations.web: saying, “I have sinned in that I betrayed innocent blood.” But they said, “What is that to us? You see to it.”

translations.kjv: And he cast down the pieces of silver in the temple, and departed, and went and hanged himself.
translations.ylt: and having cast down the silverlings in the sanctuary, he departed, and having gone away, he did strangle himself.
translations.web: He threw down the pieces of silver in the sanctuary and departed. Then he went away and hanged himself.

translations.kjv: And the chief priests took the silver pieces, and said, It is not lawful for to put them into the treasury, because it is the price of blood.
translations.ylt: And the chief priests having taken the silverlings, said, `It is not lawful to put them to the treasury, seeing it is the price of blood;'
translations.web: The chief priests took the pieces of silver and said, “It’s not lawful to put them into the treasury, since it is the price of blood.”

translations.kjv: And they took counsel, and bought with them the potter’s field, to bury strangers in.
translations.ylt: and having taken counsel, they bought with them the field of the potter, for the burial of strangers;
translations.web: They took counsel, and bought the potter’s field with them to bury strangers in.

translations.kjv: Wherefore that field was called, The field of blood, unto this day.
translations.ylt: therefore was that field called, `Field of blood,' unto this day.
translations.web: Therefore that field has been called “The Field of Blood” to this day.

translations.kjv: Then was fulfilled that which was spoken by Jeremy the prophet, saying, And they took the thirty pieces of silver, the price of him that was valued, whom they of the children of Israel did value;
translations.ylt: Then was fulfilled that spoken through Jeremiah the prophet, saying, `And I took the thirty silverlings, the price of him who hath been priced, whom they of the sons of Israel did price,
translations.web: Then that which was spoken through Jeremiah the prophet was fulfilled, saying, “They took the thirty pieces of silver, the price of him upon whom a price had been set, whom some of the children of Israel priced,
