translations.kjv: And gave them for the potter’s field, as the Lord appointed me.
translations.ylt: and gave them for the field of the potter, as the Lord did appoint to me.'
translations.web: and they gave them for the potter’s field, as the Lord commanded me.”

translations.kjv: And Jesus stood before the governor: and the governor asked him, saying, Art thou the King of the Jews? And Jesus said unto him, Thou sayest.
translations.ylt: And Jesus stood before the governor, and the governor did question him, saying, `Art thou the king of the Jews!' And Jesus said to him, `Thou sayest.'
translations.web: Now Jesus stood before the governor; and the governor asked him, saying, “Are you the King of the Jews?” Jesus said to him, “So you say.”

translations.kjv: And when he was accused of the chief priests and elders, he answered nothing.
translations.ylt: And in his being accused by the chief priests and the elders, he did not answer any thing,
translations.web: When he was accused by the chief priests and elders, he answered nothing.

translations.kjv: Then said Pilate unto him, Hearest thou not how many things they witness against thee?
translations.ylt: then saith Pilate to him, `Dost thou not hear how many things they witness against thee?'
translations.web: Then Pilate said to him, “Don’t you hear how many things they testify against you?”

translations.kjv: And he answered him to never a word; insomuch that the governor marvelled greatly.
translations.ylt: And he did not answer him, not even to one word, so that the governor did wonder greatly.
translations.web: He gave him no answer, not even one word, so that the governor marveled greatly.

translations.kjv: Now at that feast the governor was wont to release unto the people a prisoner, whom they would.
translations.ylt: And at the feast the governor had been accustomed to release one to the multitude, a prisoner, whom they willed,
translations.web: Now at the feast the governor was accustomed to release to the multitude one prisoner whom they desired.

translations.kjv: And they had then a notable prisoner, called Barabbas.
translations.ylt: and they had then a noted prisoner, called Barabbas,
translations.web: They had then a notable prisoner called Barabbas.

translations.kjv: Therefore when they were gathered together, Pilate said unto them, Whom will ye that I release unto you? Barabbas, or Jesus which is called Christ?
translations.ylt: they therefore having been gathered together, Pilate said to them, `Whom will ye I shall release to you? Barabbas or Jesus who is called Christ?'
translations.web: When therefore they were gathered together, Pilate said to them, “Whom do you want me to release to you? Barabbas, or Jesus who is called Christ?”

translations.kjv: For he knew that for envy they had delivered him.
translations.ylt: for he had known that because of envy they had delivered him up.
translations.web: For he knew that because of envy they had delivered him up.

translations.kjv: When he was set down on the judgment seat, his wife sent unto him, saying, Have thou nothing to do with that just man: for I have suffered many things this day in a dream because of him.
translations.ylt: And as he is sitting on the tribunal, his wife sent unto him, saying, `Nothing--to thee and to that righteous one, for many things did I suffer to-day in a dream because of him.'
translations.web: While he was sitting on the judgment seat, his wife sent to him, saying, “Have nothing to do with that righteous man, for I have suffered many things today in a dream because of him.”

translations.kjv: But the chief priests and elders persuaded the multitude that they should ask Barabbas, and destroy Jesus.
translations.ylt: And the chief priests and the elders did persuade the multitudes that they might ask for themselves Barabbas, and might destroy Jesus;
translations.web: Now the chief priests and the elders persuaded the multitudes to ask for Barabbas and destroy Jesus.

translations.kjv: The governor answered and said unto them, Whether of the twain will ye that I release unto you? They said, Barabbas.
translations.ylt: and the governor answering said to them, `Which of the two will ye that I shall release to you?' And they said, `Barabbas.'
translations.web: But the governor answered them, “Which of the two do you want me to release to you?” They said, “Barabbas!”

translations.kjv: Pilate saith unto them, What shall I do then with Jesus which is called Christ? They all say unto him, Let him be crucified.
translations.ylt: Pilate saith to them, `What then shall I do with Jesus who is called Christ?' They all say to him, `Let be crucified!'
translations.web: Pilate said to them, “What then shall I do to Jesus who is called Christ?” They all said to him, “Let him be crucified!”

translations.kjv: And the governor said, Why, what evil hath he done? But they cried out the more, saying, Let him be crucified.
translations.ylt: And the governor said, `Why, what evil did he?' and they were crying out the more, saying, `Let be crucified.'
translations.web: But the governor said, “Why? What evil has he done?” But they cried out exceedingly, saying, “Let him be crucified!”

translations.kjv: When Pilate saw that he could prevail nothing, but that rather a tumult was made, he took water, and washed his hands before the multitude, saying, I am innocent of the blood of this just person: see ye to it.
translations.ylt: And Pilate having seen that it profiteth nothing, but rather a tumult is made, having taken water, he did wash the hands before the multitude, saying, `I am innocent from the blood of this righteous one; ye--ye shall see;'
translations.web: So when Pilate saw that nothing was being gained, but rather that a disturbance was starting, he took water and washed his hands before the multitude, saying, “I am innocent of the blood of this righteous person. You see to it.”

translations.kjv: Then answered all the people, and said, His blood be on us, and on our children.
translations.ylt: and all the people answering said, `His blood is upon us, and upon our children!'
translations.web: All the people answered, “May his blood be on us and on our children!”

translations.kjv: Then released he Barabbas unto them: and when he had scourged Jesus, he delivered him to be crucified.
translations.ylt: Then did he release to them Barabbas, and having scourged Jesus, he delivered him up that he may be crucified;
translations.web: Then he released Barabbas to them, but Jesus he flogged and delivered to be crucified.

translations.kjv: Then the soldiers of the governor took Jesus into the common hall, and gathered unto him the whole band of soldiers.
translations.ylt: then the soldiers of the governor having taken Jesus to the Praetorium, did gather to him all the band;
translations.web: Then the governor’s soldiers took Jesus into the Praetorium, and gathered the whole garrison together against him.

translations.kjv: And they stripped him, and put on him a scarlet robe.
translations.ylt: and having unclothed him, they put around him a crimson cloak,
translations.web: They stripped him and put a scarlet robe on him.

translations.kjv: And when they had platted a crown of thorns, they put it upon his head, and a reed in his right hand: and they bowed the knee before him, and mocked him, saying, Hail, King of the Jews!
translations.ylt: and having plaited him a crown out of thorns they put it on his head, and a reed in his right hand, and having kneeled before him, they were mocking him, saying, `Hail, the king of the Jews.'
translations.web: They braided a crown of thorns and put it on his head, and a reed in his right hand; and they kneeled down before him and mocked him, saying, “Hail, King of the Jews!”

translations.kjv: And they spit upon him, and took the reed, and smote him on the head.
translations.ylt: And having spit on him, they took the reed, and were smiting on his head;
translations.web: They spat on him, and took the reed and struck him on the head.

translations.kjv: And after that they had mocked him, they took the robe off from him, and put his own raiment on him, and led him away to crucify him.
translations.ylt: and when they had mocked him, they took off from him the cloak, and put on him his own garments, and led him away to crucify him.
translations.web: When they had mocked him, they took the robe off him, and put his clothes on him, and led him away to crucify him.

translations.kjv: And as they came out, they found a man of Cyrene, Simon by name: him they compelled to bear his cross.
translations.ylt: And coming forth, they found a man, a Cyrenian, by name Simon: him they impressed that he might bear his cross;
translations.web: As they came out, they found a man of Cyrene, Simon by name, and they compelled him to go with them, that he might carry his cross.

translations.kjv: And when they were come unto a place called Golgotha, that is to say, a place of a skull,
translations.ylt: and having come to a place called Golgotha, that is called Place of a Skull,
translations.web: When they came to a place called “Golgotha”, that is to say, “The place of a skull,”

translations.kjv: They gave him vinegar to drink mingled with gall: and when he had tasted thereof, he would not drink.
translations.ylt: they gave him to drink vinegar mixed with gall, and having tasted, he would not drink.
translations.web: they gave him sour wine to drink mixed with gall. When he had tasted it, he would not drink.

translations.kjv: And they crucified him, and parted his garments, casting lots: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, They parted my garments among them, and upon my vesture did they cast lots.
translations.ylt: And having crucified him, they divided his garments, casting a lot, that it might be fulfilled that was spoken by the prophet, `They divided my garments to themselves, and over my vesture they cast a lot;'
translations.web: When they had crucified him, they divided his clothing among them, casting lots,

translations.kjv: And sitting down they watched him there;
translations.ylt: and sitting down, they were watching him there,
translations.web: and they sat and watched him there.

translations.kjv: And set up over his head his accusation written, THIS IS JESUS THE KING OF THE JEWS.
translations.ylt: and they put up over his head, his accusation written, `This is Jesus, the king of the Jews.'
translations.web: They set up over his head the accusation against him written, “THIS IS JESUS, THE KING OF THE JEWS.”

translations.kjv: Then were there two thieves crucified with him, one on the right hand, and another on the left.
translations.ylt: Then crucified with him are two robbers, one on the right hand, and one on the left,
translations.web: Then there were two robbers crucified with him, one on his right hand and one on the left.

translations.kjv: And they that passed by reviled him, wagging their heads,
translations.ylt: and those passing by were speaking evil of him, wagging their heads,
translations.web: Those who passed by blasphemed him, wagging their heads

translations.kjv: And saying, Thou that destroyest the temple, and buildest it in three days, save thyself. If thou be the Son of God, come down from the cross.
translations.ylt: and saying, `Thou that art throwing down the sanctuary, and in three days building it, save thyself; if Son thou art of God, come down from the cross.'
translations.web: and saying, “You who destroy the temple and build it in three days, save yourself! If you are the Son of God, come down from the cross!”

translations.kjv: Likewise also the chief priests mocking him, with the scribes and elders, said,
translations.ylt: And in like manner also the chief priests mocking, with the scribes and elders, said,
translations.web: Likewise the chief priests also mocking with the scribes, the Pharisees, and the elders, said,

translations.kjv: He saved others; himself he cannot save. If he be the King of Israel, let him now come down from the cross, and we will believe him.
translations.ylt: `Others he saved; himself he is not able to save! If he be King of Israel, let him come down now from the cross, and we will believe him;
translations.web: “He saved others, but he can’t save himself. If he is the King of Israel, let him come down from the cross now, and we will believe in him.

translations.kjv: He trusted in God; let him deliver him now, if he will have him: for he said, I am the Son of God.
translations.ylt: he hath trusted on God, let Him now deliver him, if He wish him, because he said--Son of God I am;'
translations.web: He trusts in God. Let God deliver him now, if he wants him; for he said, ‘I am the Son of God.’”

translations.kjv: The thieves also, which were crucified with him, cast the same in his teeth.
translations.ylt: with the same also the robbers, who were crucified with him, were reproaching him.
translations.web: The robbers also who were crucified with him cast on him the same reproach.

translations.kjv: Now from the sixth hour there was darkness over all the land unto the ninth hour.
translations.ylt: And from the sixth hour darkness came over all the land unto the ninth hour,
translations.web: Now from the sixth hour there was darkness over all the land until the ninth hour.

translations.kjv: And about the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, Eli, Eli, lama sabachthani? that is to say, My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me?
translations.ylt: and about the ninth hour Jesus cried out with a great voice, saying, `Eli, Eli, lama sabachthani?' that is, `My God, my God, why didst Thou forsake me?'
translations.web: About the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, “Eli, Eli, lima sabachthani?” That is, “My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?”

translations.kjv: Some of them that stood there, when they heard that, said, This man calleth for Elias.
translations.ylt: And certain of those standing there having heard, said--`Elijah he doth call;'
translations.web: Some of them who stood there, when they heard it, said, “This man is calling Elijah.”

translations.kjv: And straightway one of them ran, and took a spunge, and filled it with vinegar, and put it on a reed, and gave him to drink.
translations.ylt: and immediately, one of them having run, and having taken a spunge, having filled it with vinegar, and having put it on a reed, was giving him to drink,
translations.web: Immediately one of them ran and took a sponge, filled it with vinegar, put it on a reed, and gave him a drink.

translations.kjv: The rest said, Let be, let us see whether Elias will come to save him.
translations.ylt: but the rest said, `Let alone, let us see if Elijah doth come--about to save him.'
translations.web: The rest said, “Let him be. Let’s see whether Elijah comes to save him.”

translations.kjv: Jesus, when he had cried again with a loud voice, yielded up the ghost.
translations.ylt: And Jesus having again cried with a great voice, yielded the spirit;
translations.web: Jesus cried again with a loud voice, and yielded up his spirit.

translations.kjv: And, behold, the veil of the temple was rent in twain from the top to the bottom; and the earth did quake, and the rocks rent;
translations.ylt: and lo, the vail of the sanctuary was rent in two from top unto bottom, and the earth did quake, and the rocks were rent,
translations.web: Behold, the veil of the temple was torn in two from the top to the bottom. The earth quaked and the rocks were split.

translations.kjv: And the graves were opened; and many bodies of the saints which slept arose,
translations.ylt: and the tombs were opened, and many bodies of the saints who have fallen asleep, arose,
translations.web: The tombs were opened, and many bodies of the saints who had fallen asleep were raised;

translations.kjv: And came out of the graves after his resurrection, and went into the holy city, and appeared unto many.
translations.ylt: and having come forth out of the tombs after his rising, they went into the holy city, and appeared to many.
translations.web: and coming out of the tombs after his resurrection, they entered into the holy city and appeared to many.

translations.kjv: Now when the centurion, and they that were with him, watching Jesus, saw the earthquake, and those things that were done, they feared greatly, saying, Truly this was the Son of God.
translations.ylt: And the centurion, and those with him watching Jesus, having seen the earthquake, and the things that were done, were exceedingly afraid, saying, `Truly this was God's Son.'
translations.web: Now the centurion and those who were with him watching Jesus, when they saw the earthquake and the things that were done, were terrified, saying, “Truly this was the Son of God!”

translations.kjv: And many women were there beholding afar off, which followed Jesus from Galilee, ministering unto him:
translations.ylt: And there were there many women beholding from afar, who did follow Jesus from Galilee, ministering to him,
translations.web: Many women were there watching from afar, who had followed Jesus from Galilee, serving him.

translations.kjv: Among which was Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James and Joses, and the mother of Zebedee’s children.
translations.ylt: among whom was Mary the Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James and of Joses, and the mother of the sons of Zebedee.
translations.web: Among them were Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James and Joses, and the mother of the sons of Zebedee.

translations.kjv: When the even was come, there came a rich man of Arimathea, named Joseph, who also himself was Jesus’ disciple:
translations.ylt: And evening having come, there came a rich man, from Arimathea, named Joseph, who also himself was discipled to Jesus,
translations.web: When evening had come, a rich man from Arimathaea named Joseph, who himself was also Jesus’ disciple, came.

translations.kjv: He went to Pilate, and begged the body of Jesus. Then Pilate commanded the body to be delivered.
translations.ylt: he having gone near to Pilate, asked for himself the body of Jesus; then Pilate commanded the body to be given back.
translations.web: This man went to Pilate and asked for Jesus’ body. Then Pilate commanded the body to be given up.

translations.kjv: And when Joseph had taken the body, he wrapped it in a clean linen cloth,
translations.ylt: And having taken the body, Joseph wrapped it in clean linen,
translations.web: Joseph took the body and wrapped it in a clean linen cloth

translations.kjv: And laid it in his own new tomb, which he had hewn out in the rock: and he rolled a great stone to the door of the sepulchre, and departed.
translations.ylt: and laid it in his new tomb, that he hewed in the rock, and having rolled a great stone to the door of the tomb, he went away;
translations.web: and laid it in his own new tomb, which he had cut out in the rock. Then he rolled a large stone against the door of the tomb, and departed.

translations.kjv: And there was Mary Magdalene, and the other Mary, sitting over against the sepulchre.
translations.ylt: and there were there Mary the Magdalene, and the other Mary, sitting over-against the sepulchre.
translations.web: Mary Magdalene was there, and the other Mary, sitting opposite the tomb.

translations.kjv: Now the next day, that followed the day of the preparation, the chief priests and Pharisees came together unto Pilate,
translations.ylt: And on the morrow that is after the preparation, were gathered together the chief priests, and the Pharisees, unto Pilate,
translations.web: Now on the next day, which was the day after the Preparation Day, the chief priests and the Pharisees were gathered together to Pilate,

translations.kjv: Saying, Sir, we remember that that deceiver said, while he was yet alive, After three days I will rise again.
translations.ylt: saying, `Sir, we have remembered that that deceiver said while yet living, After three days I do rise;
translations.web: saying, “Sir, we remember what that deceiver said while he was still alive: ‘After three days I will rise again.’

translations.kjv: Command therefore that the sepulchre be made sure until the third day, lest his disciples come by night, and steal him away, and say unto the people, He is risen from the dead: so the last error shall be worse than the first.
translations.ylt: command, then, the sepulchre to be made secure till the third day, lest his disciples, having come by night, may steal him away, and may say to the people, He rose from the dead, and the last deceit shall be worse than the first.'
translations.web: Command therefore that the tomb be made secure until the third day, lest perhaps his disciples come at night and steal him away, and tell the people, ‘He is risen from the dead;’ and the last deception will be worse than the first.”

translations.kjv: Pilate said unto them, Ye have a watch: go your way, make it as sure as ye can.
translations.ylt: And Pilate said to them, `Ye have a watch, go away, make secure--as ye have known;'
translations.web: Pilate said to them, “You have a guard. Go, make it as secure as you can.”

translations.kjv: So they went, and made the sepulchre sure, sealing the stone, and setting a watch.
translations.ylt: and they, having gone, did make the sepulchre secure, having sealed the stone, together with the watch.
translations.web: So they went with the guard and made the tomb secure, sealing the stone.

translations.kjv: In the end of the sabbath, as it began to dawn toward the first day of the week, came Mary Magdalene and the other Mary to see the sepulchre.
translations.ylt: And on the eve of the sabbaths, at the dawn, toward the first of the sabbaths, came Mary the Magdalene, and the other Mary, to see the sepulchre,
translations.web: Now after the Sabbath, as it began to dawn on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary came to see the tomb.

translations.kjv: And, behold, there was a great earthquake: for the angel of the Lord descended from heaven, and came and rolled back the stone from the door, and sat upon it.
translations.ylt: and lo, there came a great earthquake, for a messenger of the Lord, having come down out of heaven, having come, did roll away the stone from the door, and was sitting upon it,
translations.web: Behold, there was a great earthquake, for an angel of the Lord descended from the sky and came and rolled away the stone from the door and sat on it.

translations.kjv: His countenance was like lightning, and his raiment white as snow:
translations.ylt: and his countenance was as lightning, and his clothing white as snow,
translations.web: His appearance was like lightning, and his clothing white as snow.

translations.kjv: And for fear of him the keepers did shake, and became as dead men.
translations.ylt: and from the fear of him did the keepers shake, and they became as dead men.
translations.web: For fear of him, the guards shook, and became like dead men.

translations.kjv: And the angel answered and said unto the women, Fear not ye: for I know that ye seek Jesus, which was crucified.
translations.ylt: And the messenger answering said to the women, `Fear not ye, for I have known that Jesus, who hath been crucified, ye seek;
translations.web: The angel answered the women, “Don’t be afraid, for I know that you seek Jesus, who has been crucified.

translations.kjv: He is not here: for he is risen, as he said. Come, see the place where the Lord lay.
translations.ylt: he is not here, for he rose, as he said; come, see the place where the Lord was lying;
translations.web: He is not here, for he has risen, just like he said. Come, see the place where the Lord was lying.

translations.kjv: And go quickly, and tell his disciples that he is risen from the dead; and, behold, he goeth before you into Galilee; there shall ye see him: lo, I have told you.
translations.ylt: and having gone quickly, say ye to his disciples, that he rose from the dead; and lo, he doth go before you to Galilee, there ye shall see him; lo, I have told you.'
translations.web: Go quickly and tell his disciples, ‘He has risen from the dead, and behold, he goes before you into Galilee; there you will see him.’ Behold, I have told you.”

translations.kjv: And they departed quickly from the sepulchre with fear and great joy; and did run to bring his disciples word.
translations.ylt: And having gone forth quickly from the tomb, with fear and great joy, they ran to tell to his disciples;
translations.web: They departed quickly from the tomb with fear and great joy, and ran to bring his disciples word.

translations.kjv: And as they went to tell his disciples, behold, Jesus met them, saying, All hail. And they came and held him by the feet, and worshipped him.
translations.ylt: and as they were going to tell to his disciples, then lo, Jesus met them, saying, `Hail!' and they having come near, laid hold of his feet, and did bow to him.
translations.web: As they went to tell his disciples, behold, Jesus met them, saying, “Rejoice!” They came and took hold of his feet, and worshiped him.

translations.kjv: Then said Jesus unto them, Be not afraid: go tell my brethren that they go into Galilee, and there shall they see me.
translations.ylt: Then saith Jesus to them, `Fear ye not, go away, tell to my brethren that they may go away to Galilee, and there they shall see me.'
translations.web: Then Jesus said to them, “Don’t be afraid. Go tell my brothers that they should go into Galilee, and there they will see me.”

translations.kjv: Now when they were going, behold, some of the watch came into the city, and shewed unto the chief priests all the things that were done.
translations.ylt: And while they are going on, lo, certain of the watch having come to the city, told to the chief priests all the things that happened,
translations.web: Now while they were going, behold, some of the guards came into the city and told the chief priests all the things that had happened.

translations.kjv: And when they were assembled with the elders, and had taken counsel, they gave large money unto the soldiers,
translations.ylt: and having been gathered together with the elders, counsel also having taken, they gave much money to the soldiers,
translations.web: When they were assembled with the elders and had taken counsel, they gave a large amount of silver to the soldiers,

translations.kjv: Saying, Say ye, His disciples came by night, and stole him away while we slept.
translations.ylt: saying, `Say ye, that his disciples having come by night, stole him--we being asleep;
translations.web: saying, “Say that his disciples came by night and stole him away while we slept.

translations.kjv: And if this come to the governor’s ears, we will persuade him, and secure you.
translations.ylt: and if this be heard by the governor, we will persuade him, and you keep free from anxiety.'
translations.web: If this comes to the governor’s ears, we will persuade him and make you free of worry.”

translations.kjv: So they took the money, and did as they were taught: and this saying is commonly reported among the Jews until this day.
translations.ylt: And they, having received the money, did as they were taught, and this account was spread abroad among Jews till this day.
translations.web: So they took the money and did as they were told. This saying was spread abroad among the Jews, and continues until today.

translations.kjv: Then the eleven disciples went away into Galilee, into a mountain where Jesus had appointed them.
translations.ylt: And the eleven disciples went to Galilee, to the mount where Jesus appointed them,
translations.web: But the eleven disciples went into Galilee, to the mountain where Jesus had sent them.

translations.kjv: And when they saw him, they worshipped him: but some doubted.
translations.ylt: and having seen him, they bowed to him, but some did waver.
translations.web: When they saw him, they bowed down to him; but some doubted.

translations.kjv: And Jesus came and spake unto them, saying, All power is given unto me in heaven and in earth.
translations.ylt: And having come near, Jesus spake to them, saying, `Given to me was all authority in heaven and on earth;
translations.web: Jesus came to them and spoke to them, saying, “All authority has been given to me in heaven and on earth.

translations.kjv: Go ye therefore, and teach all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost:
translations.ylt: having gone, then, disciple all the nations, (baptizing them--to the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit,
translations.web: Go and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit,

translations.kjv: Teaching them to observe all things whatsoever I have commanded you: and, lo, I am with you alway, even unto the end of the world. Amen.
translations.ylt: teaching them to observe all, whatever I did command you,) and lo, I am with you all the days--till the full end of the age.'
translations.web: teaching them to observe all things that I commanded you. Behold, I am with you always, even to the end of the age.” Amen.
